articleTitle: Research on Distributed Photovoltaic Data Acquisition and Control of Active Distribution Network with High Proportion of New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the "double carbon", the whole county distributed photovoltaic and other related policies under the target background, distributed photovoltaics have been extensively constructed, and the access ratio has been continuously improved. Due to the randomness, volatility and uncertainty of distributed photovoltaic output, The dispatching of active distribution network faces the problem of operation management after the participation of large-scale distributed PV. Through the research of distributed photovoltaic data acquisition, control strategy and platform construction practice, this paper realizes the "observable, measurable, adjustable and controllable" demand of new power system after the grid connection of high proportion distributed photovoltaic, helps the high proportion orderly grid connection of distributed photovoltaic, and improves the security and stability of the power system.

articleTitle: Rapid Power Support-based Frequency Response Strategy for Grid Forming Inverter in Low-Inertia Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy (RES) into the grid has resulted in the transformation of traditional power systems into low-inertia power systems. Moreover, this transformation has also caused a significant reduction in the system’s inertia and damping levels, making it more susceptible to frequency instability and load-shedding incidents. Although grid forming (GFM) inverters can provide inertia and damping to the system, the parameters are typically fixed, resulting in a lack of comprehensive inertia. In order to improve the frequency response (FR) of low-inertia power systems, this paper proposes a rapid power support (RPS)-based frequency response strategy for GFM inverter based on droop control. Firstly, the principles of RPS are thoroughly explained, emphasizing how modifying power references can enhance the frequency response. Secondly, the specific implementation of the RPS strategy is presented by switching between different modes. Finally, simulation is conducted to validate the superior performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Line Parameters Identification in LV Distribution Stations Based on Non-liner Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The study of line impedance parameters in low-voltage distribution stations is beneficial to utilities for file sorting and asset management, as well as the basis for trending, line loss analysis, power theft monitoring, and fault prediction. In the low-voltage(LV) distribution station areas, the topology and wiring are so complex that manual on-site inspection and confirmation is undesirable. Therefore, this paper proposes a parameter identification method based on smart meter measurement data, taking line impedance as the independent variable, projecting transformer secondary side voltage and constructing the objective function based on customer voltage and power data, transforming the parameter equation solution problem into an optimization problem, and solving it by nonlinear least squares to obtain the optimal line parameter combination. The method is tested by real-world measurement data combined with simulation to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the method.

articleTitle: Power Spot Market Clearing Method Based on Market Value Distribution Mechanism Considers the Participation of Independent Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of designing the clearing mechanism of independent energy storage in the spot market and enhance the initiative of independent energy storage to participate in the electricity market, a spot market clearing method based on the market value distribution mechanism was proposed to consider the participation of independent energy storage. The basic concept of market value distribution mechanism is introduced. Taking the substitution benefit of independent energy storage in spot market as its clearing standard, an independent energy storage spot market clearing algorithm based on market value distribution mechanism is constructed. This algorithm evaluates the benefit of independent energy storage to optimize the cost of electricity purchase by comparing the cost changes of all online electricity purchase before and after the call of independent energy storage. If independent energy storage helps to improve the trading benefits of the whole network, the charging and discharging plan of independent energy storage will be cleared; Otherwise, the independent energy storage charging and discharging plan cannot be cleared. Finally, an example is given based on the actual grid data of a province to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The numerical results show that compared with the traditional self-scheduling mode, the proposed method can guarantee the income of independent energy storage and enhance its market trading enthusiasm.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Performance of Conductive Polyolefin Coated Metal Grounding Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In response to the problem that the increase in grounding resistance and decrease in current dissipation capacity after corrosion of grounding grid materials can lead to grid faults, this article conducts experimental research on the electrochemical and corrosion resistance of three grounding materials, namely galvanized steel, copper, and conductive polyolefin coated metal, through on-site buried experiments and laboratory indoor simulation. The research results indicate that under long-term corrosive environments, the grounding resistance of conductive polyolefin coated metal grounding materials remains almost unchanged; In the absence of current, conductive polyolefin materials can hardly measure corrosion loss in corrosive environments, while the corrosion rate of galvanized steel is 3-4 times that of copper; Under the same current, the corrosion rate of conductive polyolefin materials in corrosive environments is only 1/30 of that of galvanized steel and 1/20 of that of copper; Conductive polyolefin do not produce corrosion products during the corrosion process, which will not lead to a decrease in the grounding performance of the grounding material. This research result can provide certain reference significance for the material selection of ground grids.

articleTitle: Distributed Control of Photovoltaic-Energy Storage System for Low-Voltage Distribution Networks Considering the Consistency of Power and SOC
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High-proportion integration of distributed photovoltaics presents new challenges to the safe and stable operation of distribution networks., among which the voltage violation and distribution substation overload problems are especially prominent. Therefore, it is critical to examine control methods for distribution networks with high levels of distributed photovoltaics. This paper proposes a distributed control approach for photovoltaic-energy storage (PV-ES) systems in low-voltage distribution networks that accounts for power and SOC consistency. The suggested approach leverages cooperative control among multiple PV-ES systems to mitigate voltage violations and transformer overloads while also taking into account the capacity differences among these systems. First, we propose a power management strategy that distributes power regulation commands to reduce transformer overloads in low-voltage distribution networks. Second, we construct a comprehensive consistency variable that considers both power and SOC of PV-ES systems and propose a distributed control approach for PV-ES systems based on this variable. Lastly, simulation calculations verify the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban Electric Vehicle Charging Power Demand under Extreme Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the implementation and promotion of the national “double carbon” policy, the electric vehicle industry is developing rapidly. The energy consumption, battery capacity fluctuation and charging power characteristics of electric vehicles (EVs) influence not only the development of the electric vehicle industry, but also the safe operation of the power grid. Ambient temperature and road traffic congestion influence the energy consumption of EVs, which leads to different charging power. In this paper, based on statistical methods, we analyze a large number of traffic data samples to dig out the function relationship between the average speed of electric vehicle driving and road congestion coefficient, and propose a general calculation model based on energy consumption, battery capacity and charging power of EVs accordingly. Taking a large city in China as an example, a Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the charging load of each type of EV under different ambient temperatures and different EV penetration rates to analyze the impact of EVs on the grid and provide a reference for the grid to cope with the sudden increase of EV penetration in the future.

articleTitle: Multiple Output Sparse Gaussian Processes for Short-Term Electric Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Smart grid is introduced to address power grid challenges such as reliability, efficiency, greenhouse gas and carbon emissions, economics, safety, and energy security. Electric load forecasting is one of the techniques that support smart grid objectives. It forecasts the electric load at aggregated levels and is mandatory for the smart grid’s proper functioning. It keeps a balance between load generation and load consumption and can be classified as very short-term, short-term, medium-term, and long-term electric load forecasting based on the time interval of its prediction. In this paper, multiple output sparse Gaussian processes are proposed to predict 24 values of the electric load for the next day (short-term electric load forecasting) based on load and weather data (temperature and dew point) from previous days. The performance of the proposed multiple output sparse Gaussian processes was compared with the persistence method. By comparing the mean absolute percentage error values of the proposed method with the persistence method, it can be seen that the proposed method outperforms the persistence method very well.

Index Terms: Difference In The Number Of Days

articleTitle: Location Method of Amplitude-Phase Controlled Phase Shifting Transformer Considering New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high permeability access of Distributed Generations (DG), such as difficulty in eliminating new energy, over-voltage and overload of lines, Phase Shifting Transformer (PST) has been gradually applied as an economical and reliable power flow control device. Affected by the characteristics of PST, it is necessary to choose the optimum installation position in the distribution network. Therefore, a method of amplitude-phase controlled PST location considering new energy dissipation and loop-closing operation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, this paper derives the mathematical model of amplitude-phase controlled PST, which adds the function of amplitude modulation on the basis of phase modulation function of PST, which increases the system's reactive power control capability. Then, a multi-objective optimization model for PST location is established considering the factors such as new energy absorption, power quality, network loss and loop closure safety. Finally, an example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method. The application of amplitude-phase controlled PST relaxes constraints. Under the optimal installation position, PST greatly promotes the absorption of new energy. At the same time, it also improves the voltage level, reduces the network loss and ensures the safety of the loop closing process.

articleTitle: Direct Algorithm for Static Voltage Stability Boundary Considering Power Fluctuations of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Driven by the ‘dual carbon’ goal, the development of renewable energy such as photovoltaics and wind power are rapidly increasing. However, the uncertainty and fluctuations of renewable energy have significant impacts on the static voltage stability boundary of the power system. Classical methods such as continuous power flow require repeated sampling using Monte Carlo methods, which are inefficient. It is therefore important to seek a static voltage stability analysis method that can balance computational efficiency and accuracy. This paper proposes an Affine Total Derivative Interval Algorithm that can quickly and accurately calculate the interval range of the static voltage stability boundary under the influence of power fluctuations of renewable energy. Using the IEEE standard calculation system, a comparison with a homogeneous algorithm demonstrated the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Method for the Evaluation of Uncertainty in the Measurement of Transformer Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The evaluation and expression of uncertainty is one of the fundamental issues in metrology. Transformers are not only widely used in power systems, but also one of the key and expensive components. This paper studies the measurement principles and evaluation methods of uncertainty in capacity measurement of transformers. It proposes a supplement to the uncertainty evaluation method for capacity measurement of power transformers in the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM) and its application. Finally, the paper analyzes the effects of different factors on measurement uncertainty and obtains the expanded uncertainty of transformer capacity measurement. The research results are of great significance for improving the quality of transformer capacity measurement.

articleTitle: Study of Hierarchical Equalization Control Strategy Based on Reconfigurable Equalization Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Using retired power batteries to build low-cost grid energy storage, giving full play to and efficiently utilizing the residual value of retired batteries, is an important way to solve the problem of reusing a large number of retired power batteries. However, the problem of inconsistency of batteries in gradual utilization is also more obvious than that of new batteries. In this context, firstly, a hierarchical equalization topology based on reconfigurable battery pack is proposed, which increases the equalization path and improves the equalization speed; secondly, based on this topology, a hierarchical equalization control strategy for variable operating conditions is proposed, which considers two levels of equalization control within and between battery packs. Within the group, SOC and terminal voltage are used as balance variables, and cell state balance is achieved through reconstruction. SOC is used as balance variable between groups, and battery modules with different loss levels are fully utilized through reconstruction to ensure the balance of the entire battery cluster.

articleTitle: Wiring scheme design of power supply system in remote areas
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the environment, the power system does not extend to most remote areas, and the power supply also restricts the development of remote areas. In this paper, This paper designs the power supply system according to the attributes and characteristics of remote areas. Firstly, the natural geographical conditions and daily electricity demand of users in remote areas are summarized, and the hypothetical power supply scenarios in this paper are proposed. Then, the analytic hierarchy method is applied to the site selection design of the power supply system, and the design principles and methods of power supply system wiring are given. Finally, according to the proposed design principles, the scheme design is carried out qualitatively and quantitatively, and the best wiring scheme of the power supply system of the scenario is obtained.

articleTitle: Economic Research on User-Side Photovoltaic Energy Storage System Considering Shared Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Based on the background of photovoltaic development in the whole county and the demand for energy storage on the user-side, this paper establishes an economic evaluation model of user-side photovoltaic energy storage system considering shared energy storage. Firstly, three schemes of no energy storage, independent energy storage and shared energy storage are proposed, and the influence of photovoltaic energy storage system loss on annual power generation is considered. Secondly, based on the whole life cycle theory, the cost and benefit model of the user-side photovoltaic energy storage system is established, and the unit electricity cost of the user is used as the evaluation index. Finally, the relevant data of user in Hubei area are analyzed as an example to verify the effectiveness of the model and provide reference for the investment of related projects.

Author Keywords: the unit electricity cost of the user

articleTitle: Multi-type Peak Shaving Resource Coordination Optimization Method Considering Carbon Emission Difference
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To fully tap the operational potential of different types of peak shaving resources and solve the problem that deep peak shaving measures such as coal power increase the total carbon emissions of the power grid, a coordinated optimization method of multi-type peak shaving resources considering carbon emissions differences was proposed. The main feature of this method is to realize the coordination and optimization of peak shaving resources by analyzing the difference of carbon emissions of different peak shaving resources. According to the carbon emission change characteristics during peak shaving response, peak shaving resources are divided into two categories: low carbon emission peak shaving resources and high carbon emission peak shaving resources. A multi-type peak shaving resource coordination optimization model based on two-tier architecture is proposed, which is classified according to the above peak shaving resources. Low carbon emission peak shaving resources will be preferentially invoked in the most economical way in the upper model. The remaining peak shaving demand will be met by high carbon emission peak shaving resources. The system economy, carbon emission and other aspects are comprehensively considered in the lower model. Finally, a numerical example based on the actual data of a provincial power grid was constructed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The numerical example results show that compared with the traditional peak shaving resource optimization method, the proposed method can reduce the comprehensive cost by 5% and improve the overall efficiency of power grid operation.

Author Keywords: low carbon emission peak shaving resources
high carbon emission peak shaving resources

articleTitle: Coil Optimization using Metaheuristic Techniques for Wireless Charging of Electric Vehicles - A Comparative Analysis.
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) used for charging of electric vehicles (EVs), suffers from the problem of misalignment. In this paper metaheuristic optimizing techniques are used to increase the misalignment tolerance of the receiver coil. This is done by optimizing the length of each turn of the transmitter coil such that a uniform magnetic field density is produced over the charging area, which is kept 26% higher than the transmitting coil area which further aids to accommodate misalignment of the receiver coil. Differential Evolution (DE), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) optimization algorithms are used to obtain the lengths of all the turns of the transmitter coil. These algorithms are also compared by varying the number of turns while keeping the number of iterations to a fixed value.

articleTitle: Research on the Pricing Mechanism of Wheeling Cost Considering Network Channel Occupation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The implementation of market-based distributed generation trading is beneficial for promoting the nearby consumption of renewable energy, and reducing the electricity costs of users to a certain extent. Checking and ratifying the wheeling cost is an important prerequisite for market-based trading of distributed generation. A method for calculating wheeling cost is proposed based on the principle of “who uses, who bears” and evaluating the permitted revenue of power grid enterprises by voltage grade, while considering the use of electrical resource, which is also called network channel, by both parties to market-based distributed generation trading. It helps traditional users and market-oriented transaction users share the permitted revenue of power grid enterprises reasonably and reduce the cost of market-oriented transaction users.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Optimization Design for Grid-Forming Converters with Dead Time Damping Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The LC-type filter is generally adopted in grid-forming converters, which would introduce a high-frequency resonance to the inner control loop, further resulting in the stability issue. However, the traditional stability analysis and control parameter design for the inner control loop of grid-forming converters ignored the dead time, which can provide the damping effects for the filter resonance. In this paper, the model of the inner control loop consisting of a capacitor voltage loop and a filter inductor current damping loop is first presented with the dead time considered. Then, according to the stability analysis, a control parameter optimization method is proposed to provide accurate quantitative stability design. Finally, the simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of stability analysis and the proposed design method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Computing Resource Allocation of Edge Nodes in the Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of the power Internet of Things, the edge computing terminal is a key node in the cloud edge fusion system that supports the deep perception and efficient processing of massive heterogeneous information. In order to solve the problem of resource allocation, we establish a new energy grid cloud edge collaborative optimal scheduling model based on edge computing. Firstly, we propose a computing resource allocation method for edge computing terminals of the power Internet of Things. The application scenario of the edge computing terminal studied is the periodic business oriented to distribution network stations. The effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper was verified through the simulation of periodic services in the power IoT distribution station area.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Power Control of Wind Turbines Based on SBCL Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With more wind power integration to the modern power system, the performance of the wind turbine is increasingly important. Firstly, the wind turbine, inverter, and generator of the permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) are modeled separately, and the current prediction model of the inverter is derived. Based on this, a power prediction model is constructed, and a new single boundary circle limited model predictive power control strategy (SBCL-MPC) is proposed. To ensure power tracking performance, the voltage vector that allows the power error to enter the boundary circle as quickly as possible is selected. The proposed strategy does not require complicated coordinate transformations, and it can reduce the average switching frequency of the inverter while ensuring satisfactory power tracking. Finally, simulation analysis is conducted to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Impact of PV Access on Distribution Network Node Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to cope with the shortage of traditional energy and the environmental problems brought by it, the proportion of renewable energy represented by photovoltaic has gradually increased in recent years. However, due to its particularity, photovoltaic is greatly affected by the environment, and its output power has randomness, volatility and uncertainty. A large number of photovoltaic connected to the grid will impact the voltage of each node of the distribution network, causing voltage flicker or fluctuation. Therefore, it is necessary to study the voltage distribution of photovoltaic nodes after grid connection. In this paper, the feeder model of distribution network is established first, and the influence law of grid-connected position and grid-connected capacity on the voltage of distribution network nodes is studied respectively in the case of single photovoltaic and multi-photovoltaic grid-connected. Secondly, a simulation model was built by Opendss to verify the above rules, and the relationship between environmental factors and voltage of each node was analyzed.

articleTitle: Charging Strategy for Electric Vehicle Aggregator Based on Master-Slave Game Based on Gravitational Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Electric vehicles are loads of the smart grid, which plays a role in demand side management. Its demand changes with changes in electricity prices. The aggregator plays a role in the charging management of the community. It can aggregate the charging curve of electric vehicles, so as to better plan the charging strategy and achieve optimization. Aggregators' pricing and charging strategies interact with EV charging characteristics. This paper establishes a game model to model the maximization of the interests of the aggregator and the car owner, and obtain the equilibrium point of the electric vehicle and the aggregator. This model can also provide reference for demand-side response.

articleTitle: Medium-term Load Forecasting Based on Singular Spectrum Analysis and Improved Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Accurately predicting the magnitude of non-smooth and non-linear loads is important for good network operation and maintenance, reasonable design of startup and shutdown schedules, and ensuring safe and stable operation of the power system. A load decomposition prediction method based on singular spectrum analysis and an improved neural network is proposed. Considering the cyclic characteristics of the medium-term load, the trend and period series of the load sequence are extracted by HP filtering and singular spectrum decomposition; further, each sub-series of the decomposition is predicted by the Elman neural network model optimized by the PSO algorithm; finally, the results of each sub-series are superimposed as the final load prediction result. The results of the prediction analysis combined with the data provided by a numerical modelling competition show that the method has a high prediction accuracy for medium-term load prediction.

articleTitle: Risk Probability Assessment Method of Distribution Network with Integration of High-Proportion of Distributed Photovoltaic via Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To accurately evaluate the impact of integration of high proportion distributed photovoltaic on distribution network, a risk probability assessment method of distribution network is proposed via Monte Carlo simulation. Firstly, distributed photovoltaic output data from a county is processed to remove irrelevant information, and representative typical scenarios are generated by k-means clustering via Beta distribution. Then, representative probability models are selected for conducting Monte Carlo simulation. Afterwards, the probabilistic power flow is calculated. Voltage limit risk index, voltage deviation index and network loss index are established to achieve probabilistic assessment of high proportion distributed photovoltaic integration in distribution networks. Finally, multi-scenario and multi-time period comparative analysis is conducted on an improved IEEE33 node system. As the proportion of distributed photovoltaic integration increases, the risk of voltage violations and high network losses during evening hours increases sharply. Overall, the period of highest operational risk remains noon.

articleTitle: Regional Division Based on Smart Terminals and Localization Method of Power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Modern distribution networks are large-scale, structurally complex and interconnected, a comprehensive distribution automation system is required to monitor, manage and protect the distribution network. This paper focuses on the centralized fault interval localization based on topological structure classification. Based on traditional matrix operations, the improved algorithm divides different blocks according to the different connection relationships of the distribution network, the problems of large computational complexity and fault location blind zones in traditional fault localization is solved. The accuracy and efficiency of fault location are both improved in the regional division process. The corresponding diagrams of the distribution network are presented to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and clarify the scope of application.

articleTitle: Total Harmonic Distortion Reduction Method of Improved Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control for Single-Phase Inverter with Twisted Parameter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The single-phase inverter is a commonly used DC/AC converter in the industrial field. Due to its fast dynamic performance and the ability to handle multiple constraints, Finite Control Set-Model Predictive Control (FCS-MPC) is capable of effectively tracking the current of single-phase inverters. However, the implementation of FCS-MPC is characterized by high computational demand, time delay, and a requirement for high model accuracy. In order to address these challenges, this study proposes a twisted parameter FCS-MPC method that artificially twists the model parameters. This method aims to reduce Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) as compared to the one-step delay compensation FCS-MPC. By ensuring accurate tracking of the single-phase inverter, this method can effectively save computational time. The study utilizes simulations to uncover the impact of model parameters on the THD of the grid current. It is discovered that reducing the control parameters of inductance can lead to a reduction in THD of the current. The simulation results demonstrate that, within a certain range, reducing the control parameters of inductance can effectively enhance the quality of the grid current without an increase in the number of switch operations. Furthermore, this method outperforms the delay compensation method by offering a lower computational burden, smaller prediction error, and lower switch loss.

articleTitle: Identification of Cascading Failure Critical Lines in the Dynamic Zero-sum Game of DC Transmission System Based on Bias Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As wind power penetration and DC operation expand, the power grid’s operation characteristics become increasingly complicated. The research on identifying critical lines of Cascading failure in wind power DC transmission networks is extremely useful in preventing power grid outages. To identify key lines, five indexes were developed: average load rate, weighted power flow transfer entropy, short-circuit ratio of wind power access ratio, transient voltage variation level of wind power gathering point, and effectively short-circuit ratio of operational reactive power. This study used the bias correlation approach and the bias relation number between the five indexes and load loss to demonstrate that all five indices may indicate Cascading failures. Demonstrate the usefulness of the five indicators. Finally, the weighing is realized using the dynamic zero-sum game in conjunction with the upgraded AHP scale expansion analytic Hierarchy process and EVM entropy weight technique. Given the influence factor that the management and adjustment of the power system itself may avoid the growth of the Cascading failure in the power system’s development process, the weight is more consistent with the power system’s development trend.

articleTitle: Distribution Service Fault Recovery Leveraging Cooperative Operation of Multiple Customer Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With wide penetration of distributed renewable generations, many customer-owned microgrids exist in the distribution system. When a fault occurs in the distribution feeder, it is a practical to leverage the cooperative operation of these customer-owned microgrids to maintain the electric service for users in non-faulted feeder section before the fault is cleared or the feeder section be switched to different power supply. This paper puts forward a service recovery strategy through coordination between Distribution Management System and Microgrid Energy Management System in the transitional stage before the complete recovery of the fault, fully utilize the distributed generation capacity within the microgrids to provide electric services to nearby customers, achieving the goal of minimizing load losses.

articleTitle: Study on Full Bridge LLC Resonant Converter Based on LADRC in Marine DC Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the use of a full bridge LLC resonant converter with linear active disturbance rejection control to improve the power density, conversion efficiency, and voltage regulation rate of marine DC power supply. To balance the design difficulty and accuracy of the LADRC scheme, the system order is reduced from three to two. The design process for third-order line expansion state observer and linear state error feedback is also derived. Meanwhile, the LESO's stability is evaluated by investigating the convergence of the observational error. To verify the effectiveness of the LADRC scheme, Simulations and experiments are conducted in the paper, the results demonstrated that the marine dc power achieves faster transient response speed and smaller output ripple when using the LADRC scheme instead of a PI controller.

articleTitle: Anti-misoperation Method of Substation Switching Operation Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of smart grid and the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of power grid, higher requirements are put forward for the security and intelligence of the anti-misoperation cloud system. Based on the knowledge graph, this paper proposes an anti-misoperation method for switching operation applicable to the anti-misoperation cloud system. In this paper, the authentication of the handheld terminal system, the encryption of the terminal communication, and the management of the operation ticket with the method of multiple digital signatures are used to ensure that the operation ticket is legal, compliant, and complete in content. Finally, the knowledge graph is used to perform anti-misoperation verification of the operation ticket. It is helpful to reduce the workload of operators and help to better manage the operation ticket.

articleTitle: Research on Recommended Technology of Power Transformer Disposal Case based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: When the transformer is in a critical state, it is difficult to adapt to the increasing time-variability and complexity of the power grid operation mode in the era of big data by relying only on the traditional way of manually handling faults based on dispatching management procedures. The application of knowledge graph in transformer fault handling can help break through the restrictions of manual decision-making. Based on the manual experience accumulated for many years in the maintenance and operation of transformers in the power grid and the text data such as maintenance records, defect records and power grid operation procedures, this paper extracts the valuable information from the above data into knowledge elements, and proposes a knowledge graph for transformer fault disposal. The recommendation algorithm based on knowledge graph is adopted in this paper, and introduces the five-dimensional characteristic quantity of transformer state into the calculation of case similarity. Under the condition that the transformer state and fault information are highly similar when the fault occurs, the push function of transformer fault solution is realized, which provides business support for the intelligent decision-making requirements of equipment monitoring.

articleTitle: Analysis of Short-circuit Faults in the AC Protection Zone of VSC-HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Voltage Source Converter based High Voltage Direct Current Transmission (VSC-HVDC) technology has many advantages such as low line loss and low harmonic content, which is widely used in scenarios such as large-scale new energy consumption and high-capacity transmission. The most serious fault in the AC protection zone of VSC-HVDC system is a three-phase short-circuit fault. If a three-phase AC short-circuit fault in a large-capacity DC transmission system is not dealt with in time, it will affect the power transmission in the whole regional grid. In this paper, the electromagnetic transient characteristics of the most severe three-phase short-circuit faults in the AC region of high-voltage high-capacity VSC-HVDC systems are analysed based on modular multilevel converters (MMC). In addition, a model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the short-circuit fault characteristics.

articleTitle: Short Term Power Load Forecasting Method Based on VMD-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The load of a region is often influenced by multiple factors, resulting in strong nonlinearity and temporal characteristics of load data, which increases the difficulty of accurately predicting load. To improve the accuracy of power load forecasting, this paper proposes a short-term power load forecasting method based on VMD-ResNet. Firstly, at the data level, the Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) method is used to decompose historical loads and temperatures to obtain a more stable Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF). Then, different IMFs are integrated and input into the first stage prediction model along with seasonal and holiday information to extract internal features of the data for preliminary prediction; The second stage is a Deep Residual Network (ResNet) that uses the forecast data from the first stage as input to predict the load over the next 24 hours. The data adopts real load data from Panama City from January 2015 to June 2020. The average absolute percentage error (MAPE) of the VMD-ResNet load forecasting model is 1.3%. Compared with load forecasting networks such as SVR, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, ResNet, etc., the MAPE of the test set has decreased by 2.36%, 1.8%, 1.2%, and 0.8%, respectively. Experiments have shown that VMD-ResNet can deeply mine data characteristics and has good predictive performance.

articleTitle: Co-optimization of Midterm and Short-Term Maintenance Scheduling with Large-Scale Wind Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Maintenance scheduling is the safety and reliability guarantee of power system. Since the scale wind generation in power system increases rapidly, the volatility and uncertainty of the wind generation output should be considered in maintenance scheduling. This paper proposes a co-optimization model of midterm maintenance and short-term security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) considering large-scale wind energy integration. The maintenance model includes generation unit maintenance and transmission line maintenance scheduling and the uncertainty of wind energy is considered by multi-scenario method. Both economy and reliability of system operation are considered in the proposed model so that the objective of the model is minimizing the total cost including the penalty cost of load shedding and wind curtailment. The problem is solved by surrogate Lagrangian relaxation method. A 6-bus system is used to perform detailed case analysis and a modified 118-bus system is used to verify the generality of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Power Coordinated Control of PMSG-WTG Based on Power Flow Calculation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Considering the uncertainty about the power flow in the distribution network, a power coordinated control strategy for permanent magnet synchronous generator-wind turbine generation (PMSG-WTG) is proposed. The strategy is based on the real-time power flow analysis of the distribution network to coordinately control the output of PMSG-WTG, and then achieve to optimize the power flow in the distribution. First, the real-time power flow calculation is carried out to obtain the distribution of power flow in the distribution network. According to the current power flow state, the system will reasonably dispatch PMSG-WTG to accomplish the power coordinated response. Secondly, the optimal power flow (OPF) calculation is carried out to obtain the optimal power allocation for the PMSG-WTG, and the optimal power flow of the distribution network is efficiently solved based on Dung Beetle Optimization (DBO) algorithm. Then PMSG-WTG will accurately track the optimal allocated power by using repetitive control, and the optimal power output of the system is achieved. The experiment results show that the dynamic power coordination between PMSG-WTG and the distribution network is realized through the strategy. The power losses of the distribution network are effectively reduced, and the bus voltages are stabilized.

articleTitle: Three Methods to Simulate Transformer Zero-sequence Impedance with Ansys Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The zero sequence impedance of transformer is one of the important parameters of power system, which is used to calculate the zero sequence component of short circuit current under single-phase grounding fault. The zero-sequence impedance of transformer is mainly affected by core structure and connection group, so it is difficult to calculate the Zero-sequence impedance accurately by analytical method. The finite element model of zero sequence impedance of an YNyn0d11 3phase 3-leg transformer is established in Ansys Maxwell, and three calculation methods of zero sequence impedance, namely voltammetry method, energy method and inductance matrix method, are studied. The simulation results are consistent with the test data, which verifies the correctness of the three simulation methods. Based on the simulation model, the influence of the oil tank or magnetic shield on the zero-sequence impedance is also studied.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Modeling Method for Large-scale Grid Based on BPA-ADPSS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Large-scale AC/DC power grid has put forward high requirements on the scale and modeling efficiency of electromagnetic transient simulation, but the traditional manual modeling method cannot meet the requirements of large-scale grid electromagnetic transient simulation. Aiming at the key technologies of automatic modeling such as component data conversion, automatic topology layout and accuracy checking, an automatic modeling method is proposed to convert BPA data from electromechanical transient simulation into electromagnetic transient model of ADPSS, and corresponding software is developed. The software has been successfully applied to a provincial power grid modeling, and the generated electromagnetic transient model has a high conversion accuracy, fully meets the requirements of real-time electromagnetic transient simulation, and provides effective technical support for large-scale power grid electromagnetic modeling.

articleTitle: Interruption Characteristics of Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker Based on Intelligent Mechanical Branch
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In response to the increase in voltage level (>1500V) in photovoltaic power systems, a self-triggering hybrid DC circuit breaker is proposed to accommodate the fault interruption at higher voltage level. This circuit breaker utilizes the arc voltage generated by mechanical switch interruption to reach the conduction voltage of IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) for commutation purposes. In order to reduce the fault current value flowing through the IGBT, the current detection device is connected in series with the mechanical switch branch to realize the rapid rise of the arc voltage at double times of the rated current, facilitating earlier conduction of the IGBT for commutation. As a result, the peak current in the transfer branch is effectively reduced, allowing for a decrease in the specifications and quantity of IGBTs used and avoiding current and voltage imbalance issues caused by the parallel connection of multiple IGBTs. The proposed hybrid DC circuit breaker based on intelligent mechanical branch provides research and design approach for better adaptation of hybrid DC circuit breakers to fault interruptions at high voltage levels.

articleTitle: Simulation of Hydroelectric Black Start Test in Inner Mongolia Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Based on PSCAD, the general hydropower black start test system model of Inner Mongolia power grid is built. The power flow and dynamic simulation are carried out for the processes of generator charging idle-load line, charging idle-load transformer, high-power motor startup of thermal power plant and grid connection of thermal power units. Based on the simulation results, the generator self-excitation, switching over-voltage of charging idle-load line, ferroresonant overvoltage of charging idle-load transformer, voltage and frequency fluctuations caused by starting load are analyzed. Finally, it is concluded that unit 3 of Wanjiazhai hydropower station operates in isolated network mode, can maintain the frequency stability of the test system under low load conditions, and has strong under-excitation capacity, which can be used as the black start power supply of inner mongolia power grid. During black start, the unit did not have self excitation, and the bus voltage of each station did not exceed the specified limit. The initial load of thermal power unit shall be cancelled to avoid large fluctuation of system frequency after grid connection.

articleTitle: A Method of Interval Prediction of Boundary Power Between Transmission and Distribution Based on Quantile Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to predict the interactive power of transmission and distribution boundary after a large number of distributed generators appear on the distribution network side, this paper proposes an interval prediction method of transmission and distribution interactive power based on quantile regression. Based on the initial cause of physical characteristics that include factors of temperature, light, wind speed and other weather information of distributed renewable power generation output are closely related, and the net load on the distribution network side is closely related to temperature, so a quantile regression model for the interactive power of the transmission and distribution boundary is established by taking temperature, light, wind speed as independent variables, taking advantage of the advantages that quantile regression is not sensitive to abnormal points, and taking the interactive active power of the transmission and distribution boundary as dependent variable, The historical real data is taken as the training set and test set of samples, and the quantile with the smallest error, prediction interval and confidence degree are determined according to the sample test set. The prediction interval can considers the volatility of various random factors on the distribution network side, thus reserving space for various randomized factors not considered. The simulation results of the example show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has higher accuracy compared to other algorithms when dealing with distribution networks containing multiple distributed power sources. It is more effective in dealing with the influence of various random factors when dealing with distribution networks containing multiple distributed power sources, and has obvious advantages, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Load Forecasting of Charging Stations Based on Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Load forecasting is an important service for the reliable operation and effective management of the smart grid. To achieve this goal, we analyze the load characteristics of the electric vehicle charging station according to the actual charging power and weather forecast data of electric vehicle charging stations, and propose a load forecasting method of charging stations based on support vector regression, which can enhance the scalability and robustness compared with classical regression models. We evaluate our model with several simulation examples from real data. Experimental results indicate that the proposed model can obtain higher performances than existing models for load forecasting.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Arc Motion and Electrode Erosion Behavior of MCCB
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper presents a platform for electrode erosion diagnosis of a low-voltage molded-case circuit breaker based on in-situ optical diagnostics. The platform enables rapid in-situ measurements of the droplet splashing erosion behavior during electrode arcing. Using this platform, the splashing erosion behavior of the electrode under different arcing currents and with different polarities are studied. Additionally, the motion of the arc under different operating conditions is observed and analyzed. The findings of this work contribute to understanding the motion of the arc root and the splashing erosion characteristics of the electrode during the circuit breaker opening process, providing reference for predicting breaker interrupting performance and optimizing the design of the contact system.

articleTitle: Research on Vulnerability Analysis Method of Power System under Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The deep integration of power system and information system forms a power cyber-physical system. While improving the controllability and observability of the power system, the possibility of cyber attacks is also greatly increased. Therefore, it is of great significance to analyze the vulnerability of power cyber-physical systems under cyber attacks. Firstly, in this paper, based on the complex network theory, a three-layer power cyber-physical system coupling model is established considering the power network, communication network and information network. Secondly, the propagation mechanism of cascading faults across space and the protection and control strategy to suppress cascading faults of the power cyber-physical system are analyzed. furthermore, the vulnerability analysis model of the system under two typical network attacks of circuit breaker tripping without fault and load redistribution attack is proposed, and the quantitative analysis of network attack vulnerability of electric power cyber-physical system is realized. Finally, The power cyber-physical system is constructed by using IEEE9 node system simulation, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Power Quality Assessment Method Based on Unsupervised Learning Ideas
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the structural reform of China’s power system, a large number of new energy sources have been connected to the existing power grid causing impact on the power grid, resulting in a decrease in the stability of the power grid. A more scientific method of comprehensive power quality assessment is needed, and this paper proposes a comprehensive power quality assessment model based on unsupervised learning ideas to eliminate the influence of subjective weights on the comprehensive evaluation results. Firstly, the data characteristics of the power quality indicators are analyzed by factor analysis, and then the main factor analysis method is used to extract the comprehensive evaluation indicators, and the K-means clustering method is used to classify them, and finally the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to complete the comprehensive evaluation of power quality. The feasibility of the method is verified by taking the test data of three substations in Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province as an example.

articleTitle: Full Electromagnetic TransientFine Modeling and Characteristics Study of AC/DC Hybrid Power Grid with High Ratio of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The rapid development of renewable energy and ultra-high voltage AC/DC hybrid power grids has put forward higher requirements for simulation accuracy. Only by accurately simulating the characteristics of renewable energy and DC in the power grid, the response of the power grid to faults cant be accurately reflected. In the past, digital simulations of large-scale power grids were limited by the ability of simulation tools, and renewable energy sources engineering models rarely used or did not use, resulting in simulation accuracy issues. This article proposes an engineering fine modeling method for renewable energy and DC systems. Based on the characteristics of engineering fine modeling for renewable energy and DC systems, and relying on the ADPSS rapid modeling tool, a full electromagnetic transient modeling method for large-scale AC DC hybrid power grids containing high proportion of renewable energy is studied, which solves the problem of difficult modeling for renewable energy and DC systems. Finally, the proposed full electromagnetic transient fast modeling method for AC/DC hybrid power grid with high proportion of renewable energy was applied to construct an electromagnetic transient model for a high proportion of renewable energy transmission system. The influence of DC faults and different outputs of renewable energy on the overvoltage of the transmission end power grid was studied, and the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method were verified, this provides a more accurate simulation method for further in-depth research on the interaction between renewable energy and AC/DC in large-scale power grids.

articleTitle: Equilibrium Analysis of Electricity-Carbon Markets Considering Bounded Rationality
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The power system currently generates a lot of carbon emissions. As an emerging markets player, prosumer can aggregate distributed renewable energy and reduce the volatility of renewable energy while effectively reducing the carbon emissions of the markets. Existing literature has studied the operation mode of prosumer participating in electricity-carbon markets. However, the bounded rationality of prosumer has a certain influence on the equilibrium of electricity-carbon markets, which is rarely studied. In view of the above knowledge gap, this paper explores the impact of bounded rationality on user consumption. First, we construct the bounded rational model of prosumer, and then we study the operation mode of prosumer participating in electricity-carbon markets. Finally, we solve the system model through the equilibrium algorithm. Case studies based on IEEE30 node verify the correctness of the electricity-carbon markets considering bounded rationality model.

articleTitle: Study on Distributed Uninterruptible Power Source in Ultra-deep Mine
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Ultra-deep mining is an effective way to solve the exhaustion of shallow mineral resources and obtain more available mineral resources. It is an inexorable trend of mining development in China and the world. However, the harsh environment, difficult maintenance and complicated mine tunnel of ultra-deep mine may lead to instability or interruption of power supply, and it is difficult to find out the actual fault location. These will pose a nonnegligible risk to personnel and communication network. In this paper, we first analyze the advantages and disadvantages of representative power supply schemes, and then realize the Distributed Uninterruptible Power Source (DUPS) which based on lithium-ion battery packs and modular design. This DUPS drives the data delivery and the connected detective equipment, thus making environmental information gleaned for run time decisions of ultra-deep mine.

articleTitle: Power Line Partial Discharge Detection Using Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, due to the widespread access of distributed power supply, the topology of electrical network becomes more and more complex such that it is difficult to analyze the fault causes of transmission lines, and partial discharge (PD) is a type of failure that often occurs. An automated transmission lines PD detection system requires automated feature extraction and online identification of PD. Firstly, A PD detection method based on multi-scale one dimensional convolutional neural network (MS-Conv1D) is proposed in this paper, which takes an arbitrary-long time series of fault signals as input. Furthermore, the single-phase and three-phase electrical signals can be dealt with an unified structure of neural network. Secondly, a complete flow of training MS-Conv1D and data processing is given. Finally, simulations on a real PD dataset shows that the detection accuracy of MS-Conv1D reaches 90% with 20MHz sampling rate, and the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) points indicate the robustness of MS-Conv1D at different frequencies.

articleTitle: Theoretical Mismatch Degree Calculation of PV Array by Traversal Cell-Based Short-Circuit Characteristic Fault Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Photovoltaic array consists of three levels, i.e., cell, module and array. Cell and its topology are the essential characteristics of array. For permanent cell-based faults, it is a scientific problem for academic and engineering applications whether PV arrays can be diagnosed by the degree of array power mismatch, that is, the deviation between actual output and theoretical output. Based on the generic fault cell model and the cell-based characteristic fault topology model which we proposed earlier, the simplest battery cell short-circuit fault scenario is discussed. Firstly, a power mismatch degree traversal calculation method based on the generic fault cell model and the cell-based characteristic fault topology model is proposed. Then, a theoretical power calculation model based on 2C cell model and short-circuit cell characteristic topology is proposed to quickly realize the total power output and array power mismatch degree of each topology. Finally, the theoretical calculation results are analyzed in detail, and some rules are found, which is convenient for topology diagnosis of short-circuit fault based on array power mismatch degree.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation of DP of Insulating Paper by NIRS Based on Negative Correlation Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The introduction of NIR spectroscopy for accurate and nondestructive aging condition assessment of insulating paper has important engineering application values. At present, neural network is the mainstream method to establish the correlation model between NIR spectra and the degree of polymerization (DP), but it has the problems of random weights and susceptible to local optimum, and its accuracy and generalization ability are poor in field applications. This paper proposes a neural network integration strategy based on negative correlation learning (NCL) to achieve weak correlation coupling of multiple sub-neural networks, which adding correlation penalty in the cost function to enhance the feature information diversity of neural network integration and improve the model accuracy and generalization ability. The results show that: the appropriate number of sub-neural networks and correlation penalty coefficients can utilize the maximum advantages of negative correlation integration when modeling; compared with a single neural network, negative correlation neural network integration (NCNN) has higher accuracy (RMSE =74.1, MRE=8.0%), it can be used as an alternative method to neural networks for a more precise model.

articleTitle: Statistical Inference Model for Gas Discharge Tube Excited by Pulse Based on Poisson Process
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Equipment at radio frequency front-end would be vulnerable excited by electromagnetic pulse. Consequently, the statistical inference model is needed for vulnerability assessment. Effect test is usually carried out to study the statistical characteristics of the equipment excited by pulse. Limited by experimental conditions, effect test cannot include pulses with different characteristics. In this article, a statistical inference model is proposed based on the ‘threshold’ effect test. The model considers the statistical characteristics of vulnerability is reflected by time delay of effect occurrence. Through derivation, the time delay obeys Weibull distribution and the scale parameter is related to the applied electromagnetic pulse. The model calculates the parameters based on two sets of test results and infers the statistical characteristics of time delay under pulses of other waveforms. Meanwhile, the latent variable is proposed and it is convenient to assess the vulnerability of equipment excited by pulse. The effect test for gas discharge tubes (GDTs) is carried out, the results are consistent with the statistical inference by the proposed model. The model can infer the vulnerability of equipment excited by waveforms of different amplitudes, based on two waveform effect test results.

articleTitle: Power System Load Restoration Based on Data-Driven Constraints Linearization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, power outages have occurred frequently around the world, and rapid load recovery after power outages can reduce economic losses caused by power outages. In the restoration model, the power flow calculation is a nonlinear equality constraint. The idea based on mathematical optimization is to linearize the power flow equation based on certain assumptions or perform convex relaxation. Such processing may affect the solution accuracy or speed. Therefore, a data-driven constraints linearization method is proposed, using a large amount of simulation data to linearly fit the power flow through the partial least square method. Then, based on the linear constraints, the load restoration problem is established as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem to reduce the difficulty of solving, improve calculation accuracy and provide dispatchers with optimal recovery decisions. Finally, the validity of the method proposed in this paper is verified in IEEE39 node system.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Grid Connected Stability Based on Decoupled Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To improve the dynamic frequency support and transient voltage stability of weakly connected systems after grid connection in distributed photovoltaic power plants with complex non-linearities, the decoupled current component control and integrated energy storage chain-type graded voltage inverter-type static reactive power generator (STATCOM-BESS) is now deployed in photovoltaic power plants on a large scale due to its fast response to power fluctuations in the two-dimensional operating space. At the same time, additional damping control based on the STATCOM-BESS double-loop classical direct power decoupling control structure can smooth out the power oscillations of the system. In this context, the study of STATCOM-BESS with an additional auto disturbance rejection controller based on particle swarm optimization (PSO-ADRC) for PV plants improves the stability of large grid-connected systems. stability. Firstly, a controller with adaptive discrimination of nonlinear disturbance factors is analysed, and then the STATCOM-BESS power loop additional control is combined with damping torque analysis to derive an enhanced dynamic stability strategy and design a particle swarm-ADRC. The effect of damping oscillations of a graded voltage inverter type STATCOM-BESS additional controller with direct power decoupling control structure is verified.

articleTitle: Energy-Saving Practice of Variable Frequency Drive Technology in Data Center HVAC System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The variable-frequency drive technology (VFD) can modify the motor speed or torque by varying the frequency and voltage of the AC motor input power according to the load demand as a way to save energy. To analyse the energy saving effect of variable-frequency drive technology applied to data centre heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, this paper applies VFD technology to data centre fluorine pump-compressor composite air conditioning systems, implements monitoring and analysis of the operational energy efficiency of this system before and after retrofit, and combines the actual application of this technology. The findings indicate that the VFD technology can substantially reduce the number of compressor starts and stops, reduce the compressor start-up inrush current, and improve the power system’s stability. Furthermore, utilising this technology, the HVAC system can effectively synchronise with the load and fluctuations in outdoor temperature and humidity, resulting in accurate temperature regulation and optimal utilisation of outdoor cooling resources. This approach can lead to significant energy conservation of up to 42.95% when compared to extreme hot and cold weather conditions. The findings of the study indicate that the utilisation of VFD technology exhibits commendable adaptability and yields favourable outcomes in regions with varying temperature ranges. The minimum PUE value recorded was 1.228.

articleTitle: Market-Based Power Scale Calculation under Liberalization of Power Generation and Consumption Plans
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: At present, the construction of China’s electricity market is still in its infancy, and the dual-track operation of planning and market will last for a long time. To explore the market liberalization scale under the dual-track system, it is necessary to study the calculation method of the medium-and-long-term trading power liberalization scale considering the grid operation constraints. Based on this, this paper constructs a market-based electricity optimization model that considers economic benefits and grid operation constraints. Then, a provincial power grid in China is used to simulate and calculate, and the corresponding analysis is given.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Compressed Sensing Technology Considering Complex Electrical Quantity Signals in Agricultural Grid System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the network congestion problem caused by high-frequency information interaction in the agricultural network system and meet the needs of the current consolidation and upgrading of the agricultural network, this paper improves the traditional LZ77 compression algorithm, statistically encodes the output results of the LZ77 compression algorithm through Huffman, and compresses the data based on the hybrid algorithm of dictionary and statistics. The results show that the LZ77-Huffman compression algorithm can effectively compress the electrical quantity information in the process of information interaction in the typical power consumption scenario of the agricultural grid, and alleviate the network congestion problem of the agricultural grid system caused by massive information interaction.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Return Power in Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this paper, a dual phase shift control strategy is presented to suppress the high return power generated by dual active bridge DC-DC converters under single phase shift modulation methods. Firstly, the mathematical model of output power and return power based on double phase shift control is established, and the mathematical relationship between return power and shift ratio and input/output voltage regulation ratio is deduced, and a dual phase shift reflux power optimization control strategy with the goal of minimizing reflux power is given, and a comparative analysis is conducted between the optimization strategy and the reflux power curve under single phase shift control, and a detailed optimization control algorithms and system control plans is provided. Finally, a simulation and experimental platform is built to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the optimal control strategy for reflux power provided.

articleTitle: Method for Predicting Equivalent Ice Thickness of Tension Towers without Angle Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The icing of transmission lines can cause the accidents of line broken and tower collapse, which seriously affect the safe operation of the power grid. Accurate monitoring of icing conditions for transmission lines has important engineering significance and application value. Based on the static model of the comprehensive load of the transmission line, a simplified equivalent ice thickness prediction method is proposed in this paper. Compared with the traditional methods, the proposed method does not require angle sensors, hence avoids the degradation of prediction performance caused by angle sensor errors, and reduces the hardware cost of the system. The results show that if the change in the overhang angle after icing is small, the prediction error of the proposed simplified method is within the engineering allowable range.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Based Active Power Control of Wind Turbines to Mitigate the Thrust Force
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of wind power into the power system, it is urgent for wind turbines to have the active power control capability. However, achieving the active power control goal through passive speed variation (PSV) will increase the tower fatigue load. This paper reveals the mechanism of the frequent and large fluctuations in the thrust force caused by the rotor speed control (RSC), during the start-up stage of pitch angle regulation from the perspectives of pitch adjustment amount and sensitivity. The attention should be paid to the pitch adjustment amount during the start-up stage, to address the problem of excessive pitch adjustment due to overactive PI regulation. Hence, the model predictive control (MPC) based APC methods is proposed for better coordination between pitch angle adjustment amount and rotor speed limit objectives. The result shows that MPC can effectively reduce the adjustment amount during the start-up stage, and achieve the goal of suppressing the tower fatigue load.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suggestions on the Architecture of New Distribution System IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The new power distribution system is an important part of building a new power system and promoting the realization of the “double carbon” goal. The massive access of distributed power generation, distributed energy storage and new load makes the distribution system appear new features such as diversified power supply, interactive power consumption, electronic power, intelligent equipment and digital management. The industrial control technology system supports the current real-time and low-frequency local acquisition of the main network and the distribution network, but with the access of massive equipment, it gradually fails to meet the perception requirements. This paper analyzes the architecture of the Internet of Things applicable to the new distribution system based on the technical path of the State Grid, China Southern Power Grid and related enterprises, and integrates cloud computing, high-speed network communication, network security, big data processing and other technical applications, It has the features of supporting massive terminal device access, device self-description supporting plug and play, terminal batch remote operation and maintenance, and flexible business expansion, and can effectively support million-level concurrent and million-level terminal access and management.

articleTitle: Research on Three-phase Line Loss Improvement Algorithm for Low-voltage Distribution Network with Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiency of the existing calculation method of three-phase line loss in low voltage transformer area, a new calculation method with distributed photovoltaic generation is proposed. According to the inverter type, two types of distributed photovoltaic generation were modeled, and the conversion scheme of PI and PV nodes to PQ nodes was established. The initial value of the Newton-Raphson method is calculated by the forward-back generation method, and the Jacobi matrix is modified by the gradient descent method to calculate the line loss by phase, which improves the accuracy and the speed of the calculation effectively. Finally, the data collected in a low-voltage transformer area, are used as an example to calculate the three-phase line loss using the improved algorithm, and the convergence and accuracy of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling of Power Transmission System Connected to Offshore Wind Farm Considering Typhoon Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale development of wind power resources, the installed capacity of offshore wind power increases rapidly. Due to climate and other factors, typhoon disasters occur frequently. Considering that the wind speed is influenced by the typhoon, the offshore wind power output is highly uncertain. Besides, the typhoon may lead to physical failure of the power transmission equipment and endanger the reliable operation of the power transmission system. Therefore, it is necessary to assess the reliability of power transmission system connected to offshore wind farms affected by typhoon. The model proposed in this paper adopts the hierarchical structure of wind turbine, wind farm, direct current(DC) transmission equipment and DC transmission system. Considering the effect of typhoon on wind speed, failure rate of equipment and overhead transmission lines, the multi-state model of each module is established based on the Markov process. The system states are combined by the available capacity of the wind farm and the available capacity of the DC transmission system. In order to effectively quantify the impact of typhoon on the reliability of offshore wind power transmission system, a reliability index is established.

articleTitle: Research on Power System Restoration Ability Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
