abstract: Real-time evaluation of power system restoration ability helps to make power supply restoration decisions after power outages, and can also provide reference for planning and design of resilient power systems. This paper proposes a priori evaluation method of power system restoration ability to evaluate its own restoration ability, and further establishes a posteriori evaluation method of power system restoration ability considering the effect of restoration measures. In order to simulate the effect of restoration measures, a system restoration control optimization model with the aim of maximizing the expected net income is established. Finally, the IEEE 70 node example system is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cable Fault Prediction Based on RBF and LSTM Combined Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High voltage cable is an important power equipment in power system, and its operation status affects the security and reliability of power supply. Due to design defects, insulation defects will inevitably occur in the cable system. Partial discharge (PD) is not only the main cause of insulation degradation, but also an important symbol of cable insulation defects and insulation aging. In this paper, a cable fault prediction method based on RBF and LSTM combined neural network is proposed, including: obtaining the cable partial discharge fault history data as the original data, performing noise reduction processing, extracting the partial discharge characteristic data, and then performing normalization preprocessing; Initialize the super parameters (number of nodes, learning rate), weights and neuron offsets according to the sample data; The processed sample data, together with the super parameters, weights and neuron offsets, are transferred into the prediction model until the accuracy requirements are met. Compared with the traditional methods, the prediction model proposed in this paper can ensure the stability of the prediction, at the same time, it can ensure a higher accuracy, improve the intelligent degree of the power station, and ensure the stable and safe operation of the power station.

articleTitle: A New Efficient Non-coupled Bidirectional Z-source Circuit Breaker for DC Microgrid Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Semiconductor power devices are the main loss source of Z-source circuit breakers (ZSCBs). Therefore, this paper presents a new efficient non-coupled bidirectional ZSCB (Bi-ZSCB) for DC microgrid protection. The proposed Bi-ZSCB multiplexes the fault commutation branch, and optimizes the number of the power devices in the main current path, thereby reducing the on-state loss of the Bi-ZSCB. Combined with the simulation waveforms, the working principle of the Bi-ZSCB is analyzed in detail. Finally, the performance of the Bi-ZSCB is verified by small-scale hardware test-bed.

articleTitle: Research on Equivalent Modeling of Offshore Wind Farm VSC-HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Most of the existing literature studies the small disturbance oscillation problem of offshore wind farm VSC-HVDC transmission system basing on simplified models. In order to clarify the influence of equivalent modeling on oscillation analysis, this paper first reveals the decoupling characteristics among machine side (MS) offshore station, grid side (GS)-sending end (SE) onshore station, and RE (receiving end) onshore station, and proves the rationality of local subsystem analysis approach. Furthermore, for the GS-SE offshore station and RE onshore station, the feasibility of different modeling schemes is evaluated by calculating eigenvalue deviation. The result shows that when analyzing the oscillation mode of the GS-SE offshore station, MS can be simulated by constant power source, and RE can be simulated by constant voltage source. When analyzing the oscillation mode of the RE onshore station, the SE system can be simulated by constant power source under the premise of retaining the dynamic of the DC submarine cable. The theoretical analysis results are verified by time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of two DC-DC Multilevel Converters and Classic Boost Converter in Terms of Ripples and Voltage Load Overshoot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of three types of boost converters―classic boost, symmetrical multilevel boost converter, and three-level boost converter in terms of voltage and current ripple as well as the load voltage transient overshoot. The three converters are designed and simulated under the same settings in order to obtain accurate results. A DC source powers the three converters with 61.82 V. During the design phase, the output voltage and current ripples are estimated to be 1% and 30% respectively. Funding proved that among the three converters symmetrical multilevel boost converter is the only converter that respects this criterion by giving an output voltage ripple less than 0.83% and a current ripple lower than 27.7%, while the three-level boost converter gives 59.13% for input current ripple and the classic boost gives more than 4% for the voltage ripples. Furthermore, the symmetrical multilevel boost converter reduces the load transient overshoot by more than 19% and 7% compared to the three-level boost converter and the classic boost loads transient overshoots respectively. In addition, the symmetrical multilevel boost converter provides continuous output voltage and current and reduces the ripples to 0.68% and 0.44% respectively. In conclusion, a symmetrical multilevel boost converter proves a correspondence between theoretical and simulation results. Furthermore, based on its features of reducing the current and voltage ripple as well as the load transient overshoot, it is concluded that a symmetrical multilevel boost converter is more suitable for renewable energy systems applications compared to a classic boost and three-level boost converter.

articleTitle: Investigation and Correction on Transformation Angle deviation of Brushless Doubly-fed Stand-alone Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Vector control researches of brushless doubly-fed induction generator (BDFIG) highly depend on the unified-reference-frame dq model, which requires that the coordinate transformation angles and the initial rotor position angle meet the specific relation, otherwise the practical closed-loop control performances will be influenced. To meet the requirement directly, this paper first illustrated the influence of transformation angle deviation on the critical inner-loop control, and then proposed the model-reference-adaptive (MRA) transformation angle correction method for BDFIG stand-alone generation system. Based on the commonly used dual-loop controller under control-winding current orientation, the steady-state adjustable model of control-winding voltage was constructed, and then the transformation angle correction was realized based on adaptive adjustment. The simulation results verified the influence analysis, and the experimental results verified the effectiveness of the proposed angle correction method.

articleTitle: Analysis Method for Carbon Emission Sharing of New Energy Sources in Different Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the “Dual Carbon” goal is being promoted, more and more renewable energy power sources are being integrated into the power grid. Renewable energy generation itself has no carbon emissions cost, but the power delivered to users from renewable energy sources may cause changes in power loss in the grid and lead to additional carbon emission costs. Therefore, when the same user purchases electricity from renewable energy plants in different geographical locations, the resulting carbon emission costs should be reasonably shared among different renewable energy sources and load transactions. So, a principle is proposed that the carbon emission responsibility for the same load should be evenly distributed among different geographical locations of renewable energy sources and load transactions. A power loss sharing method for different electricity transactions for the same load is designed, and the ETA algorithm is used to study the precise sharing and comparative analysis of power loss caused by corresponding transaction contracts from renewable energy sources from different geographical locations for the same load demand. As a result, the carbon emission responsibility that all of the user’s electricity transaction contracts should bear is obtained. By analyzing examples, the rationality and correctness of this method have been verified.

articleTitle: Scheduling Evaluation Technology of Micro-grid based on Combination Weighting of Game Theory Under Background of Carbon Neutrality
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the context of carbon neutrality, in order to accelerate the green and low-carbon transformation process of the energy and power system, diversified equipment such as renewable energy and energy storage have been promoted and applied in the power system on a large scale. Due to the increase in elements contained in the power system, it is necessary to effectively evaluate the effectiveness and benefits of the system scheduling plan. Based on the value connotation of coordinated scheduling of micro-grid that containing renewable energy and energy storage resources, this paper establishes a corresponding comprehensive evaluation index system from three aspects: economy, environmental protection, and reliability. At the same time, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model based on subjective and objective comprehensive weighting of game theory is proposed. These works provide important references for the efficient and safe operation of micro-grid and the clean and low-carbon transformation of the energy and power industry.

articleTitle: Conditional Probability-Based Reliability Evaluation of MMCs Considering Dependency of Submodules
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in the high-voltage direct current transmission system. To ensure the safe and reliable operation of the transmission system, it is necessary to conduct the reliability evaluation of the MMC. In the previous studies, the dependent relationship among submodules (SMs) tends to be neglected, which may result in the error of the reliability modeling for the MMC. To fill this gap, combined with the conditional probability method, the reliability model of the MMC is constructed considering the dependency of SMs. First, the effect of current levels flowing through SMs on the reliability of SMs is analyzed based on the conditional probability method. Then, the reliability model of the MMC considering dependency with the hierarchical structure is established in turn. On the basis, the reliability evaluation of the MMC considering the dependent relationships among the SMs can be developed successfully, which depicts the reliability of the MMC more accurately. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in case studies.

articleTitle: Adaptive Model Predictive Control Based Frequency Regulation for Low-inertia Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Large amount of renewable energy sources affect frequency stability in microgrid (MG) This paper proposes a novel frequency regulation method based on adaptive model predictive control (AMPC) for MG system considering large disturbances to maintain the frequency stability. The MG system performance is approximated by a simplified first-order lag internal prediction model (IPM), which is applied to AMPC. Parameters of the IPM are estimated and updated by unscented Kalman filter (UKF) in real-time. Therefore, an optimal control operation can be obtained to cope with the MG system frequency problem caused by uncertainty of the disturbances, such as wind turbine (WT) power, photovoltaic (PV). An isolated MG model with high penetration of PV, WT, and battery energy storage system (BESS) is used to verify the performance of the proposed AMPC method under low inertia circumstance. The simulation results show that the proposed method has better performance than the PI controller. Moreover, AMPC including UKF can treat low inertia MG system operation without frequency instability.

articleTitle: Study of IGBT Saturation Voltage Drop Variation Under High Temperature and High Humidity Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: IGBTs (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) are widely used in many fields because of their high switching frequency and low conductive voltage drop. However, the reliability of IGBTs is easily affected by many different environmental stresses. Firstly, the causes of saturation voltage drop variation are analyzed from chip corrosion, port corrosion and bonding line corrosion. Secondly, the environmental stresses of IGBT module are simulated by establishing a high humidity high temperature reverse bias(H3TRB) platform and a power cycle test (PCT) platform in this paper. Finally, the corrosion of IGBT ports, bonding wires and chips are verified by observing the electrochemical corrosion of IGBT under high temperature and high humidity environment. The saturation voltage drop variation of IGBT module is investigated by comparing the power cycle test and the high temperature and high humidity bias test, respectively. The test results show that PCT and H3TRB exchange test have a greater effect on the saturation voltage drop, which provides guidance for the subsequent improvement of IGBT reliability.

articleTitle: A Survey of Output Characteristics and Power Optimization Technology of Photovoltaic Array in Mismatch Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Nowadays, the photovoltaic (PV) power generation technology using solar energy has been widely used. In the PV power generation system, the study on reliability covers the mismatch problem of PV array, namely the difference between the expected power output and the actual power output of PV array. In the actual application, problems such as internal aging, local shading, uneven irradiance and inter-module connection of PV array are all likely to cause the mismatch of output, resulting in reduced output power of PV array. Among them, the mismatch between PV array modules caused by local shading is the foremost factor leading to the mismatch of PV array. Therefore, in recent years, scholars at home and abroad have studied and explored various global maximum power points to solve the power multi-peak problem of photovoltaic arrays generated by the above local shadows, and achieved some remarkable results. In this paper, the mathematical model and output characteristics of PV array are introduced, the mismatch between PV array modules caused by local shading are analyzed and explained, and the optimization technology of PV array in the mismatch condition and the prospect of future research direction are summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Image Characteristics of Streamer Discharge in the Rod-plate Gap under Positive Lightning Impulse
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The quantitative features analysis of discharge image information in long air gaps can be regarded as new physical observation parameters for discharge research and be of great significance for understanding the mechanism of lightning impulse discharge. Stream discharge is the initial stage of air gap discharge, and its formation and development have a significant impact on the subsequent leader discharge process. For the deeply exploration of the image features in streamer discharge, based on the observation of the 1 m rod-plate gap discharge under the lightning impulse discharge at high altitude, EMICCD (Electron Multiplier Intensified Charge Coupled Device) discharge images with nanosecond exposure time and time interval, synchronous discharge voltage, and current were obtained through repeated discharge tests under the positive lightning impulse with the same voltage level. By analyzing the intensity characteristics of discharge light intensity images at different discharge times, the intrinsic relationship between discharge light intensity images and discharge current was discussed. The result was shown that there is a good linear relationship between the average intensity integral of streamer discharge in the rod-plate axis and its discharge current.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Test System for Large Reaction Area Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High power density is the development trend of proton exchange membrane fuel cells, and increasing the reaction area is one of the main means to achieve high power density. To systematically study the influence of temperature, equivalence ratio, relative humidity and gas back pressure on the power generation performance of proton exchange membrane fuel cells. This paper analyzes the problems in the test of large reaction area single proton exchange membrane fuel cells and builds a test system that can realize its performance test. The system is used to carry out the power generation performance of the membrane electrode, and through the sensitivity test, the best operating point of the inner membrane electrode in the test range is determined. The power generation performance of the membrane electrode assembly was tested using this system. And the optimal operating point of the membrane electrode within the test range was determined by sensitivity testing.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Pole-Mounted Fully Insulated and Visualized Low-Voltage Load Transfer Device in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In distribution network, safe, reliable and fast operation of low-voltage load transfer device plays a vital role in power supply reliability. In this paper, a new 0. 4kV pole-mounted fully insulated and visualized load transfer device (PFIVLTD) is developed, which solves the problems of conventional jumper wire device(JWD), such as high current of single-phase operation, high resistance augmentation rate at contact points, susceptibility to aging of the insulation, clamps liable to break by an external force, and high risk and inefficient operation, and it has the advantages of full insulation and visualization, safety and convenience, economy and reliability. PFIVLTD realizes the intrinsic insulation through a fully insulated and fully enclosed design and ensures the remote visualization of the state of switch through a transparent viewable window at the bottom. Three-phase linkage switch, compact spring operating mechanism, and operating handle design changed the load-transfer-way from single-phase-sequential-operate for thrice direct contact to three-phase-operate for once indirect contact, it also reduced the load transfer operation time of the overhead line from 20 minutes to 3 minutes, and improved the safety and efficiency of 0. 4kV uninterrupted operation. PFIVLTD has been applied in many places in Shanghai City, China since 2022. Engineering practice demonstrated that the new PFIVLTD effectively reduced the tripping rate of overhead line, shortened the user outage time, and enhanced the safety of load transfer operation in contrast with conventional JWD, which provides strong support for maintaining Average Service Availability Index (ASAI) of power supply reliability above 99.999% in Shanghai urban area in 2022.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Method for Identifying Behind-the-Meter PV Systems in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The integration of distributed energy resources in active distribution networks is growing, in which behind-the-meter distributed generation takes a large proportion. It is important to accurately know the capacity of these accessed distributed generators to effectively manage the operation of distribution systems. The aim of this paper is to introduce a data-driven method that employs the data obtained by smart meters to identify the behind-the-meter PV systems, while also providing an estimation of their accessed capacity. The method involves analyzing time-series data of energy consumption to identify the presence of a PV system and then statistically verifying the detected change points. Additionally, weather data is incorporated to improve the accuracy of the estimated accessed PV capacity. To validate the proposed method, a real-life dataset is used, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness, validity, and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: State of Health Estimate Method for Lithium Batteries Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Battery State of Health (SoH) estimation is critical for battery management systems, and traditional machine learning approaches face challenges in terms of prediction accuracy and robustness due to limitations in data volume and complexity in real-world application scenarios. We propose a battery SoH estimation method based on transfer learning techniques to address this issue. First, we analyzed the battery charge and discharge data and selected three highly correlated features with SoH drop. Next, we built a gated recurrent neural network (GRU) model. We trained the GRU neural network using data from many different operating conditions as the source domain data. Finally, the trained GRU model in the source domain was migrated to the target domain, where only a small amount of data was available for fine-tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed migration learning model achieves an RMSE of 0.0097, an improvement of 59.4% compared to its benchmark model. It demonstrates the effectiveness and potential of migration learning in battery health state prediction and provides an efficient SoH estimation method for battery management systems.

articleTitle: Research on Polygonal Harmonic Impedance Boundary Model for AC System and Resonant Impedance Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale power electronic devices connected to the grid, the harmonic problem has become an important concern for the power system. The sector impedance or circular impedance boundary in traditional power system will increase the range of AC system harmonic impedance, polygonal impedance has become new choice for harmonic impedance boundary construction, but the method of polygonal harmonic impedance construction is not clear. In this paper, the construction methods of different polygonal harmonic impedance are studied, the different impedance construction and the influence on harmonic evaluation are compared, polygonal impedance construction method based on the sector boundary and resonant impedance calculation method are proposed. The polygonal harmonic impedance construction method proposed in this paper can be used more accurately for harmonic evaluation and reduce the capacity of filter devices, which is great significance for harmonic management of AC power grids.

articleTitle: A Grid-Tied Virtual Synchronous Generator Transient Suppression Method Based on Lead-Lag Control in Power Loop
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generators (VSG) are considered a new generation of grid-friendly inverters due to their ability to provide inertia support to the power system. By introducing virtual inertia into the inverter control, VSG can reduce the rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) in stand-alone mode and support the frequency stability of the power system in gird-connected mode. but it changes the power model of the inverter to higher order, resulting in significant power and frequency oscillations in grid-connected mode. The existing VSG power oscillation suppression methods have limitations such as complex controller parameter tuning, altering the frequency support characteristics, and power quality degradation. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new VSG power oscillation suppression method. By adding additional lead-lag compensators to the frequency output within the VSG power control loop, two additional degrees of freedom are introduced, i.e. the zeros and poles of the closed-loop active power transfer function can be adjusted by the lead-lag coefficients. Hence, the dynamic performance of VSG can be improved and power oscillations can be suppressed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified via simulation by comparing with the traditional VSG control.

articleTitle: Electric Energy Meter Error Monitoring Model Based on Fractal Interpolation and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of error monitoring for electric energy meters, a new model based on fractal interpolation and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms is proposed. Firstly, based on the minute level active power data of the electricity meter for one day, calculate its Hurst index to identify fractal features. Then, fractal interpolation is performed on the original data, and the PSO algorithm is used to optimize the vertical scaling factor. Finally, integrate the interpolated data to obtain the integrated electricity quantity, and compare the integrated electricity quantity with the daily accumulated electricity quantity to obtain the error of the electricity meter. By comparing with polynomial interpolation and spline interpolation methods, the results show that the average error has decreased by about 0.44%, proving that the model proposed in this paper has better error monitoring performance for electricity meters.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Energy Efficiency Test Results of Coal-Fired, Biomass-Fired and Gas-Fired Boilers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The development concept of “energy saving and environmental protection” emphasizes that the efficiency of boilers is an indicator that reflects the economic benefits of industrial boilers. Therefore, we use the inverse balance method to test the energy efficiency of coal-fired, biomass and natural gas boilers, and detect the parameters that affect the thermal efficiency during their operation to ensure the accuracy of the test, so as to propose corresponding measures to achieve the purpose of “energy saving and environmental protection”. By studying the fuel analysis report, the operational thermal efficiency of different types of boilers can be calculated. In order to better evaluate the performance of these boilers, the performance of coal-fired boilers, biomass boilers and natural gas boilers is compared to find the best improvement plan.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Park Load Scenario Generation Method with Correlation Matrix and Distribution Function
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper proposes a load scenario generation method for multi-energy parks based on correlation matrix and cumulative distribution function. The method can consider the correlation of multi-energy load data in massive parks, effectively control the marginal distribution, and generate representative load scenarios. Numerical analysis results demonstrate the scenario generation results are significantly improved. The method is conducive to improving the management level of multi-energy park and promoting the development of the energy internet.

articleTitle: Power Loss Analysis of Symmetrical Multilevel Boost Converter and Three-Level Boost Converter Compared to Classic Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper investigates power losses of three boost converters-Symmetrical multilevel boost converter, three-level boost converter, and classic boost converter. The three converters are designed and simulated under the same specifications. Moreover, to ensure performance comparison, power losses are determined by referring to simulation data results and parameters of the devices provided by the manufacturer’s data sheets. The selection of each component is done based on design and simulation results. The result shows that for input power with 1041.52W, a symmetrical multilevel boost converter reduces total losses by 0.020% and 2.78% respectively compared to classic boost and three-level boost converter converters. As a result, the symmetrical multilevel boost converter provides an efficiency of 97.31% while the three-level boost converter produces an efficiency of 95.69% and the classic boost converter efficiency goes to 97.29%. The symmetrical multilevel boost converter advantages consist of providing low losses for active and passive components. Symmetrical multilevel boost converter transistors (two Mosfets) switching and conduction losses represent only 0.25 and 0.09% respectively, while the transistors losses of the classical boost converter constitute 1.08%. Similarly, in a symmetrical multilevel boost converter, the inductors $\left(\mathrm{L}_{1}, \mathrm{~L}_{2}\right)$ and capacitors $\left(C_{1}, \ldots, C_{6}\right)$ power losses decrease by 0.009% and 0.24% respectively compared to the classical boost converter. With these results, a suggestion is proposed to enhance the symmetrical multilevel topology of the boost converter’s efficiency by reducing diodes losses which consist of 82% of the total power loss.

articleTitle: Analysis Method of Dissolved Gas in Power Transformer oil Based on Fuzzy Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition accuracy and few recognizable fault types in current transformer fault diagnosis methods, this paper proposes an adaptive transformer fault diagnosis model based on fuzzy reinforcement learning and decision tree algorithm. The dissolved gas in oil analysis (DGA) is used to extract the variables that can represent the transformer status, and J48 algorithm is used to screen out eight optimal variables to achieve the goal of obtaining high classification accuracy with the least input variables. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the fault diagnosis model proposed in this paper reaches 99.7%, which is far higher than the traditional DGA fault identification algorithm, and can provide a method basis for the research of transformer fault diagnosis algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study of Time-of-Use Tariff Planning with Reduced Load Fluctuation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In response to a large number of tram loads flooding into the power system, electricity prices have become the direct cause of users’ enthusiasm changing for electricity and load fluctuations. To decrease the load fluctuation of the power system and improve the earnings of electricity without damaging the electricity cost and enthusiasm of users, this paper proposes a time-of-use electricity price planning which consider the characteristics of power system users. By analyzing the user demand characteristics and the demand curve, the demand response (DR) load and non-response load decomposition plan are formulated. Then, based on the fluctuating demand of the power grid and the income from electricity sales, a multiobjective model is established which consider the DR load characteristics, and the multi-objective optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. Finally, the day-ahea d load forecast and demand response are analyzed to form a multi-objective value-oriented Pareto solution, and the time-of-use (TOU) tariff is selected according to the grid demand. The example analysis shows that the established model can be solved with high efficiency to achieve the target of decreasing load fluctuation, no harming the interests of users, and increasing the price of electricity sales.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Community Integrated Energy System with Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the economy and energy efficiency of the community integrated energy system, an optimal scheduling model of the community integrated energy system is established considering the integrated demand response. Firstly, the framework of community integrated energy system is constructed and the corresponding equipment model is established. Secondly, a user-side flexible load model is established. An economic scheduling model is established with the objective function of minimizing the sum of outsourced energy cost, operation and maintenance cost, and demand response subsidy cost. Finally, four scenarios are set for comparative analysis. The results show that the peak-valley differences of electric, heat, and cooling loads are reduced by 37.3%, 30%, and 24%. The system daily operating cost decreases from ￥ 2340.4 to ￥ 1492.2, which verifies the reliability and superiority of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimized Modulation Strategy for Three-level Boost Converter to Reduce the Input Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The three-level boost (boost TL) converter topology can reduce the voltage stress of switches and the volume of the energy storage elements. An optimized injection ratio modulation strategy for the boost TL converter is presented to reduce the input inductor current ripple. Optimized modulation method can be divided into three types, and each type contains 8 modulation modes. It is found that the classical phase-shift modulation strategy is a special case of the proposed modulation strategy. Meanwhile, this study analyzes the quantitative link between current ripple and intermediate capacitor voltage. A simple controller with feedback linearization is briefly introduced. The experimental results demonstrate the validity of the proposed method. Besides, this modulation strategy can also be applied to other three-level converters with good scalability.

articleTitle: A Protection and Control Coordinated Strategy for MMC-VSC HVDC System with Single AC Outgoing Line
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The large-scale development and utilization of longdistance offshore wind power is one of the most mature renewable energy technologies. More and more offshore wind farms are integrated into the onshore utility network by MMC-VSC HVDC system. The onshore converter station could have one or several outgoing lines connecting to the AC network. When the onshore converter station has single AC outgoing line, the MMC-VSC HVDC system will work in the open-phase condition during the reclosing period. The conventional AC fault ride through strategy may fail and result in outage of the MMC-VSC HVDC system. In this paper, open-phase running of MMC-VSC HVDC system is analyzed and the converter control process is researched in detail. Based on the coordination between AC transmission line protection and MMC-VSC HVDC control system, a novel coordinated protection and control strategy is proposed for MMCVSC HVDC system with single AC outgoing line. Simulation model is built based on PSCAD/EMTDC in this paper. Several cases are studied to verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed coordinated protection and control strategy.

articleTitle: A Market-Based Trading Mechanism for Distributed Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The participation of distributed power supply in electricity market trading is an essential requirement for energy and market development. In the context of the spot market, this paper proposes a coordinated electricity sale model for distributed photovoltaics, which aims to minimize the cost of electricity purchase for the electricity selling company. A twoprice contract pricing mechanism is designed in this model, where the optimal decision price is based on the predicted electricity price and the settlement price is based on the actual electricity price, ensuring a balance of interests between the two agents. The proposed model provides valuable insights for distribution companies in managing and representing distributed PV generation, and promotes the effective utilization of distributed PV in the market environment.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Modeling of Large Consumers Energy Consumption Flexibility under Resource and State Task Scheduling Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in power systems, the importance of flexibility resources has become more prominent. Large consumers, as important loads in the system, have a mutual benefit relationship with multiple energy supplies, making the management of their energy consumption behavior crucial for flexible adjustments and addressing the issue of energy shortage. This paper proposes a resource and state task scheduling (RSTS) network to model the production process of different large consumers. A collaborative operation optimization model is established to describe the production load while reasonably arranging the energy consumption plan and giving the load baseline. The paper then establishes an energy flexibility model, considering cost constraints and driven by the multi-objective of energy saving and carbon reduction, to evaluate the flexible adjustment ability of large consumers in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Small and Medium-sized Pumped Storage Participation in Integrated Regional Energy Systems Considering Low-carbon Economy Objectives Two-Tier Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To address the challenges of energy consumption and carbon emissions in district-level integrated energy systems (DIES), the incorporation of small and medium-sized pumped hydro storage in system operation has been proposed as a means to optimize energy-electricity-heat dispatch, facilitate renewable energy integration, and reduce carbon emissions. This paper presents a two-tier optimization model for the integration of small- to medium-scale pumped hydro storage in district-level integrated energy systems. First, the introduction of a ladder-type carbon trading mechanism plays a carbon constraint and cost constraint role in the scheduling operation of the system, so as to realize the low-carbon economic operation of the system. Further, YALMIP/CPLEX is used to solve the two-layer optimization model iteratively, and the optimal solution is derived according to the joint optimal discriminant mechanism to satisfy the system low carbon economy objective. The analysis of the example shows that the model proposed in this paper can improve the system economy and low carbon while satisfying the system electrical heating demand.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Multi-terminal Energy Router in Flexible DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the number of new energy sources connected to the power grid continues to increase, there is a growing complexity in the way the grid operates. In order to enable flexible consumption of photovoltaic power, energy router based on DC/DC converters are used to connect photovoltaic generations to DC distribution systems. However, traditional droop control methods may lead to excessive fluctuations in DC bus voltage due to difficulties in allocating power based on the actual operating conditions of each port. To address this issue, a droop coefficient correction factor is introduced to adjust the droop coefficient based on DC bus voltage fluctuations. The initial droop coefficient value is continuously adjusted to account for changes in the power margin of the converter station, ensuring that the load status of each converter station remains at the same level after each power allocation. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified through simulation in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: An Interaction Collaborative Low-Carbon Scheduling of Multi-microgrid Distribution System with Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to promote the low-carbon development of power systems, this paper proposes an interaction collaborative low-carbon scheduling model of multi-microgrid distribution systems (MMDS) with carbon trading mechanism. In this model, a cooperative operating structure of multi-microgrid (MMG) and distribution network (DN) based on power interaction is established, in which different microgrids with different energy supplies share electricity with each other through contact lines, and each microgrid (MG) is connected to the DN in a decentralized manner to interact with it. To reduce the carbon emissions of the system, this paper adopts the carbon emission reward and punishment operation mechanism. By this means, MMG and DN can reap economic benefits in the carbon market through energy savings and emissions reductions. Finally, the numerical results show that the proposed strategy can significantly promote the comprehensive utilization of energy and make full use of its multi-energy complementarity advantages. At the same time, it can also promote the low-carbon economic operation of the MMDS.

articleTitle: Research on Improving System Stability in Photovoltaic Power Plants Based on Feed-Forward Power Decoupling Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Under the trend of new energy power system construction and green low-carbon development, photovoltaic power plants rely on a large number of power electronics to be connected to the grid, and new energy gradually replaces conventional synchronous units to pose new challenges to the stable operation of the grid. Grid-connected PV inverters present characteristics such as non-linear coupling and dynamic interaction with the grid, which bring new disturbance factors and safety and stability problems to the grid; based on the characteristics of grid-connected PV inverter power double-loop decoupling control, the anti-disturbance capability of the grid-connected system can be improved by additional control. This paper derives the mechanism of additional control to provide positive damping torque for a PV plant operating in parallel with a synchronous machine, and designs a damping control strategy for grid-connected inverters based on Feedforward power decoupling control (FPD), which smoothes out the power oscillations of the system by reasoning and adjusting the controller parameters with the damping torque coefficient method. Taking an actual operating PV plant as an example, the modeling of the PV plant integrated into a 4-machine, 2-area grid is completed based on the Digsilent platform, and the accuracy of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Cloud Edge Collaborative Scheduling Model for Power Grid with New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: After the integration of new energy into the power grid, the amount of operation and scheduling data has greatly increased, leading to an increase in the difficulty of power grid scheduling. In order to solve this problem, we establish a new energy grid cloud edge collaborative optimal scheduling model based on edge computing. Firstly, we propose a cloud edge collaborative scheduling framework for new energy grids and establish a two-level optimization scheduling model with the goal of minimizing operational scheduling costs and data transmission delays. Then, we use multi-objective ant colony algorithm to solve. Finally, we build corresponding simulation models for simulation verification. The simulation results show that the proposed cloud edge collaborative scheduling model can effectively improve the efficiency of scheduling optimization calculation and enhance the economy of new energy grid scheduling.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Network Interface for Electromechanical Model of Grid-Forming Flexible DC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Grid-forming control voltage source converters (VSCs) have good characteristics for flexible DC transmission in weakly inertial power systems. The main differences between grid-forming control and grid-following control systems lie in the form of power supply support, fault traversal switching measures, and current limiting methods. By changing the interface between the grid-forming VSC electromechanical transient model and the AC network from average power within one AC simulation time step to average voltage, it can better adapt to the characteristics of the voltage source support in grid-forming flexible DC transmission projects. In this paper, the electromechanical transient model of the typical Chinese new energy project Zhangbei Flexible DC Transmission Engineering is established using the average voltage interface. The operational characteristics of the two interfaces are compared, and the advantages of the average voltage interface are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pre-Evaluation Index System of Park Comprehensive Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The construction of IES (Integrated Energy System) is of great value in improving the economy and environmental protection of the energy system. Before the promotion and large-scale construction of Integrated Energy System, it is necessary to evaluate the resources and conditions of the park area. Firstly, by analyzing the structure of Integrated Energy System in typical parks, a new type of Integrated Energy System pre-evaluation index system is proposed. The system integrates public and policy opinions on the basis of “3E” rules, and expands the traditional index construction principle. Then, according to the characteristics of energy use in different parks, the weight setting of the evaluation algorithm is modified to improve the accuracy of the evaluation. Finally, the Integrated Energy System evaluation process and matters needing attention are presented. The Integrated Energy System construction system is improved, and the corresponding reference is provided for the promotion of the Integrated Energy System construction in our country park.

articleTitle: A DC Line Location Method Considering the Static Voltage Stability of Renewable-connected Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the growing size, complexity, and interdependence of the Chinese power system, it is imperative to further investigate and explore voltage stability analysis in modern large-scale power grids. The static voltage stability of renewable energy grid-connected systems is primarily affected by different distribution network topologies, which alter the minimum eigenvalue of the equivalent admittance matrix. This alteration manifests in two ways. Firstly, it modifies the characteristic value of the impedance matrix by adjusting the topology structure of the existing distribution network AC system. Secondly, it introduces a DC distribution line into the AC system of the distribution network, thus modifying the influence of the impedance matrix on the minimum eigenvalue. To address the aforementioned aspects, this paper proposes a targeted evaluation method to assess the impact of various distribution network topologies on the static voltage stability of renewable energy grid-connected systems. The proposed approach utilizes specific indices to select the optimal distribution network topologies that maximize the system’s static voltage stability.

articleTitle: A Voltage Dip Depth-adaptive Synchronization Stability Optimal Control Strategy for the Renewable Energy in the Distributed Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: After the large-scale integration of renewable energy into the power grid, the risk of severe synchronous instability of renewable energy under transient conditions has become an important problem in the renewable energy power system. It urgently needs to be addressed. This paper conducts related research and proposes a solution. The control proposed in this paper optimizes the traditional grid-connected control architecture method of renewable energy. It simultaneously introduces a voltage feed-forward control path and a frequency feedback control path into the active power control loop of the traditional control method. Besides, the control parameter setting is simple, and the control quantity is adaptively adjusted based on the voltage dip depth and frequency deviation after the fault. It effectively realizes the synchronization instability suppression of renewable energy by optimizing the reference value of active power of the active power loop. The proposed method has broad application value.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Based Privacy-Preserving Renewable Energy Consumption for the Local Community
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the growing demand for sustainable energy, there is an increasing need for efficient management and distribution of renewable energy resources. However, collecting and sharing energy consumption data in a centralized manner poses a significant privacy risk for individuals. To address this issue, Federated Learning can be leveraged to train a predictive model on decentralized data sources while preserving data privacy. In this approach, each participant can train a local model using their own energy consumption data and share the model updates with a central server. The central server then aggregates the updates to generate a global model, which can be used to predict energy consumption patterns for the local community. The proposed approach can enable effective management of renewable energy resources while preserving the privacy of individual energy consumption data. It has the potential to provide a sustainable solution to the growing demand for renewable energy consumption in local communities.

articleTitle: Twice Clearing Method for Hydropower Station Suitable for Intra-day and Real-time Rapid Rolling Computation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the advancement of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals”, the proportion of clean energy such as hydropower has gradually increased. Under the background of accelerating the construction of China’s power spot market, the consumption of clean energy through the market mechanism is an important direction for the development of the current power market. There are many challenges in the mechanism design and operation of hydropower participating in electricity market with strong seasonality. In this paper, the key problem of hydropower clearing modeling considering the constraints of vibration area is analyzed, and in view of the situation that the original optimization problem will become non-convex after the introduction of vibration area constraints, a twice clearing method for hydropower is constructed, which is suitable for intra-day and real-time rapid rolling computation. The hydropower output constraints of the second round of clearing are constructed through the initial allocation obtained from the first round of clearing, which simplifies the clearing model and solves the problem that the difficulty of solving the problem increases after the introduction of hydropower vibration area. Finally, a IEEE 14-bus system is simulated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-scenario Evaluation Method for High-Proportion Renewable Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The operation benefit of high proportion renewable energy power system is one of the key factors to reflect the operation level of the system. Scientific evaluation method is an important basis to measure its operation value. In order to quantitatively analyze the operation benefit of high-proportion renewable energy system with photothermal and energy storage, a system operation benefit evaluation method based on time series operation simulation is proposed. Secondly, the comprehensive benefit is divided into four parts: power generation benefit, flexibility benefit, renewable energy consumption benefit and environmental benefit, and the corresponding evaluation model is established. Finally, the corresponding indicators are calculated to evaluate the comprehensive benefits of high-proportion renewable energy power systems with photothermal and energy storage. The results show that the proposed evaluation method can effectively calculate and analyze the comprehensive benefits of various types of power sources in the system, and can provide an effective evaluation basis for the economic operation of high-proportion renewable energy power systems.

articleTitle: An Island Partition Method Based on Modified Binary PSO for New Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As new energy sources are increasingly widely accessed in active distribution networks (ADN).The high intermittency and uncertainty of its new energy power generation pose new challenges to the safe and stable restoration of power supply after the failure of the active distribution network. Therefore, This paper proposes a new method for island partition problem of new distribution networks. A model based on graph theory is established. A modified binary particle swarm optimization is used to find the optimal solution of the island partition problem, and for the purpose of quickly converging, a precoding process is added before the optimization process. An example analysis based on the US PG&E69 node distribution network system is done. The example analysis shows that this paper’s method has good stability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-Level Multi-Objective Multi-Timescale Optimal Scheduling with User Participation and Battery Banks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the uncertainty of wind power and flexible load, wind power and demand-side response prediction errors are unavoidable. In order to reduce the impact of new energy and flexible load uncertainty on the system and improve the power leveling capability of the system, this paper proposes a two-tier multi-objective multi-timescale optimal scheduling strategy considering the battery and customer participation. Firstly, a scheduling model with battery bank is constructed with the objective of minimizing daily operation cost in day-ahead scheduling; intra-day scheduling is based on day-ahead scheduling, and an intra-day rolling optimization model is built to modify the day-ahead scheduling plan through the start-stop plan of day-ahead scheduling; real-time scheduling is based on intra-day rolling scheduling, and the prediction errors of wind power and demand-side response are suppressed by the demand response based on user participation and the battery. On the other hand, the real-time scheduling is based on the intra-day rolling schedule, and the intra-day rolling schedule is modified by the prediction error of the demand response based on the user participation and the battery should suppress the wind power and demand side response. The results of the algorithm show that the proposed strategy takes into account the characteristics of different scheduling periods, different prediction errors and multiple time scales of different devices, reasonably matches the response times of different devices with multiple time scales.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Fishery-Photovoltaic Complementary Projects Based on PVsyst
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In response to the national " carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals " strategy, to achieve clean energy transformation and reduce carbon emissions, the construction and simulation of a fishery photovoltaic complementary system in the Huchang Town area of Xiantao City are carried out as an example in this paper. The fishery-solar hybrid power station uses paddy and pit resources to realize the complementary development of fishery and photovoltaic power generation without occupying agricultural, industrial and residential land, and improves the economic value of land per unit area. PVsyst software is used to design and simulate photovoltaic power plants, analyze various factors affecting power generation, and obtain the power generation and economy of photovoltaic power generation system. The simulation results show that the system has good economic, environmental and social benefits, and is worth promoting.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Electricity System Planning and Evaluation Model Considering the Costs of Electrified Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the proposal of the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, a significant impact on the safety, economy, and social benefits indicators of the high penetration of renewable energy system has occurred. In addition, the technologies for flexible resources are also gradually maturing. As a result, it triggered us to focus on the methods of power system planning that incorporate flexible resources and their associated evaluation frameworks. This paper proposes a multi-dimensional power system planning and evaluation model considering the electric carbon economic cost. Firstly, a multi-dimensional power system planning model is established considering the electric carbon economic cost. Secondly, a comprehensive evaluation framework for power system planning is proposed based on system operation, socio-economic benefits, and socio-environmental benefits. Then, the entropy weight method is used to determine the weights of the indicators. We apply the evaluation framework to planning scenarios with different technological maturity levels to compare their comprehensive benefits. These evaluation indicators can guide renewable energy generation companies and power grid planning organizations to make more rational decisions and improve the rationality of power system planning. Finally, IEEE 118-bus system is employed to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analog Circuit Fault Diagnosis Based on One-Dimensional ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increase of digitization and automation level in power plants, the development of control circuit boards has become a necessary means to maintain the normal operation of the internal electrical system in power plants. Such control circuit boards can ensure the accurate operation of the power supply system. However, research on relevant maintenance and fault diagnosis is scarce. The usual maintenance method relies on planned overhaul processes, and the replaced control circuit board is directly stored, which requires a high level of technical proficiency from the operators and leads to waste. In recent years, residual neural networks have been widely used in the field of fault diagnosis. A fault diagnosis method for control circuit boards based on one-dimensional residual neural networks is proposed. The time domain and frequency domain signals of analog circuit output are represented as one-dimensional data sequences, and the features of different fault modes are learned by residual neural network, which can effectively detect and diagnose the faults of control circuit boards.

articleTitle: Research on Partition Balancing Method for Regional Grid Power Flow Based on Day-ahead Schedule
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The unified security check of clearing results in the electricity spot market of each province is an important means to ensure the safe and stable operation of the spot market. In this article, the actual calculation network model is divided into zones based on the lines or transformers included in the inter-provincial tie-lines. Taking into account the network losses, DC system losses and plant loads, the unbalance of power generation and consumption in each province is calculated. By modifying the load forecast of each province, the balance of power generation and consumption in each province is achieved. Simulation results show that this method can ensure consistency between the calculated value and the planned value of the inter-provincial tie-lines, and improve the convergence of future power flow calculations and the accuracy of the results.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation Method of Multi-source Frequency Modulation via Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy in the power grid, it is difficult to meet the high-quality frequency modulation requirements of the power system only relying on traditional thermal power units. This paper proposes a capacity allocation method of the wind-photovoltaic-hydropower-thermal multi-source frequency modulation system based on the Stackelberg game theory. Firstly, the thermal power unit is taken as the upper leader and the wind-light-water unit is taken as the lower follower. Secondly, by solving the Stackelberg game model, the optimal frequency regulation capacity of each unit participating in frequency regulation is obtained. Then, the improved Shapley value method is used to optimize the revenue of the wind-light-water unit. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified. The Stackelberg game multi-source frequency modulation model can make the frequency modulation capacity allocation more reasonable and give consideration to the revenue.

articleTitle: Current Limiting Control Strategy of Grid-forming MMC Based on Adaptive Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the introduction of the “double carbon’’ target and the large-scale application of power electronic devices in power systems, the power grid faces problems such as reduced inertia and decreased stability. The proposed grid-forming control converter is expected to solve these problems. It can support system inertia and voltage, but it has problems such as overcurrent after failure. In this paper, a model of grid-forming control is established. By analyzing the fault characteristics of grid-forming MMC, a current limiting control strategy of adaptive virtual impedance is proposed and simulated under different fault conditions. The waveforms before and after the current limiting measures are compared respectively. The results show that the proposed current limiting control strategy can effectively solve the current limiting problem of grid-forming MMC in weak grid.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation Method of Lithium-Ion Battery Based on Multi-innovation Adaptive Robust Untraced Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to reduce the calculation amount of battery management system (BMS) and deal with the SOC estimation error caused by various noises, a multi-time scale estimation method for lithium-ion battery SOC was proposed based on the combination of multi-innovation adaptive robust untracked Kalman filter (MIARUKF) algorithm and untracked Kalman filter (UKF) algorithm. Based on the second-order RC equivalent circuit model, UKF algorithm is used to estimate the model parameters online on the macro time scale. MIARUKF algorithm estimates battery SOC on micro time scale. The algorithm uses multi-innovation vector to correct state estimate and timely updates noise covariance to improve the SOC estimation accuracy. H$\infty$ filtering algorithm is introduced to improve the robustness of the algorithm. Simulation validation is conducted under the UDDS working condition. The maximum absolute error of SOC estimation is 0.75%, and the average absolute error is 0.37%. Compared with UKF algorithm, the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Digital 3D Intelligent Forward Design for Data Centres Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Around the three-dimensional intelligent layout of assets within data centre space of different sizes, based on the function and data centre design standard GB50174-2017, the equipment is divided into multiple asset combination variables, and the vertical and horizontal coordinate position of each variable is used as the layout variable to establish the mathematical model of occupied volume, and under the conditions of satisfying each other's power consumption density, cabinet occupancy ratio, battery room occupancy ratio, power room occupancy ratio, air conditioning room occupancy ratio The mathematical model of multi-objective optimization is established by solving the single-objective optimization result values under the conditions of mutual power consumption density, cabinet occupancy ratio, battery room occupancy ratio, power supply room occupancy ratio, air conditioning room occupancy ratio, adjacent distance of area, net height, required air conditioning cooling capacity evaluation index system, deployment environment limitation and basic size, respectively. A population-based graph structure description is established and an improved ant colony algorithm is introduced to use the search direction as the solution space for the transfer probability, combined with the pheromone volatility of the deployment criteria, and solved in multiple iterations. Lightweighting and assisted computing techniques are used to achieve rapid generation of digital 3D intelligent layout solutions for data centres. Experiments show that the proposed method reduces the design workload by 95%, achieves the rapid generation of 10 optimal forward design solutions in 5 minutes, and rapidly exports 3D design models, greatly improving the design efficiency of the data centre.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Storage System in Active Distribution Network Considering Operation Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This article investigates the optimization configuration problem of an active distribution network energy storage system, considering reliability. Firstly, a calculation method is proposed for the power supply reliability index applicable to the active distribution network. Secondly, based on the above calculation method, an optimization configuration model for the active distribution network energy storage system, considering reliability, is proposed. The model comprehensively considers the reliability and economic indicators of the distribution network, with constraints including distribution network power flow, system power balance, photovoltaic output, and energy storage system operation. Finally, taking a seventeen-node distribution network as an example, the genetic algorithm is used to solve the proposed model, obtaining the optimal installation location and capacity of the energy storage system in a photovoltaic distribution system. Moreover, the impact of the simultaneous configuration of energy storage and distributed photovoltaics and the setting of sub-objective weight coefficients on the objective function is analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Prediction Method of Electric Vehicle Charging Load Based on the Fluctuation Characteristic Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: For the strong stochastic fluctuation of EV charging load, feature decomposition is an effective technical means to improve the accuracy of EV charging load prediction. However, how to effectively characterize and learn these different modes after feature decomposition is the difficulty to further improve the applicability of this technical tool in the field of EV charging load prediction. To solve this problem, an ultra-short-term EV charging load prediction model based on sample entropy modal classification is proposed. Firstly, the historical load is decomposed into several modal functions adaptively, and then the sample entropy reflecting the fluctuation characteristics is extracted for each modal function, and then the classification criteria of high and low frequency modes are determined based on the sample entropy, and then the corresponding prediction models are selected for high and low frequency modes. For the high-frequency modes with high volatility, the meteorological data that can characterize the user’s random behavior are introduced, and the BiLSTM neural network with the ability of learning oscillatory mutation information is used for prediction; for the low-frequency modes with low volatility, they are superimposed and reorganized into a new sequence, and the LSTM with the property of temporal recursive memory is used for prediction; finally, all the prediction results are summed to obtain the load prediction value. Through experimental simulation of EV charging load data in a region of the UK, the results show that the prediction model proposed in this paper, compared with the traditional prediction model based on modal decomposition, reduces the model complexity while the learning ability of the model for different modal characteristics is significantly improved, and has more advantages in the extraction ability of EV charging load volatility compared with the traditional deep learning prediction model.

articleTitle: Stability Region Estimation and Systme Strength Evaluation of MMC-HVDC Connected to a Weak AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Analyzing the stability of MMC-HVDC under large disturbances helps us to understand and improve the system’s operation under startup, load dynamics, and fault conditions. This paper analyzes the stability region of MMC-HVDC connected to a weak AC grid after large disturbances on the AC side. A direct method for estimating the stability domain and a system dynamic strength evaluation index based on critical energy are proposed, which achieves quantitative evaluation of the dynamic strength of MMC-HVDC connected to weak AC grid and compensates for the shortcomings of static indicators. The proposed approach and analysis results were verified by an MMC/AC simulation model built in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of Multi-terminal LCC-UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Ningxia-Hunan ±800 kV HVDC transmission project was approved in June 2023, marking that Multi-infeed UHVDC transmission system will be formed in Hunan Power Grid. Due to the UHVDC transmission project can only realize the power transmission of point to point, and the power conveying method of the multi-terminal HVDC (MTDC) transmission system is more flexible. Based on 2 HVDC transmission projects in Hunan province, China. This article considers three configurations of 4-terminal LCC-MTDC transmission systems, and analyzes its advantages and disadvantages. Subsequently, combined with the practical engineering parameters, a simulation model included main circuit, DC circuit breaker, and control system are established. Finally, the DC line ground fault condition, the start-up of the parallel-type mesh topology MTDC transmission system, the steady-state characteristics, the opening characteristics of DC circuit breakers are studied. This research provides theoretical basis for the subsequent MTDC transmission system that may be constructed in the Hunan province in the future. It has a certain reference value.

articleTitle: AC and DC Hybrid Power Distribution System Networking Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to effectively deal with the problem of source load uncertainty of distributed power supply and AC and DC hybrid distribution system widely connected by industrial load (metallurgical industrial park), the distribution robust optimization based on moment uncertainty is adopted to solve the problem of front-day economic scheduling in the industrial park. The network planning model of AC / DC distribution network in chemical industry considers the synchronous planning of DC line and AC line, and improves the transmission capacity of AC-DC hybrid distribution network. The transportation industry has planned an AC-DC hybrid system that enables the system to optimally adapt to all system resources, including loads and generators.

Author Keywords: The distribution is robust and optimized
A few days ago economic dispatch

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Rotating Machinery Based on Contractive Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As one of the essential equipment in the industrial production process, rotating machinery usually works in complex environments such as high temperature and heavy load. Critical components such as gears and bearings are very likely to fail. This will affect the stable operation of the entire rotating machinery. Therefore, we designed a method for diagnosing faults in rotating machinery based on contractive autoencoder in this paper. First, the loss function of the contractive autoencoder is designed. Using a lot of vibration signal fragments combined with a gradient descent algorithm to optimize network parameters. Then, slice a newly collected vibration signal. And use the trained contractive autoencoder to calculate the feature vector of each segment. Next, the feature vectors of all segments are averaged and pooled to obtain the feature vector of the vibration signal sample. Finally, the extracted feature vectors are used to train a Softmax regression classifier to achieve fault identification of key parts of rotating machinery. The experimental results show that the method in this paper can accurately and effectively diagnose motor bearing faults, which is better than traditional method.

articleTitle: Boundary Inference of Load Scenarios in Multi-energy Parks Based on Statistical Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Uncertainties of loads including but not limited to electricity, cold and heat have brought difficulties to safe and economical operation of multi-energy complementary parks. To deal with the uncertainties, system operators usually choose to set a fluctuation range for the loads based on their past experiences of operation of the system as well as their personal preferences and habits, making the fluctuation ranges, also known as uncertainty sets in optimization, less reliable and less explainable. In this paper, we proposed a method of determining uncertainty sets in multi-energy complementary parks based on statistical learning. By applying this method, the uncertainty sets can be derived more flexibly solely based on how much the safe operation of the system could be affected and the predicted values of the loads, with no need of past experiences of operation. Such advantages make the proposed method easier to be popularized and utilized in various areas and scenarios.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Minimum Uptime and Downtime Constraints Modeling for the Unit Commitment Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper examines the impact of different modeling approaches for minimum uptime and downtime constraints in safety-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) problems. Six different approaches are tested on four power generation systems with varying levels of simulated and actual data, as well as small and large-scale optimization problems. The results demonstrate that an increased number of minimum uptime and downtime constraints can hinder problem-solving effectiveness. Furthermore, significant differences in solving effectiveness are observed among the different modeling approaches, even when they have similar constraint numbers.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Master-slave Controlled AC Microgrids Based on Impedance Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: AC microgrids dominated by power electronic converters are prone to various types of oscillation problems and a comprehensive oscillation analysis of the system is required to effectively suppress and prevent them. To this end, this paper proposes an AC microgrid oscillation stability analysis method based on the frequency domain impedance network model, which can accurately reflect the oscillation characteristics of the system. Firstly, the impedance models for Vf control, PQ control and VdcIq control are established, based on which the equivalent impedance network model of the AC microgrid system is built. Secondly, a stability criterion based on determinants is established to analyse the oscillatory stability of the system. Finally, frequency scan and time domain simulation results are presented in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the modelling and oscillation stability analysis methods.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Parallel Computing Warm-start Method for Bilevel Decomposition for SCUC
