publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The Unit Commitment (UC) problem is a common power dispatching mathematical model handled by independent system operators (ISOs). Security-Constrained Unit Commitment (SCUC) problems arise when network security limits. As the number of units involved in daily operations increases and the constraints become more complex, the SCUC problem becomes larger and more difficult to solve. To overcome the challenge of solving such a large-scale MILP, we propose a bilevel decomposition method based on machine learning to rapidly solve SCUC. This method accomplishes the bilevel decomposition of hydro, thermal power, and time based on the characteristics of the problem and a substantial quantity of data learning. Multiple subproblems can be solved in parallel, and high-quality, feasible solutions for warm start or fixing variables. The results of numerical experiments indicate that our method provides more efficient solutions of higher quality than using CPLEX directly for large-scale instances.

articleTitle: Analysis of Carbon Emission Influencing Factors and Medium- and Long-term Prediction Methods for Mega Cities Based on GDIM and PSO-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the context of the dual carbon target and to support carbon neutral planning, this paper proposes a Generalized Divisia Index Method(GDIM) and improved EXtreme Gradient Boosting method based on particle swarm optimization(PSO-XGBoost) for analyzing the impact factors and medium- and long-term projections of carbon emissions in mega-cities. First, relevant data, including energy consumption, economic growth rate, electricity production and carbon emission indicators, are collected and the influence contribution is quantified by GDIM method, so as to select the influencing factors with strong correlation. Secondly, methods such as Tapio and decoupling effort model are used to analyze the decoupling trend between economic and other data and carbon emissions, and thus determine the parameter settings under multiple scenarios. Finally, the XGBoost algorithm with particle swarm optimization is used to predict the future carbon emission trends. The actual data of Tianjin, China, verifies the validity of the method and the prediction analysis of the example is carried out.

articleTitle: Gas-Electric Power Coupling Simulation Method for Integrated Energy System Based on Improved MCMC
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The construction, operation and evaluation of an integrated energy system (IES) requires a large sample of data. However, the data generated by traditional Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulation is random timing. Traditional MCMC simulation is difficult to ensure the coupling of gas and electric power data timing matching. A gas-electric IES power coupling simulation method based on improved MCMC is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the K-means method based on Dunn Validity Index is used to cluster the two-dimensional data of gas and electric energy. Secondly, two-dimensional state transfer matrix for various types of gas and electric energy is constructed, and the transfer matrix is coded in reduced dimensions. Then, Fitting the duration of the state matrix by inverse Gaussian distribution and a large amount of transition state is generated. By dimension-up coding and superimposing random fluctuation components, a large number of gas-electric power data with fluctuation characteristics of original data are generated. Finally, the coupled data simulation evaluation index is established, and a large number of actual data are used to evaluate the fitting data. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing the Configuration of Condenser in the Power Grid with Large Scale Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The ultra-high voltage AC/DC power supply system containing large-scale renewable energy will cause transient overvoltage of renewable energy and even serious accidents of chain disconnection after failure. Configuring a condenser in a renewable energy station or gathering station can effectively suppress transient overvoltage and improve the multi input short circuit ratio. In response to the optimization configuration requirements of the condenser in the sending end system, a mathematical model for transient overvoltage occurrence in the multi feed system and the mechanism for suppressing transient overvoltage by the condenser are first derived. Then, considering the investment cost of the condenser, an optimization model based on short-circuit ratio and transient voltage rise was established for the condenser. Finally, taking a certain sending end system of the North China Power Grid as an example, distributed and centralized condensers are configured on the 35kV side of the renewable energy grid connection and the 500kV side of the convergence station. The results show that, on the basis of optimal economic efficiency, configuring distributed condensers on the 35kV side of the renewable energy grid connection can effectively suppress transient overvoltage and improve the short-circuit ratio at the generator end, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: renewable energy DC sending end power grid

articleTitle: Optimal Service Recovery Modeling and Algorithm for Feeder Cluster of Urban S-SCDN after Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The Supply region of Substation Centralized Distribution Network (S-SCDN) is a new regional division of complex urban medium voltage distribution network. S-SCDN can also be divided into multiple Feeder Clusters (FC). Aiming at FC power supply restoration after fault in S-SCDN, this paper proposes a power supply restoration method considering reconfiguration optimization. At first, an optimal service recovery model is built which considering recovered load, network loss and switching operation times and constraints. Then, an ant colony algorithm is used to solve the model and search the load transfer path. Cases study has approved the method and algorithm.

articleTitle: Combined Heat and Power Optimal Scheduling of Virtual Power Plant Considering Carbon Capture and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the unique working mode of coal-fired thermal power units and wind power reverse. The peak-shaving characteristics lead to the problem of insufficient peak-shaving capacity of virtual power plants, and high carbon emissions. At present, reasonable demand response is supplemented by carbon capture technology. Carbon capture mechanism is an important means to realize flexible and low-carbon operation of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: A Survey on Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Low Carbon Benefit of Fishery Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of the photovoltaic industry, the integration of photovoltaic power generation with fisheries has emerged as a complementary approach, taking into account the abundant solar resources and fisheries resources in coastal areas. On the other hand, the fishing industry consumes a significant amount of energy and produces substantial carbon emissions. In order to reduce carbon emissions and promote the development of renewable energy, this study establishes a comprehensive assessment method for the carbon benefits of the entire fishing grid, enabling precise calculation of annual carbon emissions from the fishing grid. Furthermore, this method provides decision support for load management and dispatching in the fishing grid. By considering the carbon reduction from photovoltaic power generation and energy conservation in fisheries, and based on national/international carbon accounting standards, we discuss the comprehensive assessment method for the carbon benefits of the entire fishing grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems with P2G Two-Stage and Carbon Capture Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the energy utilization rate of integrated energy system and realize the reuse of carbon resources, the rational use of hydrogen energy and the development of carbon capture and storage technology are important measures to achieve the goal of low carbonization. In this paper, we firstly consider the refinement of P2G into two stages, electrolysis to hydrogen and hydrogen to methane, to make full use of the high energy efficiency and pollution-free characteristics of hydrogen energy, and secondly, the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> from carbon capture can be used as raw material for the methane production stage, and the generated methane can be provided to gas units to further reduce the carbon sequestration cost and gas purchase cost. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal dispatching model of P2G two-stage operation and carbon capture under the consideration of carbon trading mechanism. With the objective of minimizing the total operating cost of the integrated energy system, four scenarios are set up to verify the contribution of P2G two-stage operation and carbon capture technology to the low carbon economy. Through the analysis of arithmetic cases, the model further improves the capacity of the new energy consumption, reduces carbon emissions and lowers economic costs.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation into the Development Planning and Absorption Dynamics of New Energy in the Northern Region of Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, new energy will become the main source of incremental power in northern Hebei province, and the large-scale development of new energy may lead to difficulties in consumption or serious power wastage. This paper, based on a summary of new energy resources and installed capacity in northern Hebei province, combined with the development of regional load and the potential for new energy development, studies the planning and sequencing of new energy development. Further, it proposes key measure recommendations for adapting to the large-scale development and efficient utilization of new energy in northern Hebei province, according to power balance and consumption issues. These suggestions provide some reference for the new energy development planning in northern Hebei province.

articleTitle: Torque Characteristics Analysis for Doubly-Fed Induction Machine Based on Magnetic Field Coupling with Multiple Number-Components of Spatial Pole Pairs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The doubly-fed induction machine with fractional-slot concentrated-winding (FSCW) structure has a close number of poles and slots, and its characteristics such as low synchronous speed and modular winding structure facilitate direct drive control and maintenance of the wind power system, but the abundant harmonic magnetic field in the air gap causes torque pulsation of the machine and affects the stability of the system. To this end, the general expressions for the stator-rotor current of machine are derived for the specific number of dominant pole pairs harmonic field; the torque pulsation caused by the number of non-dominant pole pairs harmonic magnetic field is analyzed through the superposition principle of magnetomotive force (MMF); a general expression for the electromagnetic torque is derived by analyzing the variation of magnetic field energy between the stator and rotor within the machine by means of the imaginary displacement method; the electromagnetic torque of the stator-rotor three-phase winding at different axial positions is compared and analyzed using finite element simulation, theoretical calculation by the virtual displacement method and machine torque test to verify the correctness of the theory of torque characteristics of the FSCW doubly-fed induction machine.

articleTitle: Accurate Distance Measurement Method of Single-Phase Ground Fault of Power Grid Feeder with Load Division Based on Fault Secondary Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of traditional fault location method when the feeder of distribution network contains load branches, this paper proposes an accurate fault location method for single-phase grounding fault of feeder in distribution network with load branches based on fault secondary discrimination. By analyzing the feeder fault recording data, the fault point is identified twice to determine whether the fault point occurs on the load branch. According to different fault location, the voltage of the fault point is calculated by using the voltage and current of the two ends of the fault section. The voltage of the calculated fault point should be equal. The objective function of the minimum voltage difference of the fault point is written, and the fault distance x under the minimum voltage difference is obtained. The simulation model of 10KV distribution network is built on PSCAD, which verifies the accuracy of the ranging algorithm and has certain ability to resist transition resistance, which has certain engineering practice value.

articleTitle: A Health Status Evaluation Method for Gateway Device Based on Chip-Board-Device Information and Fuzzy Synthesis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The gateway is an important secondary device in a substation, and its health status can provide guidance for equipment condition maintenance and fault disposal, which is essential to ensure the safe and stable operation of the substation. However, the existing secondary equipment assessment focuses on device or board-level information and lacks an overall consideration of chip-board-device. This paper establishes a three-level device health evaluation system of chip-board-device covering the core boards of the gateway device and proposes a fuzzy comprehensive rating method. In detail, firstly, the typical structure of a gateway device is introduced. Secondly, a three-level equipment health evaluation system of chip-board-device is established. Thirdly, based on fuzzy theory, a comprehensive evaluation method of a gateway device is given. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by comparing it with examples.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Characteristics Analysis and Location Method of the AC-DC Hybrid Renewable Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The multi-terminal AC/DC hybrid distribution network is a complex system composed of many power electronic devices. Its diverse and comprehensive fault characteristics are characterized by multiple cycles and strong transients. In this paper, the characteristics and mechanisms of typical DC short-circuit faults based on modular multilevel converter (MMC) systems are studied first. In order to achieve reliable and fast location of MMC short-circuit faults, a fault location method combining network topology protection and longitudinal protection based on cosine similarity is proposed in this paper. The validity of the proposed method is verified by simulation of its MV-DC side faults.

articleTitle: Improved Distance Relay Protection Considering High Proportion of New Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Because of non-linearity and limitation control of overall new energy sources, the short-circuit current and residual voltage are reduced during a fault occurred on the line, which will become more evident in the future. Extremely, if the fault point is near start of line, the measured residual voltage at protection site is near zero. Furthermore, if error and noise of measurement is considered, the obtained impedance will be deviated by traditional distance protection method. So, an improved distance protection method is proposed. Internal potential information of equivalent generator is adopted, which is high and relatively constant. Then, the fault component of generator output is considered, which is inverse to fault distance and can be separated from the short-circuit current through an established equivalent source model. Finally, based on obtained internal potential and internal resistance and fault output component of the generator, the distance between protection site and short circuit point can be calculated. The correctness and applicability of this improved method are verified through the analysis and comparison of cases.

articleTitle: Frequency-coupling Admittance Modeling and Measurement Method of Grid-connected Inverters Considering Phase Dependence
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Impedance-based method is an effective method to analyze the interactive system stability of a grid-connected inverter and grid. The impedance/admittance modeling and measurement of the grid-connected inverter are two important parts of the impedance-based method. However, the phase dependence characteristics is not considered in the existing most admittance modeling and measurement of the grid-connected inverter, leading to challenges to the model validation and stability analysis. In this paper, the frequency-coupling admittance model of a three-phase grid-connected inverter is first established by using harmonic linearization method, which points out the phase of off-diagonal elements are dependent on the initial phase of the fundamental voltage. Then, the impact of the phase dependence characteristics on the existing frequency-coupling admittance measurement method is analyzed particularly. Furthermore, a practical and flexible measurement method that can eliminate the impact of the phase dependence and maintain the accuracy and consistency of each measurement for the frequency-coupling admittance of the grid-connected inverter is proposed. Finally, simulations verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed measurement method.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Optimization Partition Based on Improved MOPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban economy, the electricity load in cities is rapidly increasing, and the scale of the power grid is increasing day by day. At this point, the partition operation of the power grid and the mutual backup of adjacent partitions have become one of the development trends of the power grid. Therefore, this paper first considers the electrical connections within and between partitions, as well as power flow indicators on interconnection lines in different partitions, and constructs an objective function based on these two indicators; Secondly, in order to ensure the normal operation of the system, node power constraints, node voltage constraints, and power supply reliability constraints are provided. In order to solve the multi-objective optimization model mentioned above, this paper improves MOPSO (multi-objective particle swarm optimization), initializes and updates particles based on the adjacency matrix related to the network structure, and discretize the update strategy to make it suitable for power grid partition. Finally, an example analysis was conducted on an IEEE 39-node system to verify the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Functional Transformation of Coal-fired Power Unit and Revenue Compensation Mechanism Considering Inertia Support
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To control carbon emissions, countries around the world have proposed more aggressive decommissioning plans for coal-fired power unit. Large-scale decommissioning of coal-fired power units is not only a waste of resources, but also leads to a decline in the overall stability of the power system. This paper studies the functional transformation of coal-fired power units to maintain the system inertia level. It is verified that the transformed coal-fired power unit can maintain operation by obtaining income from inertial auxiliary services. In the article, the impact of the topological relationship of the power system is analyzed, and the main considerations for the selection of coal power units for functional transformation are summarized. Then comprehensively consider the inertia auxiliary service, carbon emission quota trading, electricity revenue and unit operating cost to design the revenue compensation mechanism. Finally, through the analysis of the revenue after the functional transformation of the unit, it is shown that the revenue compensation mechanism in this paper has the ability to stimulate the transformation of the coal-fired power unit and actively reduce the output.

Author Keywords: functional Transformation of coal-fired power unit

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Source Frequency Regulation Strategies Based on the Stackelberg Game and Deep Adaptive Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increase of new energy penetration in the power grid, the traditional frequency regulation of thermal power units can no longer meet the power quality demand. To this end, a multi-source frequency regulation strategy based on the Stackelberg game deep adaptive dynamic programming (SDADP) is proposed. First, three long short-term memory neural network structures of the adaptive dynamic programming model are used to sequentially predict, evaluate, and execute actions to output the total frequency regulation power command. Then, based on Stackelberg game theory, the power allocation among frequency regulation sources is optimized. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed multi-source frequency regulation strategy is verified by case analysis. Compared with the traditional frequency regulation method, the proposed SDADP multi-source frequency regulation strategy can effectively reduce the area control error and frequency deviation, and improve the economic benefits of frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Research on the control of multi-conditions energy storage plant based on cuckoo algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Energy storage technology can provide a variety of services for grid operation, such as peak regulation, frequency regulation, standby, startup, demand response, etc. However, considering that energy storage plants operate under multiple operating conditions, the peak regulation and valley filling of the power grid are unstable, and it is impossible to take into account the charging and discharging depth of energy storage plants and the decay of energy storage battery life and its capacity, so the original single charging and discharging control method can hardly meet the demand. The paper proposes an improved strategy of cuckoo algorithm for multiple operating conditions, and proves through experimental results that after considering the multi-operating conditions control strategy, the optimal configuration can be made by integrating all the operating conditions of the energy storage plant and the characteristics of the grid tide, which is superior to the actual operation of the original energy storage plant.

articleTitle: Economic Optimal Scheduling of Electricity-Hydrogen Coupled Virtual Power Plant Considering Stochastic Flexibility Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Faced with the problem of managing a large number of decentralized distributed energy resources (DERs), the electricity-hydrogen coupled virtual power plant (VPP) is introduced to aggregate DERs and meet the peak load demand. In this paper, the stochastic flexibility of DERs has been evaluated with a combined model and data-driven solution, fully considering the uncertainty of power generation and energy demand of DERs. Furthermore, an opportunity-constrained economic optimal scheduling model considering the benefits and risks is developed for the electricity-hydrogen coupled VPP to participate in the hydrogen energy market and peak regulation market simultaneously. Finally, the operating power of DERs under different confidence is analyzed. Comparative studies have validated the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed methodology on economic performance and renewable accommodation of the electricity-hydrogen coupled VPP.

articleTitle: Dynamic Aggregation Optimization of Multiple Power Sources in Virtual Power Plant Based on Improved Cuckoo Algorithm Considering Conditional Value at Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The uncertainty of renewable energy output and market electricity price of virtual power plants, such as wind and solar energy, will lead to certain risks in its income. Reasonable allocation of the capacity of wind, photovoltaic, energy storage and conventional units of virtual power plants can reduce system costs and maximize the interests of investors. With the minimum investment and operation costs as the optimization goal, conditional risk value is used as the indicator of risk measurement, A dynamic aggregation optimization model of multiple power sources in virtual power plants based on risk measurement in portfolio theory is established. On this basis, the influence of risk preference on the planning of multiple power sources aggregation optimization in virtual power plants is discussed, and the improved cuckoo algorithm is used to solve the optimization model. Finally, the correctness of the model is verified by an example simulation. The results show that when the manager of the virtual power plant chooses the appropriate risk preference, the dynamic aggregation model of multiple power sources of the virtual power plant can effectively reduce the risk loss of the virtual power plant and improve the stability of the power supply of the virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Abnormal Grounding Current in Converter Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The online monitoring device for transformer core and clamp grounding current can accurately monitor the changes in grounding current of the core and clamp, and timely and effectively detect whether there are multiple grounding situations and other abnormal conditions in the transformer core and clamp. It has been widely used in the power system and gradually replaces the manual inspection of transformer core and clamp grounding current. However, after the installation and operation of such online monitoring devices in the converter station, it was found that there were problems such as unreasonable design and incomplete performance testing plans. This article, by measuring and analyzing the grounding current waveform of the converter transformer core and clamp, identifies the reasons for the abnormal measurement results of the grounding current online monitoring devices for the iron core and clamp during the installation and operation of the converter, and proposes corresponding measures, A higher precision harmonic detection technology and laboratory performance detection method have been proposed at the same time.

articleTitle: Fast Tracking Method of Inertial Constant Based on System Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of quantitative inertia evaluation of new energy electric power system, the system inertia constant tracking method based on system identification is studied. The method is divided into two categories: non-recursive algorithm and recursive algorithm. From the perspective of identification principle, the difference and internal relationship between the two in terms of calculation storage and identification speed are analyzed. The IEEE typical system is used to compare and verify the experimental examples. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the recursive algorithm has high identification accuracy, stable identification results and fast identification speed. It is suitable for the identification objects with large number of nodes and complex structure, which is conducive to the real-time monitoring and fast perception of the inertia constant of the new energy power system.

Author Keywords: electric power system, inertia constant, system identification, quantitative evaluation, non-recursive algorithm

articleTitle: New-Type Power System Risk Assisted Decision Considering New Energy Uncertainty and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of new energy sources such as wind power in the new-type power system, its uncertainty brings great risk to the dispatching and operation of the power grid, so this paper proposes a risk assisted decision model considering new energy uncertainty and demand response (DR). In this paper, the wind curtailment risk index and load shedding risk index are obtained from the new energy probability distribution information, and two kinds of DR mechanisms are introduced. Considering the day-ahead and intra-day collaborative control, a two-stage robust optimization model is established, which is solved by piecewise linear and C&CG algorithm. The case of IEEE 39 buses system shows that the proposed risk assisted decision model can effectively balance the economy and security of the new-type power system, and the introduction of DR also enhances the flexibility of dispatching and ensures the reliable consumption of new energy.

articleTitle: A Review of Photovoltaic Power Scenario Generation in the Context of Fishery-photovoltaic Complementarity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the advancement of the renewable energy transition, the innovative concept of fishery-photovoltaic complementarity, which is clean, efficient, and low-carbon, has gradually gained attention from the public. Photovoltaic (PV) power generation plays a significant role in achieving the “dual carbon” goals. However, the stochastic and uncontrollable nature of weather variables presents strong uncertainty in PV power generation, making it crucial to better analyze the uncertainties in PV output. Scenario generation, as one commonly used method for analyzing uncertainties in new energy generation, holds broad application prospects in the field of new energy generation. Therefore, this paper provides a systematic exposition of existing research methods for power system scenario generation. The methods for generating new energy scenarios are categorized into two types: explicit methods and implicit methods. Furthermore, we discuss the particularities of PV systems of fishery-solar complementarity, emphasizing the significant role played by weather factors. Finally, we summarize the findings of this paper and provide an outlook on future research directions.

articleTitle: Investigation on Coupled Environmental Heat-Humidity Regulation Technology with Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The development of new energy and intelligent power grids promotes the system integration and assembly of modular construction of outdoor power stations and equipment. In this article, numerical simulation has been used to establish a three-dimensional flow-thermal-humidity coupling model for full-size prefabricated integrated power equipment and to analyze the distribution characteristics of ambient temperature, relative humidity, and flow field during equipment operation; and to compare the performance of lateral air supply and overhead air supply solutions on ambient thermal-humidity coupling regulation. As the results show, temperature is the main influencing factor of relative humidity. Overhead air delivery makes the temperature and relative humidity of the environment more uniformly distributed, and the system dehumidification performance is optimal when the outlet air speed is 1.5m/s. The results of the article provide support and reference for the optimal design of temperature control and moisture control for outdoor integrated power equipment.

articleTitle: Probability Prediction Method for Assessing Cascading Faults in Power Systems during Magnetic Storms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: When a strong magnetic storm occurs, the reactive power compensation device becomes overloaded, resulting in reduced transformer load capacity and bus voltage drop. These conditions can trigger cascading failures, potentially leading to a complete collapse of the power grid. This paper introduces a probability prediction method for assessing cascading faults in power systems during magnetic storms. To address this issue, our proposed method combines the calculation of Geomagnetically Induced Current and transformer reactive power loss, considering various intensities of geomagnetic storm events. We also incorporate the transformer load capacity model under Geomagnetically Induced Current influence, along with the probabilities of transformer aging failure and accidental shutdown faults. By obtaining the initial fault probability of the transformer, we employ the Matlab and PowerWorld Simulator platforms to analyze the probability of state transitions across all levels of faults within the system. Furthermore, we utilize a Markov process to simulate the system's response in extreme scenarios, enabling the prediction of cascading fault development trends. Finally, we validate our development model and method using the GIC Benchmark model, demonstrating their feasibility and effectiveness. This approach aims to prevent the occurrence of cascading faults, reduce system risks, and enhance the power supply capacity of the overall power system.

articleTitle: A Data-model-driven Modeling Approach for Grid Connected Doubly Fed Induction Generator System Using Trajectory Piecewise Linearization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Wind farm integrated system has been an effective method of delivering renewable energy. However, owing to the stochastic operating mode and disturbances applied to the system, it is essential to know the operating trajectory properties after disturbances. Therefore, this paper implements a data-model-driven modeling approach to develop an order-reduced model appropriate for capturing the nonlinear properties of the operating trajectory after disturbance. Firstly, the modeling of a grid-connected doubly fed induction generator is built in great detail. And then, the method based on trajectory piecewise linearization generates three trajectories from a specific steady operation point with three disturbances to build a reduced-order model. Comparing the original, linearized model and the reduced order model’s simulation results demonstrate that the approach can capture the nonlinear system’s transient dynamics accurately and effectively. This will be beneficial for future controller design under different operating points.

articleTitle: Optimization of Virtual Power Plant Aggregation Strategy Considering Adjustable Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the proportion of clean energy connected to the grid gradually increases, virtual power plants (VPPs) that can help the grid to bridge the gap between supply and demand for electricity in the market have ushered in a boom. However, the overall economic benefits and regulation efficiency of VPPs are closely related to the response characteristics of the adjustable loads it aggregates. Still, the response characteristics of various adjustable loads vary greatly, and the existing research is minimal. In this paper, a revenue-cost analysis model is constructed based on the large electricity consumers with adjustable capacity in VPP scheduling, such as electric vehicle charging piles, oversized and heavy industry, and small and medium-sized industrial and commercial enterprises, which can quantitatively evaluate the impact of response methods, response capabilities and response costs on the overall revenue of different aggregate objects according to the characteristics of these target aggregates. Taking the trading situation of a spot market in Shanxi Province in August 2022 as an example, the impact of different response objects on the overall revenue of VPP is quantitatively analyzed by scenario, and the model’s effectiveness is verified. It provides good guiding significance and theoretical support for VPP operation decision-makers to improve the overall operating income by optimizing aggregation strategies.

articleTitle: Current Status of Research on Factors Causing Lithium-ion Battery Packs Performance Degradation and their State of Health Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: A lithium-ion battery pack is mainly made up of battery cells, battery management system, connector, thermal cooling system and other components. Among them, battery cell is the most fundamental unit of a battery pack, while a battery management system (BMS) is responsible for monitoring and managing the charging-discharging process of a battery pack. Estimating State of health (SOH) is a key component of a BMS. As it is affected by many factors, it is a great challenge to estimate the SOH of a whole battery pack. Reasons causing lithium-ion battery packs performance degradation and approaches to estimating their SOH are summarized, based on reading and collating related literature at home and abroad in recent years. Finally, an outlook on the future research direction is put forward after an overall comparison of the characteristics and shortcomings of different estimation approaches.

articleTitle: A Sizing Configuration and Integration Location Selection for Mobile Energy Storage Based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the rapid development of power distribution network, large-scale distributed generation and random loads are integrated into distribution network, and the low-voltage network is facing increasingly complex problems such as highpower loss, high or low voltage fluctuation, and power failure risks. To address these issues, mobile energy storage vehicles are adopted gradually. How to determine the capacity configuration and integration location of mobile energy storage vehicles seriously affects cost-effectiveness, power quality, and line loss. In response to this issue, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed with the objectives of minimizing network loss rate, minimizing the operating cost of single batch mobile energy storage vehicles, and maximizing the benefits of distributed power consumption, in the scenario of dynamic capacity expansion and distributed power consumption in low-voltage distribution networks. Based on the NSGA-II algorithm, the mobile energy storage capacity and grid connection position were optimized and solved, achieving multi-objective optimization for the participation of mobile energy storage vehicles in low-voltage substation governance while ensuring power supply quality. The proposed method was simulated and validated in a real distribution network in a certain substation area, and the results of test cases show that the proposed method has good effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Online Auxiliary Decision-Making Technology for New Energy Off-Grid Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, the security and stability characteristics of the power grid are becoming more and more complex. Aiming at the problem of wind turbine cascading disconnection after fault, the main work is to increase a large number of reactive power compensation devices, but there is a lack of online decision support technology to suppress wind turbine cascading disconnection in the actual operation of the power grid. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an online auxiliary decision-making method based on the off-grid timing characteristics to suppress the cascading off-grid of wind turbines. According to the off-grid reasons of key wind turbines, the control performance indexes of various measures to suppress cascading off-grid are calculated, and effective control measures are selected. After sorting, enumerate and combine to generate decision plans, and find the plan that has the lowest control cost and meets the requirements. Finally, taking a wind power base in Northwest China as an example, the optimal decision and the worst decision selected by the auxiliary decision are compared, and the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified. The problem of decision selection in suppressing wind power cascading off-grid is solved, which provides a way of thinking for future wind farm fault prevention research.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Planning of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Considering Users’ Willingness to Participate in Orderly Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of electric vehicle (EV) user scale, the impacts of user charging behavior on distribution network operation and electric vehicle charging station (EVCS) capacity planning are becoming increasingly prominent. By evaluating the orderly charging willingness of EV users, the charging behaviors can be analyzed and predicted more accurately, so as to build EVCSs with more reasonable capacities. Therefore, based on the charging data of EV users, this paper establishes an assessment system for orderly charging willingness, the EV charging behavior model is also built on this basis, and then the optimal capacity planning model of charging stations considering EV users’ willingness to participate in orderly charging is obtained. The regular polygon approximation method is used to transform the proposed model into a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Finally, based on a real urban area with geo-distribution network coupling system, the comparative analysis and sensitivity analysis are performed for proposed planning method in this paper. The results show that this method can take into account the rationality of charging station capacity planning and the safety and economy of distribution network operation.

articleTitle: Power Grid Peak Shaving Strategy Considering Electric Vehicle Carbon Trading and Hybrid Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To fully mobilize the potential of EVs (electric vehicle) to participate in power grid peak shaving, leverage demand-side flexibility to reduce carbon emissions, and mitigate peak loads generated by grid-connected charging of EV, we proposed a grid peak shaving strategy considering EV carbon trading and hybrid demand response. Firstly, we use Monte Carlo method to simulate the load of the disorderly charging mode of EVs. Secondly, we establish a demand response strategy that combines pricing and incentives, as well as a carbon trading mechanism for both EV users and load aggregators. Using the baseline method to allocate the carbon emission share of the system free of charge. Finally, we establish an optimal operation model for EV charging system that aims for the lowest load fluctuation index of power grid, the highest economic benefit of load aggregator and the lowest equivalent carbon emissions. The proposed model is validated across four typical scenarios. Simulation results demonstrate that the joint scheduling strategy can not only effectively reduce the carbon emissions of the system, shave gird peak load while fill the valley, but also boost the net income of the Electric Power Aggregator (EPA).

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Strategy of High-speed Railway Station Considering Air Conditioning Refinement Model and Integrating Mechanisms of Green Card and Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High speed railway stations have a large number of electrical equipment and high energy consumption, with air conditioning accounting for 80% of the total load of high-speed railway stations. Therefore, studying the optimization scheduling strategy of high-speed railway stations based on the refined air conditioning model plays an important role in energy conservation and emission reduction. Firstly, under the consideration of passenger comfort and various influencing factors, establish a refined air conditioning model that can accurately describe the actual power operation behavior, and further construct a high-speed rail station optical storage and charging system model; Then, based on the introduction of green certificates and tiered carbon trading models, a fusion mechanism between green certificates and carbon trading markets based on conversion coefficients is proposed; Finally, design an economic optimization scheduling strategy for high-speed railway stations with the goal of minimizing the total cost of system operation. Based on the actual data of a high-speed railway station, a numerical simulation was conducted and multiple scenarios were set up. The results showed that the refined model can better describe the actual operation process of air conditioning. The proposed strategy effectively consumes green electricity while improving the system’s operational economy.

Author Keywords: green card and carbon trading integration mechanism

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method of Microgrid Considering Distributed Photovoltaics and Hydrogen Production Station
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: At present, China has issued a number of policies to promote the construction of distributed photovoltaic, photovoltaic installed capacity increased significantly. However, the microgrid with a large number of distributed photovoltaics faces a series of problems such as voltage violation and line overload, and its photovoltaic absorption capacity is severely limited. Considering the application advantages of hydrogen energy, the use of local hydrogen production plants and micro-grid collaborative optimization scheduling can solve problems while responding to national energy transformation policies and committing to carbon neutrality. This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for microgrids with distributed photovoltaic and local hydrogen production station, and an example is designed for the scenario proposed in this paper, and the example is used to verify the effectiveness of the scheduling method.

articleTitle: Considerations of Distributed Photovoltaic Trading Mechanisms in the Participation of Frequency Modulation Ancillary Services Market
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the increasing environmental problems, a trading mechanism of distributed photovoltaic participating in frequency modulation auxiliary services is proposed. Firstly, according to the characteristics of distributed photovoltaic, the conditions of its participation in frequency modulation are determined. Secondly, the market mechanism of distributed PV participating in FM is put forward. Two trading targets of FM capacity and FM mileage are considered, and the price is adjusted. The reliability index of distributed PV is introduced, and the trading process and clearing model of FM market are given. A two-system compensation mechanism is adopted, including capacity compensation considering opportunity cost and mileage compensation considering frequency modulation performance index, and frequency modulation cost is shared by users. Finally, an example is given to verify the validity of the proposed transaction mechanism.

articleTitle: The Method to Generate the Scenario of Offshore Wind Power Output under the Influence of Typhoon Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of effective generation of offshore wind power output scenarios under the influence of uncertain typhoon weather, this paper proposes a short-term output scenario generation method of offshore wind power based on improved auxiliary classification generative adversarial network. Firstly, Pearson correlation coefficient is used to analyze the correlation between wind power output and meteorological characteristics, and the original data set of output related characteristics under the influence of typhoon weather is constructed. Then, combined with the characteristics of the deviation of the output curve shape with the influence of typhoon timing during typhoon weather, a wind power output clustering method based on improved k-means clustering is proposed to obtain a labeled data set. Aiming at the imbalance of wind power output data under different typhoon effects, an auxiliary classification generative adversarial network with Wasserstein distance as the discriminator loss function is introduced to enhance the data and generate a labeled output data set. The label discrimination is performed on the predicted value of wind power output during the influence of typhoon, and the similar output scene set is obtained by similarity screening. Finally, taking the output scenario of an offshore wind farm during typhoon weather as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation, which provides a reference for the uncertainty quantification of wind power output and the optimization of power system planning and operation under complex offshore conditions.

articleTitle: Coordinated and Optimal Scheduling Method of Energy Storage Power Station and Concentrated Solar Power Based on Improving New Energy Consumption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to cope with the peaking pressure on the system brought by large-scale new energy access to the grid and to improve the new energy consumption capacity, this paper proposes a coordinated and optimal scheduling method of energy storage power station and concentrated solar power (CSP) based on improving the new energy consumption capacity. Firstly, the working principle and operation characteristics of electrochemical energy storage power stations and CSP are analyzed, and the mechanism of their coordination for new energy consumption is revealed. Then, a model of coordinated optimal dispatch of energy storage power stations and CSP is established, taking into account the system economy and new energy consumption rate, and the model is solved by a particle swarm algorithm with a variable weight factor. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Review of Transient Overvoltage in UHVDC transmission Sending-End System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: When ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) is used for external wind power transmission, typical ACIDC faults in the transmission sending-end system may cause transient overvoltage problems. In severe cases, it can cause wind turbines disconnected from the grid, endangering the stable operation of the power grid and hindering DC transmission, thereby restricting wind power consumption. The characteristics research and overvoltage control of transient overvoltage problems in this system are summarized from four aspects: two typical transient voltage response characteristics and their mechanisms, simulation and quantitative analysis methods, relevant standards for transient overvoltage, and response strategy design. Starting from recent wind turbine disconnection accidents, the voltage response characteristics and influencing factors are sorted out. Analyzed the formation mechanisms of two types of transient overvoltage: from low to high and short-term jump, and reviewed the methods of transient overvoltage quantification and simulation modeling analysis. Elaborated on the development process of relevant standards and specifications, while also exploring the issue of insufficient coverage of overvoltage regulations for grid connection points in current standards and proposing suggestions. Based on the hierarchy of inhibitory strategies, compared and analyzed the advantages of single objective control and the limitations of multi-objective collaborative control of existing strategies from the control and system levels. The follow-up research on the transient overvoltage problem of the UHVDC sending-end system will be further developed based on these bases.

articleTitle: Two-stage Transient Stability Adaptive Assessment of Power System Based on Cascade Multi-channel CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Currently, deep learning based transient stability assessment (TSA) faces difficulties in distinguishing system states that lie near the stability boundary. To address this issue, a two-stage adaptive TSA method for power system based on a cascaded multichannel convolutional neural network (multichannel CNN) is proposed in this paper. Initially, a power system TSA model incorporating cascaded multi-channel CNNs is constructed. The front-end multichannel CNN predicts the transient stability states of non-boundary samples and identifies the original boundary sample set. Subsequently, the back-end multichannel CNNs is trained using the boundary sample set. This enables the model to accurately classify the transient stability states of boundary samples, thereby enhancing the TSA’s accuracy. In cases of varying operating conditions in the power grid, the evaluation model is optimized using the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) to achieve reliable assessment of the target operating conditions by generating unlabeled samples through short-term simulations. Additionally, at the moment of fault clearance, our model predicts the stability level for a stable system and the safety control time margin for an unstable system. These predictions enable fast online assessment and serve as a reference for subsequent control strategies. The simulation results on the IEEE-39 bus system demonstrate the superiority of our proposed model over other commonly used deep learning algorithms. Our model exhibits excellent performance in TSA, even in the presence of significant variations in power grid conditions.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scenario Generation for Renewable Energy Output Based on CSNGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, it is a great challenge to effectively describe the uncertainty of renewable energy output before the day of power system dispatch. This paper proposes a scenario generation method based on Conditional Spectral Normalization Generative Adversarial Networks (CSNGAN) to address the renewable energy output uncertainty problem. The generator can generate the output scenario set after being trained to learn the mapping relationship between the random noise and the real historical data conditioned on the predicted data. The renewable energy output data and the corresponding predicted data are tested and validated against the Markov chain-based scenario generation method. The results show that the proposed scenario generation method can more accurately describe the uncertainty of renewable energy output.

articleTitle: Value Judgment and Value-Added Benefit Evaluation of Electric Vehicles Participating in Diversified Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: A large number of electric vehicle charging stations can achieve comprehensive optimization of operational costs through load aggregation and participation in diverse markets. Firstly, the positioning and role of aggregators of electric vehicles in auxiliary services markets, demand response, green energy trading markets, and spot markets are studied. Then, the value assessment of electric vehicles’ participation in diverse market transactions is analyzed from the perspectives of supply-demand balance, safety and stability, and energy conservation and emission reduction. Subsequently, the value-added paths and benefits evaluation of electric vehicle aggregation participating in diverse markets is analyzed from a modeling perspective. Finally, the advantages of electric vehicle aggregation participating in diverse markets are derived through specific case analysis, thereby achieving friendly interaction among participating users, peak load shaving, and promoting the integration of renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Improved Method for SCUC Optimization with Feasibility Detection-based Induced Objective Function
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As independent system operators (ISOs) or regional transmission organizations (RTOs) grow in size, the Security Constrained Unit Commitment (SCUC) currently in use encounters significant difficulties, including issues related to modeling precision and computational complexity. To overcome these challenges, we have developed a feasibility detection-based induced objective function method to solve SCUC, which is an integer programming heuristics based on induced functions and variable fixing. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms CPLEX on large-scale datasets.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Countermeasures on Energy Security Issues and Energy Transition in Sichuan and Chongqing Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Energy security is an important part of national security. The energy structure of the world today is in the midst of an energy transformation from fossil energy to renewable energy, and China’s energy development under the new situation is facing a complex situation and serious challenges, not only to accelerate the low-carbon energy transition to achieve the goal of carbon neutrality, but also to firmly guard the bottom line of energy security. How to co-ordinate the energy transition and energy security is a major issue facing China’s high-quality and sustainable energy development. The Sichuan-Chongqing region is the most populous and economically largest region in the west, and has the highest comprehensive economic strength in the west. Its abundant hydropower resources provide powerful power output for the Sichuan-Chongqing region as well as the eastern region; its abundant natural gas resources provide stable energy power for the Sichuan-Chongqing region. However, the single energy structure of the Sichuan-Chongqing region and the uncertainty of its hydro energy resources have led to a mismatch between its energy security capacity and its development needs. This paper puts forward some suggestions and countermeasures on a series of challenges facing the energy security of the Sichuan-Chongqing region.

articleTitle: A Series Arc Fault Identification Method Based on Improved Gramian Angular Field
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The AC series arc fault of low-voltage power lines is easy to lead electrical fires and cause personal and property losses. The detection of series fault arc in low-voltage lines is mainly based on the extraction of arc fault features of current signals, which cannot make full use of all the information contained in the current waveform. In order to avoid the loss of valuable feature information in the current waveform, this paper proposes a 2D image coding method of current time series based on Gramian angular field (GAF), and uses computer vision technology for time series classification. Aiming at the problem that the arc feature information contained in the image is not obvious due to the limitation of computing resources and the pixel size of the image should be as small as possible, this paper improves the traditional GAF coding method. Based on the zero-current period and power features of arc current, the second color coding is performed on the image encoded by GAF in HSV color space to better express the original signal features. A series arc fault experimental platform was built, and the normal operation current and arc fault current of various electrical appliances were collected. The convolutional neural network and the improved image coding method are used to classify and identify the collected current. The results show that the average of the improved GAF coding method is 99.7 %, which has better accuracy than the traditional GAF.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization of Joint Thermal-Storage System for Frequency Regulation Considering Battery Life
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Combining with electrochemical energy storage to enhance the performance of thermal power unit frequency regulation (FR) can greatly enhance the thermal power unit FR auxiliary service revenue, but also provide flexibility resources for a high proportion of new energy power system. The optimal allocation of energy storage capacity in thermal power system for FR is not only related to the characteristics of thermal power units, frequency command characteristics, energy storage technology type, but also influenced by the performance index, market rules and other factors. Making full use of the capacity of energy storage to enhance the FR performance of the unit, so that the whole life cycle of combined thermal storage and FR revenue maximization has a strong practical significance. This paper obtains the equivalent cycle life of battery storage by rain flow method, establishes the optimal configuration model of combined thermal storage with maximum net benefit based on comprehensive FR performance evaluation index of Guangdong power grid, combines battery storage multi-layer State of Charge (SOC) control strategy. In case study, the actual grid Automatic Generation Contro (AGC) command and the frequency regulation curve of IOOOMW thermal power unit were used. The simulation results showed that 24MW/22.6MWh lithium-ion battery storage combined IOOOMW thermal power unit not only has a better FR performance than the conventional configuration (duration 0. 5h), but also the battery storage operation SOC is optimized, which is conducive to extending the battery life, thus enhancing the whole life cycle revenue of energy storage.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Evaluation of Solar Radiation on Solar Power Station in Yangjiang
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Based on the mesoscale model in GuangDong, which is belong to China Meteorological Administration (hereinafter referred to as CMA-GD model), this paper conducted a forecast test on the total solar radiation in Yangjiang City, Guangdong Province for four typical months in 2022. The forecast capability of this test on the total solar radiation from different perspectives is evaluated by using statistical methods based on the time-by-time total solar radiation observations of five photovoltaic power stations in Yangjiang. The results show that the overall simulation effects are good. The correlation coefficients between 24-hour forecast and observation of solar radiation in Yangjiang City in 2022 are between 0.82-0.86. And the differences between 48-hour and 24-hour forecasts are insignificant. Among the typical months, the correlation coefficients in October is the best (0.87<R<0.95), which is related to the climate characteristics of Yangjiang City with more sunshine and less rain in autumn. The relatively large errors in the solar radiation forecasts for each photovoltaic power station in January and August are related to factors such as more cloudy weather in winter and more convective weather in summer in Yangjiang. Furthermore, from the assessment of daily variation, the forecast of solar radiation at noon has a larger deviation than other parts of the day. The forecast effect is better in the afternoon than in the morning. In addition, weather conditions have a large impact on solar radiation, with sunny days having the highest correlation coefficients (0.72<R<0.82) and rainy days having the smallest correlation coefficients (0.37<R<0.52). The coefficients of overcast sky are only next to sunny days. The daily fluctuations of solar radiation in cloudy days are relatively obvious and the deviation is between overcast sky and rainy day. In addition to weather type, the topography also has a large influence on the forecast of surface solar radiation. The further research is needed to improve and revise the solar radiation forecast considering factors such as topography and weather type.

articleTitle: Knowledge-driven Identification Method for Low Voltage Ride through Strategy of Photovoltaic Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The rapid development of renewable energy power generation technology represented by photovoltaic and wind power has changed the fault characteristics of the grid. However, there is a major problem in the calculation of short-circuit current in existing renewable energy: the current analytical research on fault currents of various types of renewable energy power supplies is too dependent on the control strategy and parameters of renewable energy, while the control strategy and parameters are too hard to acquire. Aiming at the above problems, a knowledge-driven identification method for low voltage ride through strategy of photovoltaic inverters is proposed. Firstly, multi-dimensional features reflecting the differences of different control strategies are extracted from the time-varying trajectories and a knowledge-driven control strategy classification feature set is constructed; secondly, a typical control strategy identification model based on the random forest algorithm is established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Online Dynamic Black-start Strategy for Multi-power Microgrids Considering Source Output Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the variety and number of distributed generation (DG) in microgrid increases, the black start strategy of microgrid becomes more complex. A dynamic black-start strategy for microgrid based on online evaluation of DG black-start capability is proposed by considering the effects of state of charge (SOC) and DG output uncertainty. First, the index system is established from 2 levels of DG’s own starting characteristics and surrounding environment characteristics for evaluating the power supply black start capability; Secondly, the assessment value of DG black start capability is calculated online using the combined subjective and objective evaluation method to determine the start sequence of each DG in the corresponding time period; Then, a line recovery mathematical model is established with the objective of shortest recovery path and most important load recovery, and DG active output forecast values are introduced for calculation to update the recovery path and recovery strategy for that time period; Finally, the effectiveness of the strategy was verified in a modified IEEE33 microgrid system.

articleTitle: Economic and Technical Optimization Configuration Methods for Energy Storage on the New Energy Side
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, the proportion of installed capacity of new energy generation has been increasing year by year. It is urgent to install energy storage system to reduce the impact of intermittency and volatility on the power system. To this end, an economic and technical optimization configuration method for energy storage on the new energy side is proposed. With the objective of reducing wind and photovoltaic (PV) output volatility and maximizing the comprehensive economic value of energy storage systems, a technical and economic optimization configuration model is constructed. The comprehensive value considers the internal and external values of energy storage. Taking a certain region as an example, the NSGA-II algorithm was used to obtain the energy storage configuration plan. It has shown that when the suppression rate of wind and PV output fluctuations is controlled within 30%, and the proportion of PV to wind installation is low, configuring a certain scale of energy storage can achieve significant effects in both technical and economic aspects.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Power Quality Weighting Method Based on The Operating Conditions of Disturbance Source Users
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the continuous development of industry in our country, the power system inevitably connects with more and more nonlinear interference source users. These users include new energy power plants, electrified railways, steel enterprises, chemical production enterprises, monocrystalline silicon production enterprises, etc., which cause an increase in sensitive and nonlinear loads that the power system has to bear. However, the past electric power quality cannot meet the normal operation of modern equipment, and the requirements for electric power quality from major electricity consumers far exceed those in the past. This article first provides a detailed introduction to the indicators used in traditional electric power quality evaluation. Then, based on the harmonic spectrum analysis of operating conditions data from a polycrystalline silicon enterprise, this article considers the comprehensive expert score by using the analytic hierarchy process. Subsequently, building on the traditional entropy weight method, this paper proposes an improved entropy weight determination method for comprehensive weighting of electric power quality. This method is more accurate in analyzing the electric power quality for different power grid interference source users.

articleTitle: Demand-side Low-carbon Dispatch Considering Carbon Responsibility Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the introduction of China’s dual carbon target and the rapid development of the national carbon market, it is of great importance to explore the demand-side optimal dispatching strategy of the power system considering the carbon emission responsibility. In this regard, this paper proposes a carbon emission responsibility sharing method based on carbon flow theory, and constructs a demand-side low-carbon dispatching model with the objective of minimizing the cost and carbon emission of the power system. The model introduces the carbon emission responsibility cost into the demand response objective, and obtains the optimal strategy for each node of the system to participate in the demand response through the method of day-ahead simulation and optimal regulation. The research results show that the proposed improvement strategy can effectively reduce carbon emissions under the condition of meeting the demand response requirements.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Reactive Power Real-Time Dispatch Optimization in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The access of large-scale distributed generation (DG) makes the reactive power optimal control strategy of distribution networks different from traditional distribution networks. Aiming at the problem of real-time reactive power dispatch for short-time scale scheduling, this paper proposes a Volt-Var control (VVC) method of distribution networks based on multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL). Firstly, the decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP) is designed based on the VVC model, and then the multi-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (MATD3) algorithm is used to solve the Dec-POMDP model. The proposed method can intelligently generate the real-time VVC dispatch strategy according to the random change of generation and load. It has good real-time performance and control economy. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Intelligent Environmental Noise Removal for Substations Noise Monitoring via Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Substation noise monitoring has become a crucial issue for Power Grid due to environmental protection reasons. How to eliminate the disturbing environmental noise such as bird chirp, insect chirp and human voice from substation equipment noise so as to obtain an accurate substation noise measurement is therefore of great importance. To tackle this issue, this paper proposes two intelligent environmental noise removal algorithms based on deep clustering and Conv-TasNet. A novel dataset is constructed on our own, consisting of substation equipment noise, and different sources of environmental noises, based on which the proposed algorithms are trained and evaluated in various noise scenarios. Experimental results show that both algorithms achieve satisfactory separation accuracy, while the end-to-end Conv-TasNet model performs better.

articleTitle: A Hosting Capacity Evaluation Method Considering Solar Radiation, Wind Speed and Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The dependence of distributed generation (DG) outputs and load plays an essential role in renewable energy accommodation. This paper presents a modeling method that captures complex dependent structures of solar radiation, wind speed, and loads. First, an advanced dependence modeling method called regular vine (R-vine) is applied to capture the complex dependence structure of solar radiation, wind speed, commercial loads, industrial loads, and residential loads. Then, a chance-constrained DGHC evaluation model is employed to figure out the maximum hosting capacity of each DG and its optimal allocation plan with different operational risks. The proposed approaches are validated using a set of historical data from China. Results show that the dependence among different DGs and loads has a significant impact on the hosting capacity. This finding provides useful advice for distribution networks in installing renewable energy generations.

articleTitle: Optimization of Electricity Trading Strategies for Electricity Retailers in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With continuous advancement of China’s electricity market reform, the number of electricity retailers continuously increase. As a new participant in electricity market, electricity procurement and sale strategies have become core issues for electricity retails. Given the responsibility of renewable energy consumption and the increasing demand response ability, this paper proposes a model of electricity procurement and sale strategy that considers renewable energy consumption and customer demand response. Firstly, a power purchase portfolio model that considers the renewable energy consumption index is proposed. Secondly, we propose a demand response model that considers customer satisfaction under the time-sharing tariff on the selling side. A comprehensive decision-making and risk assessment model for electricity retailer is established to maximize expected profit and risk loss. The study cases analyze the influence of consumption index, customer response, and risk preference on the decision-making of electricity retailers. Then the study cases compare the results of unilateral optimization and joint optimization of electricity procurement and selling to verify the model’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Resilience Assessment Method for Energy Internet Considering Electricity-Gas-Heat Interdependence
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing frequency of natural disasters and the Energy Internet’s rising sensitivity to weather changes, the necessity to maintain uninterrupted load supply in different fault and weather scenarios has attracted widespread attention. This paper proposes a resilience assessment method considering the interdependence between electricity, gas, and heat. Firstly, this paper proposes the concept of resilience assessment scenarios, which aims to analyze the resilience level of the Energy Internet under various extreme incidents and the corresponding abilities that need modification. Secondly, this paper constructs a resilience assessment metric system covering various fault and weather types from the perspective of regional resilience, complementary ability, and system resilience. Finally, a simulation analysis of an Energy Internet is conducted to analyze the differentiated impacts of various faults on the overall system, single energy supply area, and the complementary abilities between subsystems under different weather conditions. The analysis demonstrates that the proposed method can provide targeted guidance for resilience enhancement.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Reconfiguration of Distribution Network Based on Data-Driven Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As a key component of power generation, the transmission network and user demand, the distribution network is of great significance to safe and stable operation of the power system.
