However, in recent years, owing to the increase in complex loads and access to distributed power sources, the network operation has become increasingly complicated and uncertain. In view of the complexity of the power flow of the distribution network and the uncertainty of the distributed power supply, it becomes increasingly difficult to quickly restore the normal power supply of the power system after a fault occurs. In this paper, an improved heuristic algorithm combined with convolutional neural network (CNN) model is used to solve this problem. First, the reasons for the uncertainty of the distribution network are analysed, and a mathematical model is established for the uncertainty factors; then, the minimum network loss and voltage quality factors are selected as the objective functions of reconfiguration, and, at the same time, the corresponding constraints are determined; the algorithm is finally verified on the IEEE 136-bus test system, which validates the correctness of the used method. On this basis, the deep learning method is used to improve the reconfiguration rate and efficiency, that is, the convolutional neural network is used to train the historical data set, the one-to-one mapping relationship between the historical reconfiguration optimal solution and the distribution network topology is determined, and, finally, the model is applied to the test data set to verify its validity and correctness, so as to achieve the objective of real-time reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Topology Applied to Island Photovoltaic DC Grid Connected Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: When large-scale new energy is connected to the island’s weak AC power grid through two forms: AC convergence AC grid connection and AC convergence DC grid connection, it poses serious challenges to the carrying capacity and stability of the power grid. The island photovoltaic adopts a DC convergence DC grid connection scheme, which can reduce the AC/DC conversion process and improve the overall operational efficiency of the system. This article analyzes the efficiency, photovoltaic utilization, reliability, and cost of power electronic equipment, and selects a parallel two-stage boost topology architecture; Referring to national standards and considering factors such as equipment economy, determine the DC voltage levels in low-voltage, medium voltage, and high-voltage areas; Compare and analyze the topology structure and characteristics of different types of DC transformers, and provide topology choices for medium voltage DC transformers and high voltage DC transformers based on specific system requirements. By conducting research on the application of island photovoltaic DC grid connection technology, exploring new modes of future new energy collection and transmission, and promoting the island photovoltaic DC grid connection project, it has important engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Joint Low Voltage Ride Through Strategy of Wind Power Fractional Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS) based on modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C) has good transmission efficiency and technical feasibility in scenarios of offshore wind power delivery. In order to improve the low voltage ride through (LVRT) ability of the system, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the dynamic process of the low-voltage fault of the power-frequency side in the grid. Based on the maximum capacity of power transmission of M3C and the energy storage system applied, this paper proposes a control strategy of energy transfer in FFTS, and the corresponding simulation model is built to verify the control strategy. The simulation results show that the control strategy can provide dynamic compensation of reactive current and greatly improve the stability of capacitor voltage in M3C sub-modules during the period of the fault, which can provide an insurance for LVRT of the offshore FFTS.

articleTitle: Power System Resilience Improvement Strategy Considering Cascading Failures under Extreme Disasters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, extreme natural disasters have become more and more severe, and power system outage caused by cascading faults have occurred frequently. This paper introduces a stochastic approach for link-structure analysis (SALSA) to simulate the random wandering process of fault chain propagation and obtain the authority score and hub score. Combined with load importance and topology importance, the key degree index is comprehensively evaluated, and the critical components for resilience improvement are identified. Through flexible dispatching of distributed generation (DG) and reconfiguring network topology, the strategy can reduce load power on key branches, contain the development of cascading failures and thus improve power system resilience under extreme disasters. The case study on PE & G 69 system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and model.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Fractional-Order Phase-Shifted Full-Bridge Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the fact that the actual order of inductance and capacitance is fractional, this paper uses fractional calculus and state space averaging methods to model and analyze phase shifted full bridge DC/DC converter. The state average model of a phase shifted full bridge DC/DC converter is established, and the duty cycle output voltage and input voltage output voltage transfer functions of the fractional order phase shifted full bridge converter are derived using the state average model. Finally, the fractional reactance component is constructed, and a circuit simulation model of the fractional order phase shifted full bridge converter is built in Matlab/Simulink. By comparing the experimental results with the circuit simulation model of the integer order phase shifted full bridge converter, the correctness of the established model and theoretical analysis is verified. The fractional order circuit simulation model can more accurately describe the operating characteristics of the phase shifted full bridge converter.

articleTitle: Distributed PV Power Forecast Based on Public Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the context of the large-scale deployment of distributed PV power stations, ensuring the accuracy of PV power forecasting is particularly important for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Therefore, this paper proposes a distributed PV short-term power prediction model based on public meteorological data. Firstly, the time resolution of meteorological data is improved using cubic spline interpolation. Then, in the absence of irradiance data in public meteorological data, convolutional neural networks (CNN) are used to extract features from PV output data and limited meteorological data, and combined with long short-term memory (LSTM) for further learning, which can deeply explore the relationship between meteorological data and distributed PV power output. Finally, the model is tuned using Bayesian optimization. The prediction results show that the CNN-LSTM combination model established in this paper has better prediction performance than using only CNN or LSTM for prediction, and its prediction results are closer to the actual distributed PV power output.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization Model for New Power System Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Based on the basic theory of new power system, this paper builds a power system scheduling optimization model on the basis of simulated reality, from both supply side and demand side. Firstly, the main technical characteristics of ‘double high’ power system is summarized. Then, this paper designs the compensation scheme of demand response (DR) with different compensation prices and interruptible load (IL) capacity. Specifically, the compensation price is divided into three grades according to size of IL capacity, where the higher the interruptible load, the higher the compensation unit price. On this basis, considering the carbon emission trading mechanism on power supply side, carbon price and penalty cost of wind abandonment are introduced. Then economic benefit model to measure energy consumption and operation cost of the system and environmental benefit model to measure the carbon emission cost are constructed. Finally, the operation process of the power system is simulated. The optimization solution is carried out to obtain optimal system operation cost.

articleTitle: Benefit Analysis of Park-level Integrated Energy System Transformation Planning Based on Electricity Substitution
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the context of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, electricity substitution transformation planning is carried out for the park-level integrated energy system, and the electricity substitution benefits generated after transformation are evaluated to measure the rationality and feasibility of the electricity substitution scheme. Before the transformation, the integrated energy system covers 4 major energy supply equipment, including combined cooling, heating, and power, gas boiler, air conditioner, and substation. To study the electricity substitution benefit, electric boilers, and electric energy storage are added to the existing planning scheme. Based on 8760 hours of historical multi-energy load data, several typical daily load curves are obtained by a clustering algorithm. The energy hub is used to describe the internal energy coupling of the system. Considering the construction cost and operation cost of the scheme, the minimum annual cost is taken as the objective to optimize the planning scheme, and the corresponding mixed integer linear programming problem is solved. According to the optimization results, the related indexes of electricity substitution are evaluated for the schemes before and after the transformation to reflect the planning benefits. The results show that the energy utilization efficiency and electrification level are improved, which provides theoretical support for the implementation of the electricity substitution.

articleTitle: New Operation Models of Premium Power Services
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, manufacturing industry is becoming more intelligent. Voltage sag sensitive equipment, such as electronic intelligent robots, precision manufacturing instruments, is widely used in the production lines of manufacturing users. It makes that voltage sags bring troubles to the manufacturing users, affects their high-quality and high-quantity development, and reduces users’ satisfactions with electricity. Therefore, it is urgent for power utilities to provide corresponding premium power supply services to help users solve voltage sags. This paper researches the existing premium power supply services and their operation modes, classifies them into technical and economic services according to their service essence, analyzes the applicable scenarios and service objects of different premium power supply services. The results can solve the problem that users do not know how to choose the premium power supply services which are suitable for their needs.

articleTitle: Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Dual Active Bridge Converter for Portable Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of portable energy storage (PES), a dual active bridge (DAB) converter based on linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is studied in this paper. Firstly, a small-signal model of the DAB converter is derived on the basis of its reduced-order model. Subsequently, a line expansion state observer (LESO) is designed to estimate and counteract both internal and external disturbances in real time. Meanwhile, the convergence of LESO is also validated by means of the final-value theorem. Finally, a comparison is conducted between the LADRC and the traditional PI control strategies of DAB converters in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results indicate that The LADRC control strategy allows for more effective control of the output voltage stability compared to the traditional PI control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Iterative Method for The Potential Distribution Calculation of Arrester
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This research paper analyzes the potential distribution of an AC 500 kV GIS (Gas Insulated Substation) tank arrester with high-gradient resistor sheets under continuous operating voltage. The study proposes a new calculation method for potential distribution and establishes a correlation between the relative permittivity of the resistor sheet and its chargeability through measurements of its relative dielectric constant. The results provide valuable insights into improving the performance of the arrester and enhancing the safety and reliability of substation operations.

articleTitle: Wind Power Short-Term Forecasting Method Based on Blending Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: A short-term wind power forecasting model based on Blending Ensemble learning is proposed to solve the problems of low forecasting accuracy of existing single wind power forecasting models and poor robustness of combined forecasting models. By comparing the prediction effects of several different single prediction models and analyzing the correlation degree between each single model, a group of optimal model combinations with excellent individual model performance and large differences are sought for integration and fusion. Finally, the Long short-term memory network (LSTM), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBOOST) models are selected for fusion. Compared with the traditional short-term wind power prediction methods, the proposed short-term wind power prediction model based on Blending Ensemble learning has higher prediction accuracy and better generalization performance. This study is of great significance for the stable and economical operation of power systems with high proportion of wind power integration in the future.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Boosting Algorithm-based Method of Charging Equipment for Fault Warning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Fault warning of charging equipment is a hot topic of intelligent operation and maintenance in recent years, which can ensure the safety of the electric vehicle charging process effectively. There exist some works that employ machine learning methods based on battery management system and simulation the induced reason of faults, but few of them pay attention to charging pile faults in view of the perspective of users' charging orders. In this paper, we propose a fault warning method for charging equipment based on an adaptive boosting (AdaBoost) algorithm, which focuses on modelling the charging order for early warning. Firstly, we select the properties derived from the order information of the charging station, and several features are defined manually. Then, we normalize these features so that the potential associations among features can be discovered by our designed adaptive boosting model. We construct the dataset based on provided order data and compare our model with existing methods. The experimental results show that our method can obtain better performances than existing models in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: The Impact of Thermal Ageing on the Compression Strength of Radial Spacers in Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Radial spacers made of high-density pressboard play a critical role in power transformers, providing support and maintaining distance between winding disks for efficient dielectric oil flow through cooling ducts. However, prolonged exposure to high temperatures leads to chemical reactions and degradation of mechanical and dielectric properties, potentially compromising transformer integrity. In this study, high-density pressboard spacers immersed in paraffinic oil underwent thermal aging to simulate the transformer lifespan. Various chemical, dielectric, and mechanical parameters were measured, including AC breakdown voltage, dielectric dissipation factor (tan $\delta$), permittivity, resistivity, moisture content, and oil acidity. Moreover, the degree of polymerisation and compressive stiffness of the pressboard were determined. By establishing mathematical relationships, it was possible to estimate the compressive stiffness indirectly and non-destructively, from the degree of polymerisation and oil acidity measurements. These findings offer valuable insights for evaluating the condition of radial spacers and ensuring the reliable operation of power transformers.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Control Design of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator Integrated Power System Based on Distributed Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the large-scale grid integration of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG), uncertainties also arise on the power generation side, which puts higher demands on the performance of frequency controllers. Based on model predictive control, this paper investigates the AGC strategy under the participation of DFIG to improve their secondary frequency regulation support capability. By combining control with optimization, an AGC controller is designed based on distributed model predictive control, which adapts to the system’s uncertainties through rolling optimization and feedback correction and transforms the optimization problem and constraint conditions into standard quadratic forms for ease of solution. Finally, the frequency support capability of the proposed AGC controller is verified in three-area transmission system.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy System in Park Considering Hydrogen Blending Gas and Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of low energy conversion efficiency and low utilization rate of hydrogen energy in the integrated energy system of industrial parks, an integrated energy system architecture of industrial parks with hydrogen blending gas and integrated demand response is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical models of hydrogen-doped gas turbine, hydrogen-doped gas boiler and hydrogen production from natural gas are established. Secondly, an integrated demand response model is established based on various energy characteristics of electricity, heat, gas and hydrogen. Finally, an objective function is established to minimize the operating cost of the system. According to the fact example, this paper analyses the influence of the effects of different fixed, variable hydrogen doping ratios and the load characteristics of the park after demand response on system low carbon and economy.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Dispatching Strategy Considering the Participation of Load Aggregators in the Group Optimization Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Under the background of the “Double Carbon Targets as an important element of carbon emission reduction in transportation industry, the development scale of electric vehicles (EVs) is increasing, and the management difficulty is also increasing. At the same time, the increasing penetration rate of EVs on the grid side brings uncertainty to the grid and makes the scheduling control of EVs increasingly difficult. Accordingly, this paper proposes an EV dispatching strategy considering the participation of load aggregators in the group optimization mode and builds a relevant model for simulation verification. First, the locations of EV charging stations are simulated according to the local population distribution, and a scatter diagram of charging station distribution is drawn. On this basis, the EVs and EV charging stations are bound by the characteristic of more stable EV charging and discharging behaviors in a certain area, and the group management of scattered EVs is transformed into the group management of EV charging stations with fixed locations. The k-means method is used to cluster the EVs and assign them to each aggregator for management, and each aggregator provides the predicted charging and discharging power of EVs in its jurisdiction. Finally, each aggregator is assigned a dispatching plan according to the proportion of the predicted power of each aggregator in the total predicted power. This paper takes the data for a typical day of a certain area as an example to simulate the optimal dispatching of EVs. The results show that the EV dispatching strategy proposed in this paper, which considers the participation of load aggregators in the group optimization mode, can easily and quickly cluster EVs, thus effectively reduce user costs, smooth out net load fluctuations, develop individualized dispatching plans for different aggregators, and provide reference for the dispatching center to allocate dispatching plans.

articleTitle: Semi-hot Redundant Control for MMC with Different Modulation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high voltage direct current (HVDC) system, configuring a certain number of redundant submodules (SMs) is a simple and effective way to improve the system reliability under SMs failure. However, the redundant SM control and seamless transition during faulty SM replacement are critical issues. This paper analyzes semi-hot redundant control with phase shifted carrier pulse width modulation (PSC-PWM) and nearest level modulation (NLM) strategies, respectively. The principles of two modulation strategies are introduced, and semi-hot redundant control of MMC using two modulation strategies are analyzed. Two modulation strategies are simulated in a 21-level two terminal MMC system by PSCAD/EMTDC software, by comparing the transition time and dynamic performance under different cases, the results show that the NLM strategy has better SM fault ride-through ability.

Author Keywords: carrier phase shifted pulse width modulation (PSC-PWM)

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for Demand Response Potential of Electric Vehicle Aggregators
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a method for evaluating the demand response potential of EV aggregators. Based on this evaluation method, the charging station formulates corresponding charging plan and power real-time control strategy by combining the basic load curve, demand response execution period and station operating conditions, so as to dynamically adjust the power of charging pile when demand response occurs. A beneficial effect of the present invention over the prior art is that the evaluation method clarifies the priority of charge power demand and the control recovery strategy. When demand response occurs, the system implements charging power reduction and recovery strategies according to user’s charging demand priority to ensure safe and economic operation of regional power grid.

articleTitle: No-Fluctuation Wind Power Grid-Connection Aided by Pumped Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to better utilize wind resources and achieve grid connection of new energy generation, this paper designs a power generation system that combines wind power and pumped storage power stations. By utilizing the peak shaving and valley filling characteristics of pumped storage power stations, the pump is used as a controllable load to consume the fluctuating part of wind power, and the remaining stable output is integrated into the grid. When the grid load is needed or disturbed, the pumped storage power station participates in regulation, At the same time, it can still play a role in energy storage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Reactive Power Curve Optimization during Low Voltage Ride-Through in New Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the context of the same initial operating conditions and fault conditions in the system, the requirements for the reactive power curve of the new energy power station during low voltage ride-through are studied based on the principle of following the same steady-state voltage drop value of the new energy power source and synchronous power source with the same capacity. The article first introduces the low-voltage ride-through control structure of the wind turbine generator, and then describes the power control of the machine-side converter under different wind speeds. Secondly, a mathematical model of the wind turbine generator/thermal power equivalent external transmission system is established to analyze the effect of active and reactive power on the voltage at the point of grid connection. The PV curve is used to compare the voltage stability margin and flexibility of the wind turbine generator/thermal power node. Based on the established mathematical model, the reactive power curve of the wind turbine generator during low voltage ride-through is optimized. The Matlab simulation verification shows that after the optimization of the reactive power curve, the steady-state voltage drop values of the new energy power source and synchronous power source can be maintained consistent. This is conducive to controlling the voltage influence range of the new energy field station after a fault occurs.

articleTitle: Data-driven-based potential assessment of industrial and commercial loads
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: New power system requires extracting valuable information from massive data, providing utility value for the power system and providing high-quality services to users, which promotes the development of demand response. The method of data-driven-based potential assessment of industrial and commercial loads is proposed in this paper. The raw data is processed through empirical mode decomposition and load clustering techniques to assess the potential of industrial and commercial loads. The load clustering technique for low-frequency components could identify the type of load, and participate in other auxiliary services, such as load decomposition, etc. Furthermore, the clustering results could reflect the long-term response capacity and serve as a potential assessment index for the long-term response time. In addition, the high-frequency components are added considered as detailed information based on low-frequency components, which provides a basis for distinguishing typical users of the same type of load, and could be used as a potential assessment index for short-term response rates. This assessment method will help the power system guide industrial and commercial loads to participate in demand response as needed, formulate more accurate dispatch plans, and provide better services.

articleTitle: A Strategy of Charging and Discharging for Electric Vehicle Aggregate Considering the Correction Coefficient of Load Peak and Load Valley
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This article proposes a charging and discharging method for electric vehicle aggregate that takes into account the peak valley correction coefficient of the grid bus load. Based on the load prediction results of the power grid bus, this article aims to optimize the overall economic benefits of electric vehicle aggregates for electric vehicle users in the future, with the goal of minimizing the total charging and discharging costs. It also takes into account the charging during peak and low load periods, which is the charging and discharging point method that is opposite to the peak and valley of the load, and increases the correction coefficient of load peaks and valleys in the optimization goal, That is, considering the impact of load peaks and valleys, in order to reduce the charging amount during peak loads, and reserve as much dischargeable electricity as possible, increase the charging amount during low periods, and achieve peak shaving and valley filling while improving the economic benefits of electric vehicle users, ensuring the safe operation of the power grid. Through numerical simulation, it can be seen that the strategy proposed in this article achieves peak shaving and valley filling, effectively reducing the peak valley difference. Moreover, the effect is very significant in reducing the charging cost of car owners and improving the revenue of charging stations, achieving a win-win situation between car owners and charging stations in terms of economic benefits. Therefore, the method proposed in this article is effective and has practical application value.

articleTitle: A Novel Bidirectional Converter for Spacecraft Battery Charge and Discharge Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The battery charge and discharge regulator (BCDR) is an important component of space power supply system. The use of bidirectional DC-DC converter instead of traditional dual unidirectional DC-DC converter can make the whole power supply lighter, smaller in size and higher in power density, which meets the development needs of miniaturization and lightweight of space power supply in the future. In this paper, a bidirectional SuperBuck-Boost DC-DC converter integrated charging and discharging circuit topology is proposed, and the operation principle and characteristics of the circuit topology are analyzed, The battery charge and discharge control strategy based on the bidirectional SuperBuck-Boost converter is proposed, and the feasibility of the circuit topology and control strategy is verified by a 500W prototype.

articleTitle: Multiple Output Sparse Gaussian Processes with Multiple Kernel Learning for Electric Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Electric load forecasting is one of the techniques that support smart grid objectives. It refers to predicting the electricity demand at aggregated levels which is mandatory for the smart grid’s proper functioning and having a balance between electricity generation and power consumption at all time. In this paper, we proposed multiple output sparse Gaussian processes with multiple kernel learning for hourly day-ahead short-term electric load forecasting using load, dew point, and temperature values. Mean absolute percentage error metric is used to evaluate and compare the performance of the proposed multiple output sparse Gaussian processes with multiple kernel learning and the persistence method in three scenarios (using load and dew point values, using load and temperature values, and finally, using load, dew point, and temperature values from previous days). The results showed that the proposed method achieved much lower MAPE values than the persistence method.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Strategy for Green Certificate-Incorporated Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the proposal of the target for “emission peak” and “carbon neutrality”, the electricity-carbon market is deeply integrated. The construction of carbon market can promote the optimization of thermal power unit portfolio and effectively reduce the carbon emissions of power system. The existing literature has conducted a thorough study on the outgrowth technology of power systems under the electricity-carbon market. However, there is no research on the way of green power clearing in the electricity-carbon market. The optimal clearing of green power has a great impact on the electricity-carbon coupled market, which is conducive to promoting the consumption of renewable energy in the power system and reducing the carbon emission of the power system. In this paper, a joint market model of electricity and carbon is constructed by considering green power in market clearing, and the impact of different green power prices on the carbon emissions of the power system is simulated. A MATLAB-based national carbon emission calculation example verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching of Thermal Storage Electric Boilers Based on the Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As a new type of clean heating device, heat storage electric boilers use electricity instead of natural gas and coal as the heating energy source, effectively solving the pollution problem caused by winter heating. Based on the construction of a pilot heat storage electric boiler in Shangyi and the current technology of Power Internet of Things (Power IoT), this paper establishes an optimal dispatching model with minimal operating cost for heat storage electric boilers by analyzing their working principle and operating characteristics. The optimal dispatching strategy for heat storage electric boilers is also embedded in the intelligent energy regulation and control software module and the IoT control platform. Finally, the simulation results and field demonstration results validate the effectiveness of the proposed optimal dispatching model of thermal storage electric boilers.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Benefits of Distributed Resource Aggregation on Renewable Energy Consumption in Multiple Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: F1exible load resources such as electric vehicles and air conditioners, which are widely accessed on the demand side, can provide great flexibility potential for the new power system, so as to promote the full absorption of renewable energy. Firstly, based on the virtual energy storage model, the adjustable flexibility of the aggregate resources of electric vehicles and air conditioners is modeled. Then, the maximum absorptive capacity evaluation model of renewable energy is used to analyze the effect of distributed resource aggregation on the consumption of renewable energy. Finally, the typical application scenarios are analyzed on three time scales: intra-day minute level, day-day hour level and annual level, and the results verify the great improvement effect of distributed resource aggregation on renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: Law Analysis on the Tension Difference of the Wire Affected by Dominant Factors Caused by Ice Shedding in Medium Icing Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As a sudden loading, ice shedding can cause large vibration of the conductor in the deglaciation and induce a phenomenon called ice jump. It can trigger failures of the transmission line, such as phase to phase and phase to ground flashover, wire burn, conductor strand and insulator string breakage. A numerical simulation research was carried out, in which the effect of multiple factors on the conductor motion trail and tension change of continuous multiple-span transmission line caused by ice jump was revealed, such as deicing rate, ice thickness, number of spans, span, altitude difference and length of insulator string. And finally, the laws of variation on the tension difference caused by ice shedding were summarized which were affected by multiple factors, and the dominant affecting factors were identified.

articleTitle: Research on Supporting Characteristics of VSC HVDC for Multiple Feed-in System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Although with large capacity of hydro power, Central China Power Grid is considered as an important load center in China. And with the increasing electricity consumption, it has been developed to a multiple LCC HVDC (line-commutated converter HVDC) feed-in architecture and its transient characteristics have profoundly changed. In this scenario, a reasonable partition with VSC HVDC (voltage-sourced converter HVDC) link has been a possible choice. Evaluation of DC access capability and the strength of the interregional connection with VSC HVDC connection becomes an urgent issue. This paper investigates the indexes for evaluating the strength of multi-feeder systems, the calculation of short-circuit ratio based on operating impedance, and further discusses the transient support schemes with VSC HVDC partition.

articleTitle: Research on the Surface Electric Field of the Anti-Galloping Device of UHV Double-circuit Transmission Lines on Same Tower
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The anti-galloping devices are widely applied on the lines to reduce line galloping. In the design process of anti-galloping devices, more attention is paid to anti-galloping performance, while less attention is paid to corona performance. In this paper, a three-dimensional model of the anti-galloping device with the transmission lines is established. The surface electric field of the anti-galloping device is calculated by the finite element method. The influences of the arm length and the swing hammer radius of the anti-galloping device on the surface electric field are calculated and analyzed. The variation relationship between the structure parameters and the surface electric field of the anti-galloping device is obtained. Then the calculation formula of the surface electric field of the anti-galloping device is proposed. An anti-galloping devices with the optimized parameters calculated by the formula is developed. The corona test of the optimized anti-galloping hung on the ultra-high voltage AC test lines have been carried out, the experimental results verified that the calculation method is effectiveness. The conclusions can provide technical support and reference for the anti-corona design of anti-galloping devices for ultra-high voltage AC projects.

articleTitle: Array Design of Wave Energy Converters Based on Improved Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to fully develop and utilize of the constructive interaction between wave energy converters (WECs) to improve the generation efficiency for wave power generation system, an optimization method for three-tether WEC array based on the Improved Grey Wolf Optimization (IGWO) is proposed, seeks to improve the wave energy absorption power and q-factor of the whole WEC array. Two improvement mechanisms including best point set initialization and mutation strategy are introduced into the primal GWO. Furthermore, for the sake of verifying the effectiveness of IGWO on optimization of WEC layouts, 10-buoy wave farm is carried out. The simulation results indicate that, compared with primal GWO and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), IGWO can effectively explore the constructive interaction between WECs, and the q-factor value of WEC arrays obtained by IGWO are dramatically larger than that of other algorithms.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Operation Strategy for Apartment Complex Microgrids Considering Uncertainties in Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This study focuses on the transformation of an apartment complex into a low-carbon microgrid powered primarily by renewable energy sources. The aim is to address the challenges of high energy costs and excessive dependence on external energy supply. By establishing a microgrid with renewable energy as the main power source, significant reductions in microgrid costs were achieved. Decomposing the original electricity demand and deploying energy storage devices effectively enabled the integration of renewable energy. By storing energy during low electricity price periods and discharging it during high price periods, the complex reduced its reliance on external energy supply and achieved significant cost savings. In summary, the study demonstrates the potential of a low-carbon microgrid powered by renewable energy sources in reducing energy costs and enhancing energy self-sufficiency. By optimizing energy storage configuration and usage patterns, the apartment complex can effectively integrate renewable energy and achieve cost-effective and sustainable operation.

articleTitle: Real-time Demand Response Strategy for Massive User Participation Based on Genetic Algorithm and ADMM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of society, the consuming of electricity is increasing and the problem of electricity peak arise. Demand response (DR) is a program that arouse users' interest to encourage them to alleviate electricity. However, when the sharp peak comes, the real-time DR strategy must be generated quickly to meet the requirements of shaving peak immediately. This article proposed an architecture allowing massive user to participate in real-time DR. Furthermore, the real-time economic dispatch problem concerning real-time DR is solved by Genetic algorithm (GA) and power disaggregation is solved by ADMM to improve the solving speed. Case analysis shows the feasibility of proposed method.

articleTitle: Over Voltage Caused by Asynchronous Turn-on of Series Connected IGCTs in High Voltage MDCCB
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: High voltage mechanical dc circuit breaker (MDCCB) has been widely used in Voltage source converter based high-voltage dc transmission systems (VSC-HVDC). Series connected IGCTs are utilized in high voltage MDCCB to provide high blocking voltage. This paper analyzed the overvoltage problem during the turn-on process of series-connected snubberless IGCTs in high voltage MDCCB. First, a two-unit 2T- 3R model is developed to simulate the turn-on characteristics of series connected IGCTs without snubber and the effect of different gate delays on the anode voltage is analyzed. Then, a high-voltage DC circuit breaker circuit model is established using ideal switches to replace IGCTs and the influence of asynchronous turn-on on the overvoltage of submodules is analyzed. The results shows that more than 500 ns of turn-on time difference can cause voltage overshoot of IGCT devices. Several microseconds turn-on delay will cause significant over voltage on the latter turn-on sub-module.

articleTitle: Voltage Optimization Considering Integrated Photovoltaic 5G Base Station for ADNs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The voltage problem of active distribution networks (ADNs) is becoming more and more severe with the increase of the proportion for distributed energy resources (DERs) and new loads. This paper considers integrated photovoltaic (PVs) 5G base station (5G BS) as an emerging flexibility resource and uses it to optimize the voltage of ADNs. First, the voltage regulation potential of backup batteries and PVs in 5G BS is analyzed and evaluated. Then, a voltage optimization model of ADNs considering integrated PV 5G BS is established. This model is an integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) problem, which can be easily solved by commercial software. Finally, an actual ADN is used to verify the effectiveness of the integrated PV 5G BS to participate in voltage optimization.

articleTitle: Acoustic Imaging Based Covariance Matrix Fitting Algorithm for Transformer Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Power transformer is an essential part of modern power system, its stable and safe operation is very important to the healthy operation of power system. At present, the daily monitoring method of transformer is not perfect, but also needs the experience of on-site disposal personnel to judge. Therefore, in order to promote the development of power transformer fault diagnosis technology, it is necessary to develop new technology to further improve the accuracy and rapidity of fault diagnosis. Acoustic imaging as a sound field visualization technology has been widely concerned in the fault field. According to the principle and current situation of acoustic imaging, an acoustic imaging diagnosis technique of transformer fault based on covariance matrix fitting (CMF) algorithm is proposed in this paper. This method can accurately diagnose the fault state of transformer by the distribution of the sound field inside the transformer, so as to improve the fault diagnosis efficiency. At the same time, the acoustic test data of 7 power transformers with different voltage levels and different loads were used to test the method. The test results show that the acoustic imaging technology based on CMF algorithm can identify transformer faults accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: A Centralized-local Operation Control Method for Low-Voltage AC / DC Hybrid Distribution Network Coordinated by VSC and Energy Storages
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the promotion of “carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality“ construction, large-scale distributed PVs are connected to the power system, and their power fluctuation and randomness bring great difficulties on the operation and dispatch of the distribution network. To solve high proportion distributed PVs consumption problem, this paper proposes a centralized-local operation control method for low voltage AC/DC hybrid distribution network (HDN), which is coordinated by VSC and energy storages. Firstly, the basic structure of LV AC/DC HDN and the control methods of flexible devices are introduced; secondly, the centralized optimization model of VSC and the droop control model of energy storages are established respectively, and the centralized-local operation control strategy to consume PVs in the distribution network is proposed; finally, taking a 42-node LV AC/DC HDN as an example, it is proved that the centralized-local control method can not only effectively solve the voltage problem caused by high proportion distributed PVs, but also improve the PV absorption capacity.

articleTitle: A Direct Carbon Emission Calculation Method of Industrial Enterprises Based on the Statistical Electricity-Energy-Material-Carbon Inference Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The industry is the fundamental composition of the economy, but it generates a large amount of carbon emission. Under the current carbon emission-related policies, industrial enterprises have been facing many problems in carbon emission management. For industrial enterprises, a basic requirement is to calculate carbon emission amount using a model to manage the amount of carbon emission. For power grid companies, the contribution to supporting the regional carbon emission target can be highlighted by calculating the carbon emission of factories in a specific region, which also offers an alternative way for industrial enterprises to manage and control their carbon emission. This paper develops a carbon emission calculation method based on an electricity-energy-material-carbon model using the historical data of industrial enterprises. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified by tests on real data of the steel and silicon enterprises. The tendency of results using the proposed model is almost the same with results using carbon emission factor method and the calculation of coherence results find out two methods with the lowest coherence index to determine the direct carbon emission of a silicon enterprise.

articleTitle: PSCAD-based Modeling and Simulation of Isolated Grid Operation System of Hydropower Units
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to accurately and effectively simulate the black start test process of the power grid, it is necessary to establish a hydroelectric unit model that considers the frequency control of the black start isolated grid. First, a hydro unit model was custom built using PSCAD software, and the correctness of the model was verified using PSD-BPA software. Then, the governor solitary network mode control parameters were simulated and optimized, and the applicability of the optimized parameters was verified by using the actual unit load dump test. Finally, a hydraulic turbine model considering low load resistance and nonlinearity is proposed, and simulation inversion of the load dump test is carried out based on this model, and the simulation results are in good agreement with the recorded wave data, which proves the accuracy of a hydropower unit modeling.

articleTitle: A Multi-type Market Joint Optimization Model Considering Energy Storage Participation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The significant difference between energy storage and conventional power sources is that due to storage capacity limitations, there are constraints on the generation capacity of energy storage systems for a certain period of time. Therefore, a spot market mechanism for energy storage based on segmented energy bidding curves is proposed. The energy storage units no longer bid in the power-price curves, but bid in the energy-price curves to fully reflect its scarcity and cost characteristics. Based on the operational characteristics of energy storage, a multi-type market joint optimization model was established for energy storage to simultaneously participate in the electricity, frequency regulation, and reserve markets. The correctness of the proposed method was verified through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Research on Bidirectional On-Board DC-DC Converter and Soft Start Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The main function of traditional electric vehicle on-board DC-DC converters is to charge low-voltage batteries with high-voltage batteries, and the reverse operation function is generally unavailable. This article introduced a bidirectional DC-DC converter. Its working principle was introduced. And in order to reduce the starting impulse current, the soft start strategies for forward and reverse operation were introduced separately. The circuit and the soft start strategies were built and verifiedusing PSIM simulation software. At last a 3kW experiment prototype was built. The simulation and experiment results indicate that the bidirectional DC-DC converter and the soft start strategies are effective and have a good practical value.

articleTitle: The Optimization Method of Reactive Power Control for Distribution Network Based on Two-Stage XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: A large number of distributed photovoltaic(PV) power sources are connected to the distribution network, and their volatility and intermittency easily lead to frequent voltage fluctuations in the distribution network. The traditional volt/var optimization method using the heuristic algorithm to solve the model is highly dependent on the accurate modeling of the power grid. Besides, the solution accuracy and calculation speed are difficult to respond to the voltage control requirements of the new energy distribution network. Aiming at the volt/var optimization problem in the distribution network, a method for establishing a two-stage volt/var optimization model is proposed. Based on the XGBoost algorithm, this method considers the lifetime of the PV inverters and combines the historical optimal strategy library to perform two-stage optimization of the XGBoost model, to obtain the volt/var optimization model. It is verified that this method can improve the online operation speed of the volt/var optimization model and prolong the lifetime of IGBT, to update the optimization strategy of the distribution network in time and reduce device investment.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered H∞ Consensus Secondary Voltage Control of AC Microgrids With Sampling Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this article, a distributed event-triggered $H_{\infty}$ consensus control strategy is proposed for secondary voltage control of microgrids (MGs) to reduce communication and computational burden. The event-triggered is implemented based on periodic sampling. By using the Lyapunov method to design the triggering conditions and sampling period of the distributed generators (DGs), DGs only communicate with their neighbors under certain specific event conditions, and the event triggering conditions are only calculated at the sampling time. Therefore, it avoids continuous communication and the calculation of continuous event-triggered conditions, thereby reducing the communication and computational burden. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Radiated Electromagnetic Waves during Reactive Power Switching
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As an important component of reactive power compensation equipment, the reactive power switching circuit breaker plays a crucial role in the stable switching of reactive power compensation devices such as capacitor banks and reactors, which helps maintain system voltage stability and reduce line losses [1–3]. However, due to issues such as inrush current and slamming through-voltage when switching on and off capacitive current, as well as closure overvoltage and frequent operation when switching on inductive current, it is necessary to monitor its switching performance [4–7]. Currently, the detection technology of circuit breaker’s arc extinguishing characteristics based on radiated electromagnetic waves has achieved good practical results in the detection of common circuit breaker’s arc extinguishing characteristics. However, there is no research on reactive power switches. Therefore, this paper conducts an experimental study on the characteristics of radiated electromagnetic waves during the breaking process of reactive power switches.

articleTitle: Prediction of International Aviation Carbon Emissions and Offsetting Based on ICAO Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Carbon emissions are hot topics of common concern to the international community, and achieving carbon neutrality has become a global goal. In response to the challenges faced by developing countries in implementing the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) proposed by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), this study predicts the international aviation carbon emissions and offsetting obligations for developed and developing countries from a theoretical calculation perspective. The results show that the global total international aviation emissions will reach approximately 2.233 billion tons by 2050, with developed countries and developing countries accounting for 40.57% and 59.43%, respectively. Additionally, based on the CORSIA mechanism, the calculation results show that developing countries will need to offset 467 million tons more per year than developed countries by 2050. Finally, the cost of implementing carbon offsetting is analyzed, including the reasons for cost generation and the help that developed countries should provide to developing countries.

Author Keywords: carbon offsetting and reduction scheme for international aviation (CORSIA)

articleTitle: A Compensation Modeling and Diagnosis of Low-Frequency Oscillation Caused by Thermal Power Units
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Under the background of establishing a new power system, all kinds of renewable energy are connected to the grid on a large scale. Because of the fluctuation and instability of renewable energy output, their grid connection has a great impact on the stability and security of the grid. This problem makes thermal power units need to respond to frequent fluctuations of the power grid and compensate for the tasks of deep peak adjustment and frequent load change. As a result, the operation state of thermal power units has changed greatly, from infrequent operation of high load to frequent operation of large range now. The prime mover side, especially the nonlinear part, is easy to produce low-frequency oscillation in the running state. Low-frequency oscillations are difficult to identify. Once it occurs, it may spread to the entire power grid, endangering the security of the power grid and even causing economic losses. This paper retrofits the compensation side model. A method to evaluate the safety level of power oscillations is designed to diagnose the low-frequency oscillation modes. It has been proved that the duration to diagnose the emergences of low-frequency oscillations is reduced by about 30 seconds.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on SEB Resistance of Silicon-based RESURF LDMOS Device with Drain Buffer Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The power LDMOS device is vulnerable to the influence of high-energy particles in the space radiation environment, which leads to the single event burn-out, makes the device fail and destroys the electronic system of the spacecraft, which will seriously threaten its full operation in orbit. It is necessary to reinforce the design of the device to improve the resistance to single event burn-out[3]. Therefore, this paper proposes a new 650V Si-based power RESURF LDMOS device-RESURF LDMOS with Buffer Layer and P, N Buried (NPBNB-MOS), and introduces and analyzes the device structure and working principle of NPBNB-MOS. Simulation based on Sentaurus TCAD tool. NPBNB-MOS, RESURF LDMOS with Buffer Layer and P Buried (PBNB-MOS), RESURF LDMOS with P Buried (PB-MOS) and Conventional RESURF LDMOS (C-MOS) are simulated. The basic electrical characteristic curves and SEB characteristic curves of the four devices are obtained, and the simulation results of the four devices are compared and analyzed. The results show that under the same incident position, LET value and particle ionization radius, the SEB threshold voltage of NPBNB-MOS device proposed in this paper is higher, which is 116 % higher than that of C-MOS device, 47 % higher than that of PB-MOS device, and 14 % higher than that of PBNB-MOS device.

articleTitle: Research on Load Restoration Method for AC/DC Distribution Systems Considering Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Flexible power electronic devices need to be connected between the DC distribution system and the AC distribution system to form an AC/DC hybrid system. However, the frequent occurrence of extreme weather poses a higher demand for effective and reliable load restoration strategies and methods for ACIDC hybrid distribution systems. At present, there is little research on the reliability of reconstructed AC and DC distribution networks for distribution network load restoration. Therefore, this article proposes a load restoration method for AC/DC distribution systems that considers reliability. Firstly, a modified explicit reliability evaluation model was established; Secondly, an optimization model for load restoration was established with the highest reliability and the maximum amount of recovered power loss load as the objective functions; Finally, a simulation comparison was conducted in a numerical example to verify the effectiveness of the optimization method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Market Game Model Considering Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) gathers various types of resources and is a new participant in the power market. The research on the market equilibrium state based on VPPs is helpful to analyze the problems existing in the construction of open power market. Based on the analysis of game behavior in power market, this paper constructs the decision-making models of VPPs and traditional power plants, and discusses the applicability of reinforcement learning in the bidding strategy of power producers. Based on this, a bi-level game model with VPPs is proposed. The model is solved iteratively based on the multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) method combining win or learn fast and policy hill-climbing algorithm, and the state space is compressed to improve the solution speed. Finally, through the example analysis, the results show that the proposed model and algorithm can effectively solve the optimal bidding strategy of VPPs and obtain the market equilibrium results. In the power market with constant total demand, VPPs have better resource integration and profitability than traditional power plants, and have higher adaptability to different power trading mechanisms.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Park-type Microgrid Considering Time-varying Carbon Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective park-level microgrid economic dispatch model considering time-varying power consumption factors is proposed for park-level microgrids that only consider carbon economy. Firstly, by improving the carbon emission model of the whole process of power production, this paper deeply studies the carbon emission characteristics of contact circuit and energy storage charging and discharging. On the basis of excavating the low-carbon potential of load-schedulable resources and constructing the load-schedulable resource invocation model under the dual incentive of price signal and time-varying carbon factor curve, a low-carbon economic dispatch model of park-type microgrid considering time-varying carbon factor curve is constructed. The system operation is simulated and optimized with the goal of minimizing the system operation cost, carbon emission, peak-valley difference and fluctuation of comprehensive load. The simulation results show that the low-carbon economic dispatch model can improve the system stability, reduce the system peak-valley difference and system volatility on the basis of reducing the system carbon emission level and reducing the total operating cost, and better complete the above objectives.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Investment Efficiency of Chinese Provincial Power Grid Companies based on Super Efficiency SBM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasingly complex electricity market environment, the evaluation of the quality and efficiency of power grid investment is gradually di-versified. In order to measure the efficiency of power grid investment in various regions, this paper uses the panel data of 31 regions (excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) from 2016 to 2021 to construct the input-output index system of power grid investment efficiency. Considering the undesirable output, the super-efficiency SBM (slacks-based-measure) model is used to explore the efficiency of power grid investment and its dynamic changes. The results show that from 2016 to 2021, the investment efficiency of China s power grid shows a high-low-medium trend from east to west, and during this period, the overall investment efficiency shows an increasing trend. And the efficiency difference between the central region and other regions has a decreasing trend.

articleTitle: Improved Braking Criterion for Phasor Current Differential Protection Based on Sigmoid Function
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to enhance the sensitivity of phasor current differential protection for AC transmission lines that connect modular multilevel converter high voltage direct current converters (MMC-HVDC) and inverter interface renewable energy generators (IIREGs), a new optimization scheme that utilizes the Sigmoid function to compensate for phasor differential braking currents has been introduced. This compensation term improves the protection sensitivity, particularly when the phase angle difference is close to 90°. Compared to existing methods, the proposed algorithm offers a more flexible adjustment of the equivalent braking coefficient without requiring complex calculations or tuning. The proposed algorithm’s reliability and superiority have been confirmed through testing on the RTDS simulation platform under different fault scenarios.

Author Keywords: modular multilevel converter high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC)

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Input-Parallel Output-Parallel Phase-Shift Full-Bridge DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This manuscript proposed a coordinated control method based on droop characteristic for an input-parallel output-parallel (IPOP) phase-shift full-bridge (PSFB) DC-DC converter. By introducing a variable virtual impedance and a DC bias voltage in the control loop, the output current sharing is got, the output voltage drop is compensated, and the circulating current is suppressed. The proposed control strategy is validated by means of a 3-kW experimental prototype with two IPOP PSFB DC-DC converter modules at 100 kHz. And a maximum efficiency of 95.3 % is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-connected and Off-grid Control Strategy of Advanced Adiabatic Compressed Air Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In the background of the application of compressed air energy storage system to participate in grid regulation, due to the large capacity of compressed air energy storage, access to the grid and off-grid will bring instability to the system, so how to keep the compressed air energy storage system on-grid and off-grid can maintain the stability of voltage and frequency as well as normal absorption and emission of power becomes an urgent problem to be solved. This paper proposes a control strategy for the compressed air energy storage system in both grid-connected and off-grid modes, so that the compressed air energy storage system can transmit power to the grid in a stable manner during grid-connected operation, while providing voltage and frequency support for the system during off-grid operation, thus maintaining stable system operation. Finally, simulation models are built in MATLAB/Simulink for parallel and off-grid simulation, and simulation analysis is also carried out for switching from grid-connected to off-grid and from off-grid to grid-connected to verify the rationality and feasibility of the parallel and off-grid control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-energy Co-stage Bidding Mechanism Suitable for Fujian New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Fujian has a relatively high proportion of new energy and rich types of new energy, and how to solve the problem of multi-energy entities bidding on the same stage is a key problem faced by Fujian market trading. In this context, this paper proposes a multi-energy bidding mechanism adapted to Fujian’s new power system. In view of the difference in competitiveness between multiple energy sources, the clearing order of the traditional clearing mechanism is optimized according to the “price difference mode” to ensure the clearing priority of high marginal cost energy entities such as gas turbines. Second, in order to ensure the reasonable income of energy subjects, a price difference apportionment and return mechanism is proposed, so that energy entities with different cost characteristics can obtain reasonable benefits. At the same time, the market mechanism is innovated to ensure the reasonable income of different energy players participating in the market.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Energy Storage Grid-Connected Converters Based on DEPSO and Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As a key component of energy storage system, grid-connected converter plays an important role in the transient characteristics of energy storage system. In order to accurately construct the mathematical model of the converter, it is necessary to accurately obtain the parameters of the model. In this paper, a control parameter identification method for grid-connected converter based on Differential Evolution Particle Swarm optimization (DEPSO) algorithm is proposed, And adopt adaptive strategies for algorithm parameters. The identification results show that DEPSO algorithm is obviously superior to DE algorithm and PSO algorithm in parameter identification accuracy and global searching ability. Through the simulation test, there is a large deviation between the simulated value and the actual measured value. Therefore, an adaptive optimization strategy for identification parameters based on fuzzy control was proposed, so that the identification parameters could be adjusted adaptively according to the deviation between the simulated values and the actual measured values. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: MPPT Design for Hybrid PV-TEG System under Partial Shading Condition via Manta Ray Foraging Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The highly efficient Manta Ray Foraging optimization (MRFO) algorithm is utilized to achieve maximum power point tracking (MPPT) in a centralized hybrid photovoltaic-thermoelectric generator (PV-TEG) system under partial shading conditions (PSC). This approach enhances the power generation efficiency and energy utilization of the hybrid system. Given the existence of multiple local maximum power points (LMPPs) in the centralized hybrid PV-TEG system under PSC, MRFO is leveraged to effectively identify the global maximum power point (GMPP) and overcome the challenge of multiple LMPPs, a challenge that is causing traditional MPPT algorithms to fall into local optimization, leading to tracking failures and reducing the total output power of the hybrid system. To validate the effectiveness of the MRFO-based MPPT approach, two case studies are conducted, including start-up test and step variation test. Simulation results demonstrate that compared to other methods such as the Whale optimization Algorithm (WOA), Firefly Algorithm (FA), Perturbation Observation (P&O), and Incremental Conductance (INC) methods, the MRFO-based MPPT approach achieves higher power collection efficiency in a shorter time and delivers minimal power fluctuations.

articleTitle: Bi-level Homogeneous Dispatching of Power System Considering Unified Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The uniformity of grid operation is an important metric to evaluate the available transmission capacity and operational safety of the system. To address the problem that the conventional safe uniform dispatch cannot satisfy the economy and balance at the same time, a bi-level homogeneous dispatch model of the grid with unified power flow controller (UPFC) is proposed, on which a linearized optimal power flow (OPF) model is used to preserve the node voltage magnitude and line reactive power while ensuring the calculation speed. The results of UPFC optimization are solved by particle swarm algorithm combined with Gurobi solver, and the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by the analysis of IEEE 30-node system.

articleTitle: A Virtual Power Plant Economic Scheduling Strategy Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the dispatching efficiency and information security level of virtual power plant (VPP), a virtual power plant economic dispatching strategy based on deep reinforcement learning was proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the distributed operating environment of virtual power plant, an optimized computational blockchain system suitable for VPP is proposed. Secondly, the deep reinforcement learning theory is used to transform the VPP economic scheduling problem into a sequential decision problem of reinforcement learning. POS algorithm is used to improve the design method of state space, action space and reward function. Finally, the optimal scheduling decision is solved and applied in offline and online environments. The effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method are verified by comparison and analysis of examples.

articleTitle: Analysis on Technical Loss Reduction of Typical Low-Voltage Distribution Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: It is extremely important for power grid enterprises to find the combination of economic benefits and stable operation by studying energy loss. By drawing power grid topology of typical low-voltage distribution areas, using current theoretical line loss calculation software, considering energy conservation effects and power grid renovation plan, reasonable and economic technical loss reduction schemes are proposed. It has been found that in order to have effects on loss reduction, for low-voltage distribution areas such as YA and WF, where have several high-loss conductors that account for a relatively large or even half of the total loss, it is best to replace the high-loss conductors; for low-voltage distribution areas such as GM, where have multiple high-loss conductors with relatively balanced loss proportion, it is best to optimize the installation location of the distribution transformer. The proposed scheme has pertinence and can provide a practical reference for reducing energy loss and power grid planning.

articleTitle: Study of the Short-circuit Currents in Branches of a Single-loop Network with Connected Decentralized Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The paper presents the determination of the short-circuit currents in branches of hybrid medium voltage distribution networks with connected decentralized energy sources. It is known that after connecting the decentralized energy sources, sections with more than one power supply appear in the branches, which becomes a challenge for the servicing staff. This leads to a change in the structure of the network, its mode parameters, and also requires adjustments to the settings of the relay protection. The proposed software will be useful for engineers in the operation of hybrid electrical networks and for students in their preparation for designing, reconstructing and servicing similar types of networks, the number of which is constantly increasing. It will assist in choosing the optimal power configuration for users in post-emergency situations. It will also serve as the basis for the selection of switchgear and current-carrying parts.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimal Scheduling Model of Virtual Energy Storage Based on Electric Vehicles under Time-of-Use Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Access to large-scale electric vehicles poses a new challenge to the optimal scheduling of electric power systems. This paper proposes a bi-level optimal scheduling model of virtual energy storage for electric vehicles under TOU. Using TOU electricity price to guide the orderly charging of electric vehicles on the load side; Then, considering the uncertainty factors in the process of photovoltaic output at the source side and price-type demand response at the load side, the system optimization scheduling was carried out to maximize the economic benefit of charge and discharge and minimize the peak-valley difference of load. Finally, through the analysis of simulation examples, it can be concluded that the bi-level optimal scheduling strategy proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the peaking and valley difference of load in the system, realize the orderly charging of electric vehicles, and effectively improve users’ satisfaction with electricity consumption, reduce users’ charging costs and increase system economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Modified Carrier-Based Discontinuous PWM for Photovoltaic Three-Level Converter with Reduced Common Mode Voltage Ripple
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Nowadays, three-level inverters are frequently applied in photovoltaic (PV) systems because of their high efficiency and low harmonics. To improve the power density of transformerless three-level inverters, the high switching frequency is considered which causes lager switching losses. Discontinuous PWM (DPWM) is a solution to reduce switching losses. However, conventional DPWMs cause common mode voltage (CMV) ripple which worsens the reliability of PV systems. To solve this problem, DPWMA is proposed by selecting space vectors which CMV amount are low, but the CMV ripple can be further reduced. In this paper, a modified carried-based DPWM is proposed to reduce CMV ripple of DPWMA. Carrier types of every phase are selected to realize an improved PWM sequence according to switching clamping modes. Finally, the proposed modulation strategy is verified in different modulation index by the simulation.

articleTitle: Layout Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Considering Economic-Technology Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
