abstract: This paper proposed a layout optimization method for offshore wind farms that considers economic and technology constraints. The wake deficit factor of wind turbines in wind farms is calculated based on the engineering wake model, considering both partial and wake superposition scenarios. Furthermore, the power output of the wind farm is estimated based on complex wind conditions. The genetic algorithm is then employed to optimize the number and positions of wind turbines while taking into account factors such as construction costs, operation and maintenance expenses, and construction difficulties. The proposed method provides a systematic approach to optimizing wind farm layout, balancing various factors to maximize power output while minimizing costs.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of partial discharge in switchgear based on deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: he deep neural network switch cabinet integrated with residual learning is a kind of electrical equipment, which is mainly used to open and close, control and protect electrical equipment in the process of power generation, transmission, distribution and energy conversion in the power system. However, in the complex environment of high temperature and high voltage where the power system lasts for a long time, or in the process of manufacturing, transportation and assembly of the switchgear, it is inevitable that some potential safety hazards will be generated, such as dust, conductive particles, metal tips, air gaps, etc., which may lead to various forms of partial discharge, thus leading to insulation failure or power system failure. In this paper, a deep neural network fault diagnosis method for partial discharge of switchgear is proposed, which integrates residual learning. Its core idea is to update the weight of the prediction model with residual learning algorithm, and update the neuron bias of the prediction model with gradient descent algorithm. Compared with the traditional methods, the prediction model proposed in this paper can efficiently and accurately predict the type of partial discharge fault of the switchgear, effectively save manpower and time costs, simplify the fault diagnosis process, improve the robustness of the power station, improve the intelligent degree of the power station, and ensure the smooth and safe operation of the power station.

articleTitle: Study on Noise and Temperature Rise Characteristics of Iron-Based Soft Magnetic Composite-Silicon Steel Hybrid Core Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The high voltage shunt reactor is the important equipment for reactive power compensation and harmonic suppression in the power grid. However, due to the magnetostrictive effect and electromagnetic force, the noise problem of the shunt reactor has been paid much attention. Iron-based soft magnetic composite materials(SMC) have the characteristics of low magnetostriction and low iron loss. It is of great significance to study the noise and temperature rise characteristics of the reactor with these materials as the core. The hybrid core reactor combined silicon steel and SMC materials. In this article, the reactor noise and temperature rise test platform was built. Through the voltage boost test, it is found that the noise of the hybrid core reactor is less than 55dB(A), which is obviously less than that of the silicon steel reactor. Besides, the hybrid core reactor is less affected by voltage change and winding loosening. The noise level is more stable. Through the temperature rise test, it is found that the highest temperature rise of the hybrid core reactor is $3.5 ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ lower than that of the silicon steel reactor during normal operation. In addition, there is no obvious local excessive temperature rise. The analysis shows that the hybrid core reactor has obvious advantages in terms of noise and temperature rise. It is a kind of reactor with a good application prospect.}}

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network “Source - Load - Storage” Cooperative Optimal Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To be able to heighten the power supply reliability of active distribution network and cut down the operation cost of power system, a two-layer optimal dispatching model of distribution network was built taking into account the access of distributed power supply, flexible load and energy storage system. The constraints such as distributed power output constraint, flexible load demand response constraint and energy storage response constraint were taken into account. The upper layer considers the economy of the distribution network operation and aims at the best overall benefit of the distribution network. The lower layer considers the reliability of the distribution network operation and aims at the optimal load variation. The Yalmip toolbox in MATLAB platform calls Gurobi optimization software to solve the problem, and finally uses IEEE33 node system for simulation and verification.

articleTitle: Joint Expansion Planning of Offshore Wind Farms and Transmission Lines Considering N - 1 Contigency
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The rapid development of offshore wind farms (OWFs) has been witnessed all over the world for its excellent application prospects. To ensure the accommodation of wind power and the maintenance of operational security, it may need to implement transmission expansion and flexibility reformation of thermal power units. This research paper presents an optimization approach that aims to jointly optimize the flexibility reformation of thermal power units, integration sites for OWFs, and transmission expansion. The planning model focuses on minimizing the total investment cost while improving the wind power utilization and satisfying N-1 security. To solve the problem, an iterative algorithm is employed, which involves iteratively solving mixed-integer linear programming problems with adjusted constraints. By conducting a case study using the IEEE-30 bus system, we validate the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-harmonic Linearization Based Small-Signal Impedance Modeling of a Modular Multilevel Converter With DSOGI-PLL
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In recent years, the grid-connected stability of modular multilevel converter (MMC) has attracted widespread attention. The performance of MMC control has a significant impact on its stability, among which the phase-locked loop (PLL) plays an important role in maintaining system stability. Compared with the traditional single-synchronous coordinate system PLL, the PLL using a dual second-order generalized integrator (DSOGI-PLL) is more capable of accurately locking the phase in situations of three-phase imbalance and complex system harmonics, providing accurate phase information for the design of subsequent control systems. However, the traditional single synchronous coordinate system PLL is widely used in most of the current research, while the MMC impedance model using DSOGIPLL has not been established. Therefore, this article is intended to fill a gap in this aspect of MMC modeling. In this paper, the small-signal impedance models of the MMC using DSOGI-PLL are first developed based on the multi-harmonic linearization approach. Then analyze the effects of DSOGI-PLL parameters, current controller bandwidth and circulation suppression bandwidth on the impedance characteristics of MMC. Finally, the correctness of the established multi-harmonic linearization impedance models and theoretical analysis using DSOGI-PLL are proved based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of Electrical Power Systems using Polynomial Approximation based Galerkin Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Parametric problems in the transient analysis of power systems, refer to studying how changes in system parameters affect the dynamic behavior of the system. The dynamic behavior of a power system is characterized by the time-varying voltages, currents, and power flows, which are influenced by various parameters such as load demand, generation capacity, transmission line impedance, and control settings. To address these parametric problems, a proposed method based on the Galerkin method based polynomial approximation is introduced. The Galerkin method is used to determine coefficients that establish a relationship between the system parameters and the dynamic behavior. This allows for efficient and accurate approximation of the parametric transient trajectory using polynomial expressions. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, it is tested on an IEEE 9 bus system and compared with existing processes. The results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves accuracy when there are significant parameter changes and strong system nonlinearity. Additionally, the method exhibits global controllable accuracy characteristics within the range of variable parameters.

articleTitle: An Assessment Method for Vulnerable Lines of Power System with Offshore Wind Power Considering Typhoon Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Frequent typhoons bring new challenges to the safe and reliable operation of the power system. Aiming at the problem of vulnerable line assessment of offshore wind power system under typhoon weather scenarios, a vulnerable line assessment method considering the risk propagation of offshore wind power system under the influence of typhoon is proposed. Firstly, based on typhoon data, power system topology and geographical parameters, the typhoon scenario is constructed, and the uncertainty of offshore wind power output is depicted by using the interval number, and a regional power flow model considering wind power access is established. Secondly, based on the dynamic Bayesian network (DBN), a time-varying risk propagation model of the power system is established according to the uncertainty of wind power output and the power flow transfer caused by line faults Finally, the real-time comprehensive vulnerability interval index of line is defined by considering the line fault and system risk propagation in typhoon scenario.and the assessment of vulnerable lines in power system with offshore wind power under typhoon scenario is realized. The simulation results of IEEE-RST79 verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: A Harmonic Injection Method to Reduce Filter Inductance or Capacitance for MMC-BESS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Battery energy storage system based on double-star structure, which is also called modular multilevel converter battery energy storage system (MMC-BESS) is a practical topology to expand the capacity of single machine. However, the inherent current fluctuation in submodule will have a negative influence on batteries. Therefore, the LC passive filter is introduced as the power buffer unit to suppress the battery current fluctuation. First, the components of DC side current in submodules are deduced. Then, the design method of LC passive is proposed. Next, the influence of different current or voltage harmonic injection method on battery current is analyzed. On this basis, a second-order circulating current and third-order harmonic voltage injection method is proposed to decrease the filter inductance or capacitance. Finally, the correctness of proposed method is verified by simulation on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Optimization of Integrated Energy System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The integrated energy system contains a variety of types of energy equipment, which can realize the efficient utilization of a variety of energy sources and solve the problem of new energy consumption. For the optimization of energy storage capacity of integrated energy system, the demand response of electricity load price type and heat load incentive demand response are established, based on the double-layer optimization theory, a double-layer optimization model of energy storage capacity of integrated energy system considering demand response is established, and the capacity configuration of energy storage equipment is obtained under the premise of achieving the lowest total cost of the system, and the model and method are verified through typical example simulation. The results show that the model proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the investment cost of the integrated energy system, and considering the comprehensive demand response of electricity/heat can reduce the energy storage capacity and total cost of the system, and improve the absorption rate of new energy.

articleTitle: Topology Identification in Distribution Network Based on μPMU Phase Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Fast and accurate topology identification is an important basis for the stable and safe operation of power grids. With the increasing complexity and uncertainty of the distribution network, the topology changes more frequently. Aiming at the problems that the existing topology identification methods have poor real-time performance and are susceptible to external interference, this paper proposes an adaptive topology identification method for distribution networks. The topology similarity is calculated and fed back to the algorithm parameters in real time, and a topology identification optimization model is established to complete the topology identification. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified on the test case of double-petal ring network.

articleTitle: Effect of Back-P-Region on Reverse Recovery Oscillation Suppression in High-Voltage FRDs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The efficient transmission of electricity over long distance requires the use of high-voltage fast recovery diodes (FRDs). However, if not designed correctly, these diodes can lead to oscillation problems and damage to the device, potentially disrupting the operation of other devices in the system. Therefore, it is crucial to explore methods to suppress oscillation during the FRD reverse recovery process. In order to alleviate this problem, the FCE (Field Charge Extraction) diode, with a high-concentration $P^{+}$ region added to the cathode $N^{+}$ region, has been proposed. However, there is limited literature on the detailed mechanism of its oscillation suppression effect. In this paper, three-dimensional models of 4500-V high-voltage conventional FRD and FCE diode are established with Sentaurus TCAD tools. The mechanism of oscillation suppression is elucidated by studying the movement of internal carriers during reverse recovery. Simulation results show that the larger the proportion of the back P region, the better the reverse recovery softness of the diode, the more obvious the oscillation suppression effect.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Field-circuit Coupling and Output Response of TMR Current Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Current sensors based on the tunneling magnetoresistance effect (TMR) have many advantages, such as small size, high sensitivity, wide measurement range, etc. In this paper, the output response of TMR current sensor under complex electromagnetic environments are numerically studied with finite element method. A prediction method for the operating characteristics of TMR sensor is developed with field-circuit coupling method, and the adaptability of TMR current sensor under different coil currents is also discussed. The results show that, the linear operating region of TMR current sensor is from6. 75mT to 6. 75mT. The variation of output voltage with the installation angle is in a cosine law. When the sensitivity axis of TMR current sensor is parallel to the magnetic field vector, the absolute value of its output voltage is the highest. Furthermore, when the Barker coil is applied with step, sinusoidal wave and harmonic currents, if the TMR current sensor works in the linear operating region, it can sensitively detect the magnetic field generated by different currents. The output voltage of TMR sensor changes with coil current waveform, amplitude and frequency, and shows good adaptability.

articleTitle: Graph Convolution Network for Carbon Emission Factor Forecast of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Global climate change is intensifying, and more measures to reduce carbon emissions should be taken. A method based on graph neural network can predict the carbon emission factors of power grid and that helps the users side to take more active measures to reduce the carbon emission behavior caused by electricity consumption. By learning the data of power grid loads and carbon emission factors through the graph neural network, which quickly predicts the carbon emission factors of nodes of the power grid, and provides an auxiliary basis for power grid dispatching. Finally, using a standard IEEE 39-bus system, the validity of the prediction model is verified by comparing the prediction data with the data obtained from traditional power flow calculations.

articleTitle: Single-Pole Ground Fault Protection Method for DC Distribution Network Based on Active Injection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this paper, based on the insufficient reliability of the existing wire routing methods for single-pole ground faults in DC distribution networks, the previous method of wire routing based on transient quantities is improved with controllable steady-state quantities. A single-ended DC distribution network model with a modular multilevel converter (MMC) as the core is established. By injecting a sinusoidal signal into the MMC, the response waveform to the sinusoidal signal is obtained at the line, and the conclusion that the faulted line is an inductive zero-mode impedance and the non-faulted line is a capacitive zero-mode impedance is obtained, and the faulted line of the DC distribution network can be selected based on this principle. Among the influencing factors of the optimal frequency of the sinusoidal detection signal, the size of the transition resistance and the response speed of the MMC are taken into account, and the amplitude and injection time of the sinusoidal waveform is given on the basis of not affecting the normal operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Standardized Wave Energy Generation Device Design
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This study examines the current state of standardization for wave power generation devices and proposes a SolidWorks-based standardization scheme. The standardized wave power generation device comprises basic and auxiliary modules, classified according to their functions, and incorporates mainstream, standardized parts available in the market. The design aims for high efficiency, low cost, and a clever and convenient structure. An innovative conceptual model for a wave energy generation device is proposed and realized using the previously designed standardized parts. Additionally, another power generation device is proposed based on the standardized parts list.

articleTitle: Controllable Rectification Technology with Adaptive Parameter Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: At present, the three-phase rectifier bridge composed of fully controlled devices such as MOSFET and IGBT has the advantages of low harmonic content of current on the grid side, controllable output voltage on the DC side, and unit power factor operation. It has been widely used in the fields of new energy grid-connection and micro-grid system. In the rectifier bridge predictive control, model predictive control (MPC) has been widely used in recent years because of its high control accuracy, but the parameter error of model predictive controller will affect the prediction accuracy. Therefore, a controllable rectifier technology with adaptive parameter online identification algorithm is proposed to solve the model adaptation problem caused by parameter changes. The algorithm uses the least square method to calculate the input inductance and resistance of the three-phase rectifier bridge through the input current and voltage and the output voltage within each sampling period. The controller parameters can be updated online through the input voltage and current of the controller without additional sensors, so as to reduce the performance degradation caused by model parameter errors.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Dispatching Strategy for Combined Heat and Power System Considering the Thermal Characteristics of HFC
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This paper uses the thermal characteristics of hydrogen fuel cell (HFC) to relax the wind-electric-thermal coupling contradiction existing in the combined heat and power (CHP) system. Firstly, the thermal characteristics of HFC and their different response levels under different dispatching instructions are analyzed to explore the thermal utilization potential. Secondly, a multi-time scale dispatching model for the CHP system is developed considering the thermal characteristics of HFC. The simulation results suggest that the proposed strategy optimizes the electric-thermal coupling of the CHP system and substantially improves the adjustment ability of the system units.

articleTitle: Technical Life Assessment of Main Equipment in Power Grid Considering the Operating State and Aging Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In response to the issue of difficulty in accurately predicting the technical lifespan of power grid main equipment, this article proposes a technical lifespan evaluation method that comprehensively considers the operating status and aging mechanism of power grid main equipment, based on the aging mechanism of power grid main equipment and the impact of operating status on the aging rate of power grid main equipment. Firstly, determine the operating status of the equipment according to the state evaluation guidelines; Then, establish different aging models based on the aging mechanisms of different equipment types; Finally, convert the state evaluation results into state evaluation coefficients, refer to the design life of the substation main equipment and the aging factor under rated load, calculate the accelerated aging factor, and establish technical life evaluation models for various types of substation main equipment.

articleTitle: Micro Magnetostrictive-Piezoelectric Coupling Sensors for Measurement of Magnetic Filed
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Accurate and precise measurement of electrical current holds utmost significance across diverse domains that profoundly influence our daily lives. By measuring the magnetic field near the conductor, it becomes possible to deduce the magnitude of the electric current traversing the conductor. In this study, a novel high-sensitivity MEMS magnetic sensor has been introduced for the measurement of both AC and DC magnetic fields. The sensor leverages the synergistic combination of magnetostrictive and piezoelectric effects to enhance its overall performance. Employing state-of-the-art microfabrication techniques, the sensor structure is meticulously designed as a silicon bridge-film configuration. By conducting extensive simulations, we have effectively accomplished magnetic field measurement using a micro device through meticulous analysis of the output voltage variations. The sensor exhibits an exceptional level of sensitivity, rendering it capable of fulfilling the diverse requirements in power grid and electrical equipment applications. The proposed sensor offers several notable advantages including cost-effectiveness, compact size, and simplified scalability for mass production. These attributes collectively position the presented sensor as a promising technology with extensive application potential.

articleTitle: Clustering and Storage Methods for Transient Stable Fast Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of timeliness and accuracy in online transient stability assessment, a clustering and storage method for transient stability fast analysis of power grid operation mode is proposed. A strategy of stepwise construction is used to build a database of key features of the power grid, which realizes automatic identification and effective reduction of the key features. The two-layer sample clustering method is used to generate a sample set of operation mode, which reduces the scale of the sample set and improves the clustering accuracy. A two-layer data label structure is established for an index of samples, which improves the access efficiency of massive operation mode sample sets. The proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of transient stability fast analysis. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a practical power grid calculation example.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of Electrochemical Energy Storage System Debugging
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The typical faults during the subsystem debugging stage and joint debugging stage of the electrochemical energy storage system were studied separately. During the subsystem debugging, common faults such as point-to-point fault, communication fault, and grounding fault were analyzed, the troubleshooting methods were proposed. During the joint debugging, common faults such as batteries and PCS were analyzed, the optimized operation methods for energy storage systems were proposed to prevent them from occurring. A debugging fault diagnosis method based on the electrochemical energy storage system debugging fault database has been established, which helps to improve the debugging efficiency of the electrochemical energy storage system.

articleTitle: Two-stage Phase Compensation for Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The traditional phase compensation method in CVQKD (continuous variable quantum key distribution) usually assumes that the phase drift within a frame is constant. However, in reality, there are usually small phase drifts within a frame, especially in free space. Unperfect compensation of phase drifts can introduce additional phase noise, which can reduce key rate and transmission distance. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage phase compensation scheme that inserts different length phase drift compensation blocks to not only compensate for the average phase drift of a frame but also to compensate for the internal phase drift fluctuations within the frame. This enables more accurate phase drift compensation, particularly useful for scenarios with large and fast phase drift fluctuations.

articleTitle: The Control Strategy of New Energy Station for Power System Cooperative Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Based on the inertia support and primary frequency regulation ability of new energy station, this paper constructs a cooperative frequency regulation model, and proposes the frequency regulation timing strategy of thermal power unit and new energy station to ensure the stability of the system. Through simulation verification analysis, it can be seen that the proposed strategy can provide inertia and primary frequency regulation capacity based on the adjustment coefficient and dead zone of new energy station. The new energy station is used to frequency regulation with traditional generator, so as to support the frequency and reduce the regulation burden of the generator. When the adjustment coefficient of new energy station is matched with its dead zone, the designed primary frequency regulation performance and timing can be achieved.

articleTitle: Efficiency Optimization Based on LLC Cascaded Three-phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Modern power electronic devices pay great attention to the index of efficiency. In the case of high voltage input, low voltage and high current output, if the inverter is directly inverted, the inverter efficiency is low and the power quality is poor. In order to solve this problem, LLC con-verter can be used to convert high voltage to low voltage and supply power to the inverter. This two-stage inverter has higher efficiency. For the former LLC power supply, the lower the output DC voltage, the lower the efficiency; for three-phase inverters, the higher the input voltage, the lower the efficiency. How to select the intermediate DC voltage is the key to achieve optimal system efficiency. From the perspective of the system, this paper analyzes the influence of the intermediate stage voltage on the efficiency of the pre-stage LLC converter and the post-stage three-phase inverter. The intermediate stage voltage with the best efficiency of the cascade system is obtained by theoretical calculation, and the simulation model is built to verify the calculation results. Compared with the traditional single-stage inverter, the efficiency of the cascaded system with optimized intermediate voltage is improved by 5%.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Scheme of Energy Storage in Regional Power Grid Under the Goal of “Double Carbon”
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the release of the “carbon peak, carbon neutrality” program, energy transformation has been further promoted, and carbon emission reduction has been fully assisted. At the same time, wind power and photovoltaics have gradually been widely used in power systems. In this context, this paper proposes a bi-level optimization model of energy storage system under wind and solar access. Integrating planning with operational issues, the inner layer considers the cost of wind and power curtailment with the goal of minimizing the operating cost of the unit; the outer layer is aimed at minimizing the total cost of energy storage planning, taking into account network losses and energy storage benefits. Finally, the correctness and feasibility of the scheme and model are verified by the simulation analysis of Archimedes optimization algorithm in the improved 39-bus system.

articleTitle: An Optimal Decision-making Method for Independent Energy Storage Declaration Strategy Considering Comprehensive Transaction Benefits
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of formulating declaration strategy for independent energy storage in electric power spot market and improve its comprehensive income in electric power spot market and frequency modulation market, an optimization decision-making method of independent energy storage declaration strategy considering comprehensive transaction benefits was proposed. The expected transaction income of independent energy storage is the product of the timesharing curve of its charge-discharge power plan and forecast in the electricity spot market. If the self-dispatching mode is adopted to participate in the spot market of electricity, independent energy storage can make its own charging and discharging power plan. The expected transaction income of independent energy storage includes capacity income and mileage income in frequency modulation market. The capacity income is determined by the expected winning capacity of independent energy storage and the expected clearing price. Mileage returns are determined by expected frequency modulation response mileage and mileage compensation price. The evaluation model of expected benefit of independent energy storage is constructed to optimize the capacity declaration and charge-discharge power plan of independent energy storage frequency modulation under the goal of maximizing expected benefit. An example was constructed based on the actual data of a provincial power grid to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The result of the example shows that the declaration strategy can increase the expected income of independent energy storage by more than 10%, which is helpful to improve the income of independent energy storage trading.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Capacity-Increase Strategy of Transmission Lines Based on Thermal Inertia
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic capacity-increase strategy based on thermal inertia of conductor is proposed for high-voltage transmission lines. By using the finite element simulation software, the multi-physical field coupling analysis of the temperature rise process of the conductor is carried out, and the internal temperature distribution is considered. The precise results of the temperature change with the current are obtained. The temperature rise process caused by the increase of current generally lasts for 40 minutes. The temperature rise of wire first increases quickly and then slows down. The higher the current increment, the faster the temperature rise of wire. When the dynamic capacity-increase method is adopted, even if the current suddenly increases to exceed the specified limit value, it can ensure the safe operation of the transmission line for a period of time, which provides a solution to deal with the sudden condition of the line, and has a strong practical application value.

articleTitle: Multiuser Decision Equilibrium Analysis Considering the Coupling of Electricity Market, Carbon Market and Energy Consumption Right Market
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the increasing environmental problems, many countries regard the carbon emission market as an important means of energy conservation and emission reduction, and the similar energy trading market is also playing a role. With the deepening of the coupling between the electricity market and the carbon market, the decision making behavior of market players has to consider the interaction between the three. In this context, it is of great practical significance to study the decision making behavior and equilibrium analysis of market players under the coupling of multiple markets. This paper focuses on the equilibrium game of users in the market, and proposes a bilevel optimization model of multiuser equilibrium game under the coupling of electricity market, carbon market and energy consuming right market. The upper layer of the model takes the maximum user income as the optimization goal, and the lower layer is the market clearing model. The model is transformed into a mathematical problem with equilibrium constraints (MPEC) by Karush Kuhn Tucker condition (KKT), and the equilibrium point is solved by diagonalization algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by the IEEE30 node system.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement Method for Distribution Network Considering Distributed Generation Location
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Aiming at the extreme natural disaster situations that can easily cause large-scale power outage failure in the distribution network (DN), this paper presents a method to improve the resilience of DN considering the location of distributed generation (DG). Firstly, the location of DG is determined by analyzing the importance of each bus of DN through network centrality. Secondly, the island partition model is built with the goal of maximizing the power value of the restored load within the island to prioritize the restoration of power to important loads in the system. Then, a multi-objective fault recovery model of the main network and the residual network is constructed, which takes the minimizing network loss, minimizes the number of switching operations and minimizing voltage quality deviation as objectives, and restores the power to the remaining loss of load areas. Finally, the IEEE 33-bus DN is adopted as a numerical example for verification. The simulation results show that the proposed method in this article can provide a reasonable recovery scheme after a DN failure and significantly improve the resilience of the DN.

articleTitle: Method for Measuring Dynamic Resistance of Reactive Switch Circuit Breakers On - line
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Reactive power switch circuit breaker is more likely to be ablated than other circuit breakers because of inrush current and punch through voltage when it is on and off capacitive current, as well as closure and overvoltage when it is on and off inductive current and frequent operation. As a result, the switching performance is reduced and the breaking failure occurs. Therefore, this paper designs the main circuit of reactive power switching circuit breaker under laboratory conditions according to the voltage waveform changes in the actual breaking process of reactive power switching circuit breaker, establishes the simulation platform of reactive power switching circuit breaker breaking test, and uses the non-contact measurement dynamic resistance curve of reactive power switching circuit breaker breaking process to carry out a refined evaluation of the status of the arc extinguishing chamber of reactive power switching circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for Power Sale of Photovoltaic Plants with Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: In order to improve the economy of electricity sales photovoltaic power plants equipped with energy storage system, this paper proposes an optimization power sale strategy which takes into account the prediction of price peak time and price fluctuation. First, according to the historical electricity price data, the peak time of electricity price is predicted. Then, a long short term memory neural network is used to predict the electricity price at off-peak times. With the goal of maximizing the revenue, the optimization strategy and method of power sale are established. Finally, the power generation data and electricity price data of a photovoltaic power plant in Australia are used to conduct a simulation test. After the implementation of optimization, the monthly revenue has been significantly improved. Compared with the existing strategies, the proposed strategy has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Ride-through Strategy of Photo-storage Co-Control Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator Current Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the instability of new energy co-generation, the traditional virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology has difficulty in suppressing the divergence of the power angle when the grid voltage drops, resulting in overcurrent and unable to meet the reactive power support, which seriously affects the low-voltage ride-through. Although the current improvement strategy is to suppress overcurrent, the difference and cost consumption of different voltage dip depths is ignored. To address these challenges, a low-voltage ride-through strategy of photo-storage co-control based on VSG current suppression is proposed, which includes the suppression of current amplitude and the design of virtual impedance modulus and impedance-inductance ratio according to different voltage dip depths. This method avoids excessive inverter output power consumption while achieving transient power angle stability, adaptive reactive power compensation, and completes low-voltage ride-through through the adaptive adjustment of VSG power command values based on active current and voltage dip depth. Finally, Simulink simulation is used to verify the feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A User Electricity Characteristic Analysis Method Based on Honey Badger Algorithm and Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the construction of smart grid, a large number of applications of smart monitoring devices have promoted the development of large data of power distribution, which contains a large amount of user power information waiting to be excavated. A user power characteristic analysis method based on honey badger algorithm and fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is proposed. Firstly, normalize the obtained power data. Next, the honey badger algorithm is combined with the fuzzy C-mean algorithm to achieve clustering analysis to obtain more accurate results. During the clustering process, the honey badger algorithm is used to optimize the selection of clustering parameters to solve the local optimal solution problem, and the principle of adaptive local minimum index is used to select the optimal number of clusters. Finally, the user power characteristics are analyzed through simulation experiments, and the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Fault Ride-through Strategy of Offshore Wind Power Island via VSC-HVDC Grid-connected System Based on Surplus Power Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: To address the problem of direct current side over-voltage caused by power imbalance in the offshore wind power system with VSC-HVDC and grid integration due to short-circuit faults in the receiving end power grid, this paper proposes a fault ride-through strategy that combines surplus power allocation based on energy-consuming devices optimization and offshore wind power voltage control coordination. Firstly, this paper deduces the causes of direct current over-voltage caused by power imbalance and analyzes the main influencing factors, proposing the safe operating power of the system. Then, the relationship between the input power, output power, and safety power of the VSC-HVDC system is established, and the surplus power under no measures is allocated. Based on this, an energy-consuming resistance optimization strategy and a fault ride-through strategy coordinated with the islanded operation of offshore wind power are proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified on PSCADIEMTDC.

articleTitle: Double Modulation Simplified Space Vector PWM for Split Output Three-Level T-Type Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The use of high-frequency and wide-bandgap semiconductor switching devices further improves the performance of inverters. In this paper, a split-output T-type three-level inverter using SiC MOSFET devices is proposed based on the conventional T-type three-level inverter. The simulation verification shows that the adoption of double-modulation simplified space vector pulsewidth modulation (DMS-SVPWM) can reduce the influence of dead-time on inverter output. It demonstrates that the proposed DMS-SVPWM can significantly improve the output current quality of the split-output T-type three-level inverter.

articleTitle: Control Method of Hydrogen Fuel Cell DC-DC Converter Based on Generalized Second-Order Differential
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: With the development of new energy technology, hydrogen fuel cell has gradually become a hot spot in the field of new energy research, but its output characteristics are soft, output voltage is unstable, and dynamic response is slow. To solve this problem, this paper uses the former three-stage cascade circuit as the main topology of hydrogen fuel cell DC-DC converter, and proposes a control method based on generalized second-order differential function. Compared with traditional differential function, generalized second-order differential function has the phase lead compensation effect of traditional differential function in a specific frequency range, which improves the loop rapidity. At the same time, the high frequency noise amplification problem inherent in the traditional differential function is eliminated because of the low gain in the high frequency band. Based on the traditional PI closed-loop control, a parallel compensation control loop with generalized second-order differential function is added to improve the dynamic performance of the converter and reduce the output ripple. Finally, the effectiveness of the control method is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Energy Flow Analysis of Electricity-Gas Coupling System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: This article aims to study the energy flow analysis of the Electricity-Gas coupling system. Firstly, model the nodes, pipelines, and non-pipeline components of the natural gas system, innovatively equating the compressor into two forms: node and virtual branch. Secondly, based on the characteristics of gas transmission and distribution networks, establish mathematical models respectively. Finally, a unified model of the Electricity-Gas coupling system is established, and the constant power and constant voltage control modes of the energy conversion branch are proposed, propose a unified solution method and an alternating iteration solution method to solve the energy flow calculation problem of coupled systems, and provide a detailed explanation of the solving process of the alternating iteration solution method.

articleTitle: Double Model Optimal Cooperative Control Method for Multi-frequency Cooling Load Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The system framework is constructed for the balance of supply and demand in the demand-side resource scheduling of micro-grid with renewable new energy consumption capacity. The mathematical model of a single controllable regulated load, namely, a variable frequency air conditioner, is established by double models; On the premise that the indoor temperature meets the constraint target of comfortable temperature range, the tracking target is set for the controllable regulated load, namely the variable frequency air conditioner. Establish the topological relationship of information exchange between multi-controllable regulated loads, i.e. multi-variable frequency air conditioners; According to the dual model and control objectives, the collaborative control strategy of iterative optimization is designed. Relevant data are given, and feasibility analysis and theoretical verification are carried out according to MATLAB. On the premise of meeting the constraint of indoor temperature comfort, the supply and demand balance problem in the demand-side resource dispatching of power grid with renewable new energy consumption is realized. The application solves the coupling complex network problem of cooperative tracking target with temperature comfort constraint.

articleTitle: Online Volt-Var Control Based on Reinforcement Learning in Active Distribution Systems Considering PV Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Due to the wide deployment of photovoltaic (PV) power generation, voltage stability is facing a severe challenge in the active distribution networks (ADNs). Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques have been widely adopted in the power system optimal operation and quick control with high-performance achievements. Existing RL algorithms can handle only homogenous control action spaces, i.e., either continuous or discrete actions. However, the voltage control problem has hybrid action spaces. This paper proposes a hybrid soft actor-critic (H-SAC) algorithm for online quick-optimal voltage control. First, the problem is formulated to consider all types of control actions, including the setpoints of PV inverters. Second, it is standardized to be compatible with RL techniques. Third, the fundamental sample-efficient entropy-based maximization SAC algorithm is enhanced to train a policy with hybrid action spaces, where an action selection method is employed to map the continuous output of the actor-network into the integer action spaces. The proposed method is applied to the modified IEEE 33-bus system, where the voltage has been controlled with a very low computational burden.

articleTitle: Configuration of Battery Capacity for Energy Storage Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation Based on VSG Control
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the integration of renewable energy sources continues to grow, power systems face critical challenges including the reduction of system inertia and frequency dynamic degradation. Virtual Synchronous Generation (VSG) control, designed to mimic the behavior of synchronous generators, can provide inertia and damping support to the power system for regulating active power frequency and reactive power voltage. This paper introduces the overall structure of an energy storage system based on VSG control, including the bidirectional DC/DC control on the DC storage side and the control principle of the grid-connected inverter VSG. A comparative simulation analysis between VSG control and droop control is conducted, outlining the constraint mechanism of energy storage VSG under different inertia constants and damping coefficients, aiming to achieve optimal configuration of battery storage units. The optimal energy and power parameters of energy storage units for different damping ratios are determined, and the suggested approach is validated and demonstrated by conducting simulations using Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Hybrid Assessment Method for Health Status of Charging piles Based on AHP and Entropy Weighting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: As the new energy vehicle industry continues to rapidly develop and supporting charging facilities continue to improve, the operation of a large number of decentralized and centralized charging stations has become increasingly prominent. In order to scientifically manage and comprehensively evaluate existing charging stations, this paper conducts a comprehensive analysis of the technical performance requirements and safety impact factors of electric vehicle charging stations. From the perspectives of electrical performance and safety performance, indicators are selected and determined, and a hierarchical structure of indicators is constructed for the comprehensive evaluation of the health status of electric vehicle charging stations. A comprehensive evaluation model of the health status of electric vehicle charging stations is then constructed based on the uncertain analytic hierarchy process and entropy weight method. Finally, the comprehensive evaluation model and algorithm for the health status of charging stations are validated and compared through specific examples, achieving efficient evaluation of the health status of charging piles.

articleTitle: Coordinated STATCOMs Planning for Wind-Photovoltaic Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: Replacement of synchronous generators by converter-based generators brings a big challenge to the systems, in terms of reactive generation. Static synchronous compensators (STATCOMs), which can effectively provide reactive power during both pre-contingency and post-contingency stage for the power systems. The proper configuration of STATCOMs can significantly save the cost at the premise of satisfying the reactive power demand. This paper proposes a multi-stage coordinated STATCOMs planning method, with a novel index for evaluating the short-term voltage stability, for the wind-photovoltaic power systems. The planning method also including total cost and static voltage stability indices. The coordination for the multiple stages can effectively improve the short-term voltages stability of the systems, with a less cost. The effectiveness of the planning method is verified by IEEE 39-bus test system.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Response Method to Cluster Classification of Large Charging Piles
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The accurate response of electric vehicles as a flexible load to the regulatory signals of multiple power markets requires a high degree of cooperation from charging piles, which poses a serious challenge to the response performance of the piles. In this paper, a method of classifying charging pile clusters is proposed based on the response accuracy as well as the linear fit to construct response characteristics. The charging piles will be classified into four types, the K-means clustering method is used to provide uniform regulation instructions for linear clusters and the probability distribution of power deviations to control the error range of nonlinear clusters respectively. By giving different degrees of regulation instructions to different clusters, it ensures that the charging pile resources with good responsiveness and cost-effective regulation can be utilized in priority

articleTitle: An Online MMC Arm Current Control with Adaptive Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power and Energy Technology (ICPET)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) arm current contain AC current, DC current, and circulating current. Therefore, by controlling the arm current, the control structure can be simplified and indirect suppression of the circulating current can be achieved. This paper establishes a mathematical model of the MMC based on the arm current in a three-phase stationary coordinate system, establishes the state equations of each arm current considering perturbations. Proposes a proportion integrated resonant and phase-looking loop observer controller with decoupled tracking and immunity performance. The problem of poor resilience of the PIR controller to disturbances is addressed. The controller parameter adjustment problem under unbalanced grid is solved by using the seagull optimization algorithm to achieve online adaptive parameter adjustment of the controller. An MMC rectifier-side simulation model is built to demonstrate the advantages of this control method over the conventional fixed-parameter quasi-proportional resonance control under balanced and unbalanced grid conditions.
